title: The Grudge
synopsis:
This series contains mature themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
The day Charles Ji, leader of the White Flame Gang, is betrayed and murdered by his own fiancé, he unexpectedly regains consciousness thirty years in the past. Now in the body of nineteen-year-old Hanson Ji, the alpha is rescued by Will Jin, a beta doctor who treats him and takes him into his home. Charles remains wary of his savior, however, unable to ignore one unsettling fact: Will has the same face as the man who killed him. As Dr. Jin's unexpected warmth begins to disarm him, can Charles resist the dangerous attraction drawing them together?

title: Junk to King: I Am A Scavenger
synopsis:
You’ve received a hidden job. Processing… Congratulations, Scavenger!
Typhon Ye couldn’t afford to repay the high-interest loans that plagued him after a few failed investments, so his loan shark made him do illegal work for private parties to repay his debts. On one fateful day, Typhon struck down a monster he should never have been able to, and in that instant, experience points surged within him! He’d leveled up from Lv. 0 to Lv. 1! Typhon had triggered his once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to get a job! But the hands of fate had another plan for him, he awakened to a job unheard of in history -Scavenger! A “unique” job that revolves entirely around junk!

title: Elixir of the Sun
synopsis:
This series contains mature themes and graphic depictions of self-harm that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
“I want you, Your Majesty.”
For once, Emperor Dhan is at a loss for words. Scorned by her own people for lacking their healing gift, Bayan finds herself in the palace of an emperor whose concubines meet bloody ends. Under a divine curse and tormented by an unquenchable thirst, Dhan is a man to fear.
Yet the woman dismissed as powerless may be the one who can bring him peace. But Bayan doesn’t just want a place by his side. She wants him.

title: Deadman's Undecember
synopsis: Three descendants appear living in different eras but all have the same problem of the undead.Their mission is to protect the weak from the undead that's littered in the chaotic world. A thrilling action comic where the story going through different eras dealing with one problem!

title: 24-Hour Rebirth Consultation Center
synopsis: For generations, Laura’s family has run a divine sanctuary to guide souls lost across time and space. After a five-hundred-year drought, three legendary clients crash into her office simultaneously. A transmigrated hero trapped in the body of a royal, a regressed tyrant looking for a restart, and a reincarnated ancient myth. Laura only wanted a steady consulting fee to restore her fallen noble house. Instead, she is stuck running a twenty-four-hour babysitting service for three universe-bending bachelors who all decide she is their ultimate sanctuary.

title: Apotheosis in Nine Acts: How I End Up Saving the World
synopsis:
Welcome to the Era of Calamity! Humanity: Screwed. Malefics: Thriving. The Chosen One: …Wait, this guy? Good luck, world. You'll need it.
[This series contains depictions of disturbing imagery that my not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.]

title: The Remarried Empress: Spin-off
synopsis: Navier's story hasn't ended. The Remarried Empress is back with spin-off episodes!

title: I Am Your Revenge
synopsis: Ten years ago, Seulha was the popular campus "It Girl" and Doseok was the college loser-- until she accidentally ruined his life. Today, their roles are completely inverted: Seulha is an exhausted workplace loner, and Doseok has returned as her gorgeous, unstoppable team leader. Doseok is back with one goal: to complete some unfinished business. Can Seulha survive his cold authority, or will her past finally catch up to her?

title: My Butler Is a Mafioso
synopsis: How far would you trust a dangerous man to protect everything you love? Princess Marina is desperate to save Scylla, her frozen kingdom that is on the brink of ruin, even if it means accepting a marriage she never wanted. Then a group of mafia from another world suddenly appears, armed with strange weapons and motives she can’t fully read. Among them is Heart, a ruthless man who becomes her unlikely butler and closest ally. But the more Marina relies on him to save Scylla, the harder it becomes to ignore the feelings growing between them.

title: Richer with Every Click
synopsis: Jinho Jeong is unemployed and despondent about it when his guildmaster unexpectedly offers him a job at his brokerage firm, citing his skill at matters of chance. He may have been an MMO player for most of his twenties, but Jinho’s about to discover a new side of his talent – one that might just make him filthy rich.

title: The Corruption-Immune Hunter
synopsis: Ten years after mysterious gates connected Earth to a monster-filled world, people are signing up to become Hunters that protect humanity, but not Gaon Yun. He just wanted to open a savings account, but after forging an accidental contract with a possessed sword, he discovers he is uniquely immune to corruption. Rather than destroy him, the Hunters Bureau turns him into a living containment vault for relics that would consume anyone else.

title: Turns Out I’m a Billionaire’s Heir
synopsis:
“It turns out I wasn’t supposed to be poor after all.”
The life I was supposed to be living was that of a third-generation chaebol heir, but it was stolen from me at a young age! Just as I was about to give up in despair… The annoying spirit of my ancestor sent me back in time to before I was robbed of my life as an heir.
This time, things will be different. This is the story of a chaebol heir reclaiming his rightful place and taking on the challenge of managing his family's business!

title: My Twin Stole My Husband
synopsis:
Marianne’s husband loved her twin sister, Gloria, more than he loved her. She discovers that the two have been having an affair in her own home. Furious, she throws Gloria out and decides to divorce her husband.
But the next day, everyone suddenly believes that Marianne is Gloria, the mad widow who stole her sister’s husband. Her husband has taken away her name, her identity, and her place as his wife.
Then, Gloria’s husband, who was believed to be dead, suddenly returns.
What will Marianne do now that her life has been stolen from her?

title: Tidal Warning
synopsis: Danbi Lee’s fortune app warns her to brace for a tidal wave. She just doesn’t expect it to show up in a tailored suit. Haeil Han, her high school first love, is back after ten years. Now he’s a Silicon Valley success, heir to the company she works for, and, worst of all, her new boss. Danbi wants to keep her head down, her job intact, and the past where it belongs. Haeil didn’t come back to play it safe. He came back for her.

title: Playboy Helper
synopsis: Dean, a notorious playboy at the architecture school, is used to having girls throw themselves at him. So when gorgeous, seriously sexy Fufong starts making moves on him, he doesn’t think much of it at first. But there’s something about her that feels... different. He can’t quite put his finger on what it is, but if she wants to get up close and personal, who is he to say no?

title: We’re NOT A Couple!
synopsis: Picture-perfect high school sweethearts Na-eun Gwon and Seon-ho Ji split up on graduation day -- leaving Na-eun puzzled and heartbroken. Five years later, Seon-ho is an A-list superstar, while Na-eun is a struggling actress desperate for her big break. When Na-eun lands a lead role in a high-profile romantic comedy alongside her ex, she proposes a high-stakes bet: whoever falls in love first buys the other a house! As real-life feelings blur with their on-screen romance, can Na-eun keep her cool on set?

title: The Former Supreme
synopsis:
Once the strongest martial artist in the world, Socheon Baek sacrificed everything to defeat the ultimate villain. His reward? A shattered dantian, zero power, and a brutal demotion to lowly office worker in a remote regional branch.
But don't count this former supreme master out just yet. Starting from rock bottom to rebuild his shattered core, Socheon proves his spirit is unbroken. Armed with unmatched battle instincts, he’s ready to smash through red tape, expose deadly martial conspiracies, and reclaim his lost glory!

title: The Unstoppable
synopsis: Lance Darner reborn 20 years ago, a few hours before the Apocalypse, and he can finally make up for something he's regretted for 20 years... He uses the knowledge he learned in his previous life to arm himself in this life and constantly improve his strength. He can only survive in the last days, is a world hero in this life...

title: Wonder Land
synopsis: “Here, fantasy becomes reality—if you can survive.” While searching for his missing daughter, a man arrives at a bizarre amusement park, where a monster in a teddy bear costume tells him he must survive the park’s deadly games if he wants to find her. Forty other participants have been drawn there by promises of money, fame, and their deepest desires—but who will survive long enough to claim what they came for?

title: The Greatest Mercenary’s Dungeon Tactics
synopsis: Ryuji Hasumi, a soldier deployed overseas, finds himself transported to a world of dungeons, monsters, and magic. Unfamiliar with these tropes, Ryuji nevertheless helps a group of adventurers, using items to summon any weapon he's used before. Faria Mirabel, an adventurer he saved, takes him to the dungeon city Rhedom to help him fulfill the goal given to him: clear the 10 mythical-rank dungeons to return home. Faria accompanies him into a legendary-rank dungeon to find a key he needs, where they find a mysterious squad of unauthorized adventurers hired by the king. Will Ryuji make it back home?

title: The Human Table
synopsis:
Yunho Jeong is working at his father’s company when he gets called in for a job aboard the Leviathan, an ultra-large, offshore nuclear plant vessel built by Chronos Global Energy Solutions, a corporation that spearheads human advancements in technology. Little does he realize that Chronos isn’t what it seems, and that it has been conducting temporal wormhole tests at this facility. While he and his father’s team are on the ship, an explosion goes off at the plant, and as the ship’s hull begins to break, Yunho finds himself facing ruthless biomachines that kill on sight. All he has to go on is a mysterious voice on the radio of a person supposedly from the future… Will he survive?

[This series contains mature content and disturbing imagery that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.]

title: Betrothed to the Assassin Prince
synopsis: Iliya, once neglected in a past life, is now the happy daughter of a poor but caring duke. Eager to be of help to her family, she accepts an engagement to Crown Prince Loren, but he turns out to be gloomy and asocial. The king reveals that Loren was kidnapped as a child and forced to be an assassin, and Iliya was chosen as his fiancée due to her reputation for giving advice to others. Loren seems closed off, but Iliya can tell there's good in him. Will she be able to win him over with her cheer and determination?

title: The Zero-Mana Genius Assassin
synopsis: Born without magic, Gerudi assassin Ban Kruger trusted a prince who promised equality, only to see that prince become king, slaughter Ban’s people, and take his life. Returned to his fifteenth birthday with every skill and memory intact, Ban enters the royal academy to secure the power to protect his family and change the kingdom. But prejudice, his future betrayer, and a rigged entrance exam soon turn his second chance into another fight for survival.

title: The Loser Becomes the First Spouse
synopsis: Hyeonu Gwak and Jaeryeong Jo are members of the National Assembly of South Korea with strong careers ahead of them. They are members of opposing parties and talk each other down in public debates, but at home, they’re a married couple with a lovely seven-year-old daughter! Things get hectic when it turns out that their respective parties have chosen them as presidential candidates. Can they navigate the challenges that lie ahead both in their careers and at home as they run as rivals in a presidential race, and political schemes begin to cloud the horizon?

title: Formula for Romance
synopsis: Soyeon ranks top of the liberal arts track at her school and is at war with a single, agonizing flaw that is Junsu, the STEM prodigy, and his effortless streak of top scores. Desperate to break him, she crosses enemy lines to unravel him. But as academic rivalry blurs into unpredictable chemistry, Soyeon discovers that the hardest formulas in life are the ones involving the heart.

title: Professional Bridesmaid
synopsis: Once inseparable best friends, Neen shattered Chaya’s trust by stealing both her dream and her boyfriend, Aek. Ten years later, Chaya is now a successful wedding planner, only to have Neen return with Aek and hire her to plan their lavish wedding. Chaya accepts with a smile, secretly plotting revenge, while Pao, her longtime business partner who has always loved her, watches with concern. As the wedding turns into a battlefield of pride and betrayal, who will truly come out on top?

title: Apocalypse Online
synopsis: Humanity faces total annihilation when portals unleash hordes of game monsters onto Earth. High-ranking player Gu Qingshan sacrifices his life in a final attempt to drag the Demon Lord down with him. But instead of dying, he suddenly awakens ten years in the past before the world collapsed. Armed with future knowledge and a unique system that lets him absorb skills from weapons he touches, Gu Qingshan vows to alter humanity's grim fate and rewrite the apocalypse.

title: Title Unlocked: This Life, I Dominate the Game
synopsis:
Bullied, humiliated, and ultimately left to die at the bottom of a river, Colin thought his life was over—until he wakes up on the very day Fantasy Legend first launched.
Armed with memories of his past life and a god-tier title, [The Returner], which allows his equipment and skills to grow exponentially stronger, Colin finally has the power to rewrite his fate.
This time, he'll conquer every Hell-level dungeon, dominate the rankings, protect the woman he once failed to save, and take revenge on everyone who trampled over him.
But as mysterious rewards and secrets of the ancient gods begin to emerge, Colin realizes his return may not have been a coincidence. Behind [The Returner] lies a mission that could change the fate of the entire world.
In this life, Colin won't follow anyone's footsteps. Whether his enemy is a god, fate itself, or the entire world—he'll rise above them all.

title: Doomsday: Virus Monarch
synopsis: This series contains mature content that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.When the apocalypse descends, the world transforms into a brutal game of evolution—humanity's final trial, and the favorite playground of gods and demons. Brian Carter time-travels back to ten days before it all begins. Armed with foreknowledge and no time to waste, he injects himself with the zombie virus and awakens a legendary SSS ability: Virus Monarch! Now, with the power to command infection itself, Brian forges a terrifying new path through the chaos, one where he doesn't just survive the end of the world, but rules it!

title: Serim's Golden Rule
synopsis: Everyone's terrified of Serim Han. Word is, she's a gangster. So of course Seung-u Kang, the ultimate golden boy, ends up with her in the school’s mentor-mentee program. He decides the only way forward is to become her friend, but the closer he gets, the less anything makes sense about her. What starts as a simple assignment soon turns into something neither of them planned, a dangerous romance between a girl who lives like there's no tomorrow and a boy whose entire life has been meticulously mapped out.

title: The World Is a Game
synopsis: Jinu used to make video games. Now he's spent a century in another world, where the mysterious Blight is slowly swallowing it whole. Jinu comes up with a desperate plan: turn the dying world into a video game. To people on Earth, Arsilan Saga is the most realistic VR MMORPG ever made. But the monsters are real, the NPCs are real, and the apocalypse is coming. Can Jinu convince Earth's gamers to save a world they think is fantasy?

title: Heavenly Exorcism
synopsis: When Taeung’s shaman father vanishes, an ancient calamity breaks free from its sealed jar—and Taeung is forced to jump off a roof to avoid a horrifying fate. But death is just the beginning. Now a ghost, Taeung discovers his body has been possessed by Chachaung, the legendary Shaman King of ancient Silla. As supernatural threats close in, Taeung learns that his father belonged to Ryeong, a secret corporation of exorcists. To find his father, Taeung must join Ryeong and enter the hidden world of the occult… where menacing myths and lethal legends lurk behind every corner.

title: Turning Point
synopsis:
Sarang Baek has always been happiest alone.
Pyeonghwa Yu has always been happiest with others, even when it means putting himself at risk of heartbreak.
When these two total opposites meet, they begin to change the way they see life, love, and themselves.
Follow Sarang and Pyeonghwa for a romance that's surprisingly grown-up, surprisingly childish, and, at times, a little too real.

title: I Awaken as a World-Ending Behemoth
synopsis:
Bustling cities and peaceful societies crumbled in an instant when the apocalypse erupted. A tide of contaminated monsters engulfed the globe as forbidden zones descended, linking worlds of sheer ruin and drowning billions in a sea of blood.
In humanity's darkest hour, Chen Chu emerges from the shadows—having quietly cultivated power rivaling that of gods and demons. And towering behind him stands a ten-thousand-meter-tall behemoth: reminiscent of Godzilla, yet far more colossal, ferocious, and clad in absolute darkness.

title: A Widowed Queen's Devotion for Love
synopsis: Her husband is dead. Her crown is gone. And now, Queen Fiona stands accused of murdering the man she loved most. Driven from the palace and hunted by those who once bowed before her, Fiona finds refuge with the Duke of Windsor, her late husband’s closest friend. But as doubts surrounding King Cecil’s death begin to surface, Fiona realizes there may be far more behind his final days than anyone knows. With everything taken from her, Fiona’s fight to survive, uncover the truth, and protect what she still loves has only begun.

title: Farewell My Love
synopsis: In a kingdom where witches are burned at the stake, Alice Liberance has spent her life fearing the day her family might be condemned. Just before her wedding to Oscar, her worst nightmare comes true when she awakens as a witch. She flees and hides, then gives birth to their son, Noah, while Oscar believes she’s dead. Years later, they are finally reunited, but Alice fears that her curse will put the family she loves in danger. Will they ever be able to live out the future they dream of, or will they have to say farewell forever?

title: Forbidden Games with My Wife
synopsis: The man who saved me from the edge of despair, Do-Geon Beom. Unlike back then when he rejected my confession, calling me a little lady who needed to be protected... this man is way too good at playing the husband. By day he's the reliable protector of the world, but by night he becomes obsessed like a beast and won't let me go...

title: The Cursed Beauty
synopsis:
How far would you go to take back everything your beauty once gave you?
After a mysterious illness steals Princess Seraphine’s beauty, crown, and future, her sister Lucia takes her place. When Seraphine discovers that her sister may be behind it all, she sells her soul to the Demon Abaddon and returns as the beautiful Muse. With only one year left, she vows to take everything from Lucia, starting with her fiancé.

title: A Cat Amongst Wolves?
synopsis: Young, orphaned Kittea is determined to find a place for herself in the territory of the wolf beastfolk, and will stop at nothing to get there…. even if she has to disguise herself as one of them to survive. But can a cat like herself survive pack life in the heart of wolf territory?

title: Warrior of the Soulblade
synopsis:
In a world where your weapon is a literal mirror of your soul, your strength is determined by the depth and sincerity of your beliefs. Only a select few are able to summon swords of their soul, and those who can, are deemed “Warriors.”
Meet Allen, a kind-hearted warrior-wannabe who refuses to let a cruel world change him. While others seek power out of pure greed, Allen’s heart of pure gold drives him to protect everyone with the unstoppable Sword of Purity.
But the road to becoming a hero is rigged. The official qualification exams are strictly controlled by the realm’s apex executioners, the 10 swords of the king… who don’t seem too benevolent either. Can this boy who refuses to harm innocents grow strong enough to stay true to his path?

title: Wild West Murim
synopsis: The tyranny of the Empire has lasted a thousand years, and true martial arts is but a thing of the past. However, there are still heroes in the most unlikely of places— amongst the motley band of soldiers and outlaws who left the old continent for the New World. One such vigilante, the lone wanderer Janggeon, has the hope of restoring martial arts to its former glory… but is that such an easy thing as it seems?

title: Forced to Be the Heavenly Demon
synopsis: Jihun Seo is a civil servant who wants nothing more than a peaceful, easy life. But after an angry complainant stabs him, he wakes up in the Murim, a world ruled by martial arts. Reborn as Ilmok, he quickly settles into a quiet job at a local inn, only for the Heavenly Demon to appear and force him to become his disciple. Now surrounded by deadly martial artists and even deadlier training, can Ilmok survive the Demonic Cult without sacrificing the one thing he values most: a healthy work-life balance?

title: The Day of Kidnapping
synopsis:
Hae-eun has spent her life surviving one tragedy after another. Adopted into a wealthy family, she soon discovers that her new home hides a dark secret—she is being used for mysterious experiments. After illness, abandonment, and a desperate escape, she is forced to start her life over once again.

Years later, fate brings her back to Myung-joon, her first love. But when she makes another wrong choice and Myung-joon agrees to fulfill her request, they end up kidnapping Ro-hee, a brilliant young genius, dangerously entangling all three of their lives. As the three confront secrets from the past and an inevitable tragedy, they must make impossible choices to survive.

Can Hae-eun break free from the fate that has followed her, or will the truth destroy them all?

[This series contains mature content and sensitive themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.]

title: The Kiss of a Blade
synopsis: Famed warrior Arne Brynhilt, known firebrand and unchallenged hero of the Eastern Empire, finds herself unexpectedly married to a foreign Archduke who knows nothing of her identity and seems to have gotten the entirely wrong idea about her, to boot. Arne isn’t quite sure how she ended up playing along with this ruse, but she can always just kill him if things go wrong, right? Just why is that condescending man so handsome, anyway…?

title: Siru / 24 / 1 mi
synopsis: Siru spent two years as a recluse, until she impulsively got plastic surgery one day. Now, going on a dating app to meet random men has become her daily routine, which is a way to fill her void of loneliness and boost her confidence. Who will she meet this time? And will they cross paths again?

title: The Heavenly Demon's Live Stream
synopsis: The Heavenly Demon, head of the Demonic Cult, is the most powerful martial artist in the gangho. But one day, a mysterious force suddenly traps him on an uninhabited island crawling with demonic beasts! There, he finds a room packed with streaming equipment, and realizes that not only has much changed in the outside world, but he and his cult were declared dead long ago. His only lead for getting off the island and reclaiming his former glory is a modern streaming platform called Kwitch. His first move? Rejuvenate himself into a youthful body, transform into a cute girl streamer, and start gathering followers!

title: Murim Psychopath
synopsis: The predator of predators has awakened! In life, Bongsu was a serial killer who exclusively hunted murderers and violent criminals. After being gunned down by the police, his dying wish comes true: rebirth inside his favorite game, the brutally graphic world of Murim Online. Armed with a status window only he can see, Bongsu discovers that every kill earns him experience points—and the stronger the prey, the greater the reward. In a world overflowing with ruthless, corrupt martial artists, Bongsu has found the perfect hunting ground. His bloody journey toward the top begins.

title: NUNA CLUB
synopsis: Three 27-year-old best friends find themselves facing the ultimate plot twist: they've all suddenly fallen for younger men! Banding together to navigate the uncharted waters of age-gap dating, they officially form the "Older Women's Club." This is their deeply personal, yet hilariously relatable, tale of modern romance.

title: Our Ancestors Are Watching
synopsis: Dawon is your average college freshman-- except that she can see ghosts. All she wants is a normal life, and maybe a little spice of love. But when she runs into the all-too-handsome Daham, president of the occult club, her life turns upside down. From fortune-telling to investigating urban legends, Dawon can't shake the feeling that there's more to Daham than he's letting on. Is this destiny or something far more sinister?

title: Waiting in the Wheat Field
synopsis:
He had fled from his marriage of convenience on their wedding night. For ten years, he lived under a new name, leaving his old life behind. But when news of his father’s death brought him home, he found someone he never expected to see again.
His wife.
The woman he had met only once, ten years ago. The woman he had assumed would have long since left. Yet she was still there, waiting for him. And she was just as beautiful as he remembered.

title: I Married the Dragon I Killed
synopsis:
Cast out by his family for refusing a betrothal to the dreaded Red Dragon Valdrova, Ferda Rosnova chooses a path of blood and vengeance. After claiming Valdrova’s heart—a heart she surrendered without resistance—Ferda ascends to godlike status. However, a glimpse into the depth of the dragon’s ancient despair renders his triumph hollow and reveals the utter emptiness of his ambition.
Armed with his new power, Ferda turns back time to start over. This time, he won't run; he decides to embrace his fate and marry the dragon who willingly gave him her heart.

title: Your Closet Monster
synopsis:
While everyone else was reincarnating as beautiful women and adorable animals, she somehow ended up as a gloomy monster living in the male lead’s wardrobe.
Worse, she was supposed to be the very monster that tormented him.
According to the original story, he should’ve been terrified of her. But instead, he told her that her horns were beautiful, gave her a name, and even asked her to stay with him at night.
To him, she was no longer just a monster.
She was his monster.

title: The White Tiger Clan’s Little Fluff
synopsis: Soya was the Phoenix clan's treasured youngest daughter. At least, she was until her ninth birthday, when she shifted for the first time and turned into a baby bird with soft white down instead of crimson. She became the family's disgrace overnight, and when the clan's true daughter came home at last, they threw Soya out to die. One fateful night, Soya was moments from death when Sa-eon Baek, head of the White Tiger clan, steals her away. All Soya wants now is to stay quiet and go unnoticed in her new home, but unfortunately, her new family seems to have other plans.

title: I Came From the Abyss
synopsis: Dylan Zhou was a genius until a magic beast tore through his heart at thirteen, sealing his talent and leaving him unable to walk. At sixteen, the seal breaks, and he awakens a Black-rank class: Lord of the Abyss. Now Dylan must survive a brutal ranking system, where bullies like Drake Fang crush the weak and the awakening lair tests every student. Can he master the abyss inside him, climb the ranks, and reach the Divine Domain to find his father?

title: Devils' Crest
synopsis: When sixth-grader Yu-uma Ashihara and his classmates log into the VRMMORPG Actual Magic, reality and the virtual world violently merge into a terrifying new landscape. Trapped in chaos, Yu-uma is suddenly confronted by his classmate, Seumika Watamaki, only to find that she’s twisted into some sort of bloodthirsty monster. Will Yu-uma survive this horrifying new world, or will he fall victim to the Crest?

title: Too Close for Comfort
synopsis: Brilliant, blunt, and determined to keep everyone at a distance, Irene Rios is a medical prodigy with an intense fear of being touched. Diego Cassis, the charming Grand Duke of Divoa, has long since grown bored with the world around him. But when he meets Irene, a woman utterly unimpressed by his title or charms, his interest is finally piqued. He needs her skills. She wants him to leave her alone. But as fascination draws these opposites closer, they may find themselves changing each other in ways neither expected.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
synopsis:
When you live by the way of the sword, there’s only room for one at the top.

Sasaki Ganryu has one goal: to become the strongest swordsman in the world. When a duel with the wandering samurai Miyamoto Musashi ends in humiliating defeat, Ganryu is consumed by rage. What follows is a bloody quest to reclaim his honor that leads him down a path of madness and obsession. 

On his journey, he receives a mysterious artifact known as “The Oni Gauntlet”, that gives him a power no mortal blade could ever match. Hunting down ever-stronger foes has set him on a collision course to face off again against the only man who has ever bested him in battle. 

A prologue to the latest game in Capcom’s iconic samurai action series: Onimusha: Way of the Sword.

title: Goth Boy and the Jock
synopsis: When a smug goth takes an interest in a no-nonsense jock, teasing turns into tension and tension turns into something more.

title: Eternal Loop: A Thousand-Year Grind
synopsis:
This series contains mature content that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
Ryan Whitman is stuck in an endless time loop, reliving the same day over and over again—July 7th, 2020. No matter what he does, the clock resets. Over a thousand years, he's mastered hundreds of languages and every instrument imaginable, and perfected skills in fighting, driving, shooting, cooking, dancing, acting...and more. But on this very day, something changes. July 8th, 2020 finally arrives...

title: Supreme Zerg Lord: The Catastrophe
synopsis: 300 years ago, rifts containing monsters appeared all over the world. Class changers, who consisted of combat, support, and life-type awakened people, fought against the monsters and protected the people. Out of the four grades of class changers, divine is the rarest, appearing once in a century, which is why all eyes were on Chen Jiang, the first divine class changer in a century. However, expectations were turned into disappointment when he awakened into the most unpopular type, the life type. However, for some reason, Chen Jiang seems quite content with what happened...

title: The Hellish Hoarder
synopsis: When Lin Yu awakens the "Hellish Hoarder" system, he thinks he's struck gold until he realizes his daily fortune comes in the form of useless ghost money called Grim Gold. Years pass, and Lin has stacks of gold with nowhere to spend it.Then a terrifying horror game called "Dread Dive" invades reality, trapping players in a nightmarish world where spirits reign supreme. While everyone else desperately scrambles to survive, Lin discovers his worthless gold is now the ultimate currency. Time to buy his way to the top and show these ghosts who the real boss is.

title: The Hunger and the Dusk
synopsis:
WAR BUILT THIS WORLD. LOVE MAY SAVE IT. Gasping its final breaths, only two people remain: humans and orcs.
From Hugo and World Fantasy Award–winning writer G. Willow Wilson and artist Chris Wildgoose comes a sweeping fantasy epic where sworn enemies must stand together—or fall forever.

title: Trapped Together
synopsis: Ever since high school, Seonyul has been plagued by a bizarre jinx that always leaves her trapped with Ro-un, a taciturn but hardworking student she can never seem to escape. Even attending different college departments doesn’t break the strange cycle. But when Seonyul discovers Ro-un’s hidden struggle, their unlikely bond begins to deepen. Is their jinx simply bad luck, or is fate trying to bring them together?

title: Legend of Dangun
synopsis:
Back when tigers still smoked, a bear crawled into a cave and crawled out a woman, becoming the mother of the great ancestor known as Dangun. That is the story everyone knows, but no one remembers the others who left the cave too soon and scattered into the world, learning to hide their fangs behind human smiles.
Seventeen-year-old Narae Lee is about to meet the animals that walk among us, quietly waging war on the spirits and creatures that everyone else believes were only myths.

title: The Warrior's Ballad
synopsis: Only the purest of souls may shine as a star, the brightest of which is inevitably the most destructive of them all. The demon and the hero are but two sides of the same blade. A hundred years after his death, the fallen swordmaster of the empire returns as young Ricardt and sets out on a journey to uncover the truth behind the war that consumed his first life.

title: Demon Breaker: The King's Demon Hunters
synopsis: In 2026, humans and supernatural beings share the streets of Joseon under an uneasy truce... until it's shattered overnight. With monsters rampaging, conspirators moving in the shadows, and the throne's future hanging by a thread, the king turns to two men no reasonable ruler should trust. Now Joseon's most unpredictable new agents must hunt down a power everyone is willing to kill for, before the kingdom tears itself apart.

title: My Secretary Wants to Kill Me!
synopsis: Lawrence Gu reads minds. It helped him ace every test and land the president's seat. Then he interviewed Ron Lee, a gloomy applicant whose thoughts screamed: "I'll kill you!" So Lawrence made him his secretary. What else could he do? Let a potential criminal walk out the door? But here's the real question: is Lawrence trying to save Ron or falling for the one person who wants him dead?

title: How to Ruin a Crush
synopsis:
“Please let this crush crash and burn!”
A romance story with a female lead who doesn’t want her unrequited love to come true?! Chohui is on a mission to sabotage her own unrequited love. But when Shiho discovers her secret, he blackmails her into making a deal with him. As if that weren't enough, Itae uncovers Shiho's own unrequited love, turning everything into a tangled mess. Welcome to the story of a chaotic love triangle, where three people do everything they can to ruin each other's unrequited love!

title: Shutter Flutters
synopsis:
“What was going through your mind?”
Yerim Han was an ordinary student who loved filming until one day, she started hearing the thoughts of anyone captured in a photo or video. However, this ability brings her nothing but torment as she attempts to navigate her film and video production program without being overwhelmed by everyone’s thoughts. Soon after, Yerim meets Jinho Cha, a performing arts student who confides in her about his own ability. As the two work together to overcome their shared aversion to being in front of and behind the camera, they find themselves falling for each other.

title: First Affection
synopsis:
The series contains themes regarding domestic abuse that may be upsetting to some readers.
Apathetic chaebol heir Taeseo Gwon drifts aimlessly through life until a scandal sees him banished to Seongu Village—a backwater town so isolated it lacks even a cafe. There, he meets Yuna An, a resilient convenience store worker enduring a harsh home life. Much to his surprise, her warmth breaks through his cynical exterior and ignites a deep bond between them.
Over four years, Yuna defies all odds to become a rising star. But when Taeseo’s older brother pressures her to walk away, Yuna makes a devastating choice to disappear, leaving Taeseo in utter shock.

title: EX
synopsis: After a long and exhausting job hunt, Abila Ruby finally lands a job as a Project Coordinator at a promising company! Her new life seems perfect… until she meets her new manager, Krisna Aditya. Young, successful, charming, and apparently everyone’s favorite boss. There’s just one tiny problem. HE’S HER EX!

title: How to Love a Cursed Girl
synopsis:
Do-ae Ma carries a cruel curse. Anyone who loves her, or whom she loves, falls into misfortune. There's only one way to break this curse. She must find her true soulmate, the one who is immune to this curse.
But there’s just one problem. Of all people, the only candidate who fits the bill is a good-for-nothing troublemaker named Seon-hwa Gong. 
Do-ae has no choice but to get involved with the worst possible man in order to end her curse. But will she be able to find her true love this time?

title: Knee Pads
synopsis:
College senior Wren Wu has never been a team player. So, when her brother gets checked into a rehab clinic across the country, and her family makes her move with them, her world is pulled off its axis.

Her solitude is challenged further when she joins the school roller derby team. It’s probably a mistake. As a former figure skater, derby is far from the skating she’s used to. It’s rough, dirty and she bruises easily.

But perhaps her biggest challenge is the elusive and infuriating team captain: Corinne Fontaine.

title: I Won’t Let My Son Become the Evil Male Lead!
synopsis: After waking up as the cruel mother in one of her favorite dark fantasy books, Seriel Roperam makes it her mission to steer her adorable son, Kardiciel, away from his future as the story's twisted male lead. However, her prior cold actions have left Kardiciel and her husband, Erykian, wary of her. After an initial awkward phase where neither of them believed her, the three of them slowly learn to rely on and trust one another. Will this once-dysfunctional family finally find their happy ending, or have Seriel's past actions left wounds too deep to heal?

title: My Perfect Senior's Secret
synopsis: Taehyeok is the perfect upperclassman: kind to everyone, effortlessly charming, and at the top of his department. But beneath that flawless golden-boy image hides a wildly unhinged side no one is supposed to see. The only person who knows his true self is his underclassman, Moeum, and the more she sees through his perfect mask, the more obsessed he becomes with her. As their strange connection continues, the two students who seem completely opposite begin a campus life that is anything but ordinary.

title: Demon Devourer
synopsis: Weak. Frail. Powerless. That is all Guyeong Oh has ever been, until the legendary Demon Devourer chooses him as its successor. When the Hell Demon opens the Gates of Hell and unleashes monsters upon the human world, Guyeong is thrust into a war he never asked to fight. His only chance to stop the invasion is to devour every demon in his path, growing stronger with each one he consumes. Fortunately for Guyeong, nothing tastes better than monsters fresh from Hell.

title: The Ordinary Jackpot
synopsis: After years of hard work, Euntae Gong becomes the youngest team leader at Hongseong International, a major luxury brand licensing company. Instead of the success he envisioned, he’s bombarded by office politics and constant pressure. When he unexpectedly wins 1.8 billion won in the lottery, he believes he’s finally found an escape, but family troubles and a brand new outlook on life lead him back to the office where he and his unlikely team of underdogs battle the odds to succeed.

title: The Tricky Double Life of a Demon Commander
synopsis: Deon Hart has one goal: quit his job. Unfortunately, his employer is the Demon King. Revered throughout demonkind as the legendary commander Damon Arte, Deon is feared as a ruthless military genius capable of impossible feats. In reality, he's an anxious human whose greatest skills are coughing up blood and accidentally making himself look far more competent than he actually is. Caught between the Empire that’s growing suspicious of him and a Demon King who puts entirely too much trust in him, Deon must hide the fact that he’s not, in fact, that kind of talent.

title: How to Survive as a Wandering Knight
synopsis: Yohan died broke in modern Korea and woke up broke again -- now the lowest-ranked son of a noble house in a savage medieval world. Armed with superhuman strength and modern know-how, he chases the money that buys his way out -- but every scheme turns into heroism. Can a man who only wants gold survive an imperial enforcer razing noble houses across the realm, or become another body in the bloodshed?

title: Marriage Contract
synopsis: Prince Kahlid must save his nation from the drought, and marriage seems like the easy way out, but – is it, really? Is he willing to travel far and wide? Of course. Competing against another prince for the heart of a princess? In a heartbeat. Marrying his competition instead of the princess? I guess we’ll find out how fine the print in the marriage contract really is.

title: Rakshasa: Demon Rising
synopsis:
A feared gangster. A forgotten past. A contract with a monster from Hell. When Dojin Hong's girlfriend is kidnapped, he awakens the power of Rakshasa and is thrust into a hidden world of Contractors, Exorcists, and deadly supernatural creatures. To save her, he'll have to become the very monster he's been trying to leave behind.
[This series contains mature themes such as graphic imagery and human trafficking that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.]

title: Full-time Sword Cultivator
synopsis: In an era where reality and a game had become one, Lin Jichen, the greatest mage in Eternia, was stabbed in the back and killed by the people he trusted the most—his lover and the man he considered his brother. Yet destiny had other plans for him. He regressed to the day before Eternia’s launch and gave up the staff for a sword! Join him on a journey to rewrite the future with the blade of a sword!

title: How I Became the Duke's Beloved Daughter
synopsis:
Orphan Alvi possesses a mysterious power to dispel misfortune, but she was cast aside by her adoptive family once she was no longer useful. Yet, a twist of fate reveals her true identity as the long-lost daughter of a ducal family. Rescued by a mysterious man and reunited with her true family, Alvi is now showered with love by her father and brother, ready to face her new challenges and claim the life she deserves.
[This series contains mature themes including child abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.]

title: Lord of Fate: When Mutation Strikes
synopsis: A planet known as the Phantom Star suddenly appears above Earth, triggering mutations that turn the planet’s plants and animals into monsters capable of wiping out humanity. As extinction looms, humans unexpectedly discover a way to enter the mysterious star during their exploration, gaining the power to fight back. Jiang Kai is no exception, but things go south fast. Trapped and facing death, he gambles everything to gain the power needed to protect his family and his world.

title: The Evil Ring
synopsis: Born in the ruthless Exile Land where his next meal was never guaranteed, Moon has always aspired to no longer be a worthless human stuck at the edges…

title: The 100,000x EXP Transcendent Hunter
synopsis: Jihan Lee is an F-rank hunter with no talent or skill, living in a world overrun by a demon invasion. And the demons are winning! Backed into a corner, humanity has no choice but to send a special hero back to the past to start over. But by a twist of fate, it’s Jihan who gets sent through the portal instead! Returning as his younger self,  Jihan discovers that he’s been granted a special leveling trait that gives him a massive head start... but he still has a long way to go. Can Jihan, the F-rank hunter,  save the human race?

title: If Obsession Runs Deeper than Blood
synopsis: Princess Juno of Berau lives happily with her father as well as her fiancé, Leif, the second prince of Elest. Leif will become the ruler of Berau once they marry, but Juno loves and trusts him. That is, until he kills her father in front of her. Betrayed and confused, Juno swears to take revenge against Leif, who suddenly seems to despise her, but still marries her for the throne. She then discovers sinister secrets as she explores the palace, which hint at a truth she was completely blind to. Does Leif actually have a good reason for his betrayal?

title: The Great Sage of 100 Magic Stones
synopsis: Talentless at combat, sixteen-year-old Tori supports his sick brother and his two younger siblings with the only thing he can: Utility Magic. He does all this while hauling gear for adventurers who despise him. Then a talking, mustachioed magic book left by the legendary Great Sage chooses him, revealing how to harvest magic stone crystals worth 100 times the norm—no killing required. With Utility Magic as his secret weapon, the guild's errand boy begins his rise. It’s time to corner the magic stone market.

title: The Corrupt Tyrant’s Obsession
synopsis:
This series contains mature themes including abuse that may not be suitable  for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
A corrupt tyrant, a loyal knight, and an allied nation’s crown prince. Latisse Eldwin, the so-called “Puppet Princess” of the Zerdian Empire, is used to being used by her father for her healing powers, her stepmother and half-siblings as a scapegoat, and the citizens as an object of scorn. But after a mysterious young man slaughters everyone in the palace, she suddenly finds herself in a position of great power… and having to choose a husband from between three men. Her decision could turn the entire world upside down… but who is the correct choice?

title: A Druid’s Healing Days
synopsis: An ancient druid awakens in the body of an office worker whose health is on the verge of collapse. Seeking a place where he can recover, Shihyeon leaves the city for a rural village filled with Nature Energy. As he tends the land, grows his own food, and cares for the animals around him, his strength slowly returns. What begins as a quiet retreat soon draws him into the lives of his neighbors, turning his search for healing into a new beginning shaped by nature, community, and the small joys of everyday life.

title: The Transfer Assassin
synopsis:
This series contains mature content and disturbing imagery that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
Killing is all Kangmin Ryu has ever known. As a member of the infamous assassin syndicate Bathala, he has never imagined life beyond the organization—until he's offered freedom in exchange for one final assignment: eliminate a target in Korea. There’s just one problem…  how do you kill a target without a face?

title: Unofficial Campus Couple
synopsis:
Doa Han is secretly dating Seong-u Yu, the most popular guy on campus. To the outside world, they’re just acquaintances, but behind closed doors, they’re in a relationship. However, the illusion of a perfect romance is shattered when Doa suspects Seong-u is harboring a dark secret.
Enter Eunho Yeon. He’s a mysterious student who seems to know something about Seong-u. As Doa becomes increasingly entangled with Eunho, her unofficial relationship is pushed to the absolute brink. On a campus fueled by twisted desires and shifting loyalties, how far will Doa go to uncover the truth?

title: Green Skin
synopsis:
Ten years after arriving at a fantasy world, Taeseong loses everything to the betrayal of a fellow human. Reincarnated as a goblin named Gorulz, he is given a chance to seek revenge. Leveling up, gaining the trust and adoration of other goblins, becoming the leader of his own clan, they all serve a single goal: to slaughter the humans he has come to despise.
[This series contains mature content and disturbing imagery that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.]

title: Mu Mu Mu
synopsis: Every 10,000 years, a Heavenly Demon--a legendary master of the Demonic Cult--is born. But the modern era has two geniuses: Hoya, a boy with a burning interest in martial arts but no inner power, and Soma, the disciple of the Mad Demon who wiped out the Murim Alliance in a single day. When fate brings them together, Hoya decides to learn everything he can from Soma, but Soma only wants Hoya’s help in figuring out the password to his master’s well-stocked bank account. Who will claim the title of Heavenly Demon, and will they remain friends or become rivals?

title: Gotham By Daylight
authors: Mike Birchall,Jeannine A. Halley,Ekass,Paula Fidelis,FELICO STUDIO,Pinga,RoiVal,WmW
synopsis: From the creator of 'Everything is Fine,' this chilling tale uncovers something terrible lurking in Gotham's light. The days are getting longer, and the people are acting strange. At the center of it all is Gotham's daylight protector, Duke Thomas. With a group of ordinary citizens, he will face his greatest challenge yet as his friends are targeted one by one and pushed to their breaking points. There is no night, and without night, no darkness. And without darkness, there can be no Batman.

title: Revenge with My New Husband
synopsis: Isu is betrayed, robbed of everything, and finally murdered by her husband Taegang, who was having an affair with her own stepmother. But when Isu opens her eyes again, she finds herself on her wedding day, seven years in the past. This time, she refuses to be anyone’s victim. Determined to take revenge, she joins hands with Jeonghyeok, a man who offers a contract marriage as the price for playing the role of her ex-boyfriend. As Isu’s revenge and hidden pasts unfold, will they be able to keep their calculated relationship as nothing more than an emotionless agreement?

title: Taka
synopsis:
Join Taka, the Notorious Delinquent, as she struggles to right her wrongs after unwittingly releasing a horde of evil robots. It’s tough being a hero.

Taka is no hero. The Notorious Delinquent has a bit of a reputation in her city, but after she accidentally unleashes a horde of evil robots, she begrudgingly takes up the mantle of MECH FIGHTER!

Armed with special abilities, Taka sets out to recapture all the robots and seal them back up, playing protector to a city of people who previously couldn’t care less about her. While the popularity of the Mech Fighter grows with every adventure, Taka does her best to keep her identity a secret. Because, after all, she has a reputation to keep!

Set in a fictional world that takes inspiration from Japanese, Western, and European comics and manga, Taka follows our titular hero, Star (her best friend), Meg (the last survivor of the mythical Science-Priests), and a host of memorable villains on the adventure of a lifetime.

title: OVERGEARED
synopsis: Shin Youngwoo (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

title: The Eldest Daughter Protects the Tang Clan
synopsis:
Betrayed by her husband and forced to watch her family perish, Sohwa Tang, the brilliant Master of Poisons, exacts ruthless revenge before taking her own life.
But death isn't the end. Awakening as her 17-year-old self, she makes a fierce vow: protect the Sichuan Tang clan at any cost. She doesn’t care about righteous justice or martial world politics. Her only goal is her family's survival. Yet as she brutally eliminates future threats, the world misinterprets her ruthless pragmatism as noble acts of chivalry.
Follow Sohwa as she accidentally becomes the martial world’s greatest heroine while simply trying to keep her family alive.

title: Fight Delivery
synopsis: Sang Lee is a courier who makes deliveries for a beatdown. But when Seonha puts in an order of her own, his life takes an abrupt turn. Taking the wheel with her in shotgun, he dives into a world filled with political heavyweights, corrupt businessmen, and backdoor meetings in the underworld where power and strength mean everything. Sang knows this will be a bloody ride, but can he come out of it alive?

title: Hate Girl
synopsis:
Unrequited love is like breathing in fine dust: toxic, yet impossible to avoid. For over five years, Dahye Jung has harbored a relentless crush on her childhood best friend, Beomseok Lee. She vows to make one final, undeniable confession the moment her college entrance exams end.
But her grand romantic dream is shattered when she catches him having a secret kiss… with her own older sister!
Caught in a messy web of betrayal, petty resentment, and a chaotic four-way romance, Dahye’s lifelong crush is about to become a total disaster. After all, love hurts, but family hurts worse.

title: Father, I don't Want this Marriage
synopsis: Juvelian is a villainess so hated by everyone that even her lover and father leave her to die a pitiful death. Just as she’s about to face her fate, she gets the chance to change the course of her story. In order to avoid the tragic end she knows awaits her, she breaks up with her lover and gives up trying to win her father’s love. Instead, she focuses on using his wealth to enjoy her new life to its fullest! But while she prepares for her extravagant life as a lady, her father begins looking for her new suitor. Afraid that he’ll marry her off to the infamously unpredictable and stormy prince, she lands on a desperate solution: a dating contract. And the best candidate is none other than her father’s student. Based on the hit novel.

title: Raising a Child With a CEO
synopsis: What happens when the overlooked finally becomes important? Jisoo never expected a mischievous boy causing chaos in the office to turn her ordinary life upside down. Believing the boy to be the CEO’s son, she is surprised when she is offered a secret job to take care of him. This unexpected responsibility pulls her into the world of the CEO, a man known for his cold personality and surrounded by rumors. As hidden truths begin to surface, Jisoo must navigate unexpected challenges, growing feelings, and secrets that could change the lives of all three of them.

title: The Summoner: Apocalypse Rewinds
synopsis: The end comes when monsters from the game shatter the dimensional barrier and unleash a massacre, pushing human civilization on the Blue Star to the brink of extinction. At the very moment the world collapses, his time suddenly rewinds to the day the game first appeared. This time, he is determined to uncover the mastermind behind it all, protect his home, and prevent the tragedy from ever happening again. Thus, a deadly revenge game against time begins, where failure means the end of the world.

title: Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead
synopsis:
After being transported to another world and becoming the most powerful necromancer, Rhode unexpectedly finds himself back in his youth.
In his original world, he was the good-for-nothing young master of the Morris family—a spoiled noble in everyone’s eyes. Little does anyone know that he has brought back with him the unique necromantic magic he mastered in the other world.
As Rhode works to regain the full power he once possessed as a necromancer, he hides his true strength and begins turning the tables on those who underestimate him.
His family, loved ones, and friends... Given a second chance at life, this time he will protect everything that matters to him and completely rewrite the fate of both himself and those he holds dear!

title: Back to First Base
synopsis: Baseball gave Yeseong everything, and then took it all away. Years after injuries ended his career, he suddenly finds himself back at age 18. This means another shot at becoming the pitcher he once dreamed of being, but starting over means more than just returning to the mound. Yeseong has already lived through one career filled with regret, but reconnecting with his estranged father, a legendary MLB pitcher, this opportunity may prove to be a second chance at more than just baseball.

title: I Will Remarry the Husband I Murdered
synopsis:
Punished by the gods for having killed her husband in her previous life, Bari is unable to grow old or die. The only way to end the curse is to find her reincarnated ex-husband and remarry him. 
Upright police officer Hae-an Kang has no recollection of his past life. When Bari appears and demands they get married, Hae-an dismisses her as a stalker. But as his bad luck brings misfortune to his only remaining family, Hae-an has to reconsider his options. 
Can Bari successfully remarry her ex-husband and end their ill-fated relationship?

title: SOS! Fledgling Report
synopsis:
Cheongyeon is an academic legend with a soul of ice. To save his college applications from a failing character evaluation, he agrees to mentor Suhan, the school’s most notorious troublemaker. Suhan earns nothing but zeroes and lives with zero motivation. While Cheongyeon only wants his college recommendation, Suhan just wants to be left alone. As they clash over study habits and life choices, the top student begins to find his missing empathy and emotions in the most unexpected place.

"This series contains sensitive themes such as toxic relationships, emotional pressure and intense situations involving minors that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.”

title: Bloodbath of the Fallen: The Reborn Hero Gron
synopsis: When a mighty hero falls in the final battle with the Demon Emperor, he is reborn five years later… as a minion of the very same emperor. Though he's now among the weakest of the demon camp, the hero's soul awakens the hidden power of the ancient Serpent God in his body—and he's ready to take on the world. From revered hero to feared demon, the bloodbath he unleashes will settle this war for good.

title: Spooky in Love
synopsis: Beautiful, wealthy, and smart, Yeori Cheon is a chaebol heiress cursed with the ability to see ghosts. In order to appease the restless spirits, she secretly helps them find their missing bodies. When she meets Gang-uk Ma, a prosecutor investigating unsolved murder cases, the two join forces to solve paranormal cases. As they confront increasingly dangerous cases, an unexpected romance begins to blossom.

title: This Punk Wants Love
synopsis: Yujin was once a top student with dreams of becoming a doctor until her first love, the rebellious Junha, turned her carefully planned life upside down. After blaming him for losing her shot at medical school, she vows never to see him again. Years later, they're reunited in a college study group as she prepares for one final chance to achieve her dream. Determined to make amends, Junha refuses to leave her side, forcing Yujin to confront the boy she once loved and the man he's become. As old feelings resurface, she must decide if love deserves a second chance.

title: I Became the Tyrant of a Defense Game
synopsis:
Clearing the tower defense game was supposed to be the end, not the beginning!
No one had ever cleared Save the Empire on its most brutal difficulty setting until Retro Gamer did. But upon reaching the ending, he woke up inside the game, trapped in the body of Ash, the incompetent third prince of the empire. To make things worse, he had landed in the tutorial stage, a battle that was intentionally designed to destroy the player before the game begins.
As Ash, he must now lead his forces to survive, even if that means becoming a tyrant.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man: Big Time
synopsis: Peter Parker has finally hit the Big Time. He’s a full-fledged Avenger, he just landed a high-paying science job, and he has an amazing new girlfriend. But big-time living means big-time pressure! Will all his new commitments prove too much to handle?

title: Shadows in Paradise
synopsis:
This series contains mature themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
Louise Ideana, a survivor of the fallen Ideana family, has been living in hiding as a maid. Then one day, Shayde Lupus, the slave she once sold, appears before her as a duke. Though Louise denies knowing him, Shayde has not forgotten her. With cold fury and lingering obsession, he makes it clear that he has no intention of letting her escape him again. As the woman who lost everything and the man who rose from nothing cross paths once more, their reunion is shadowed by power, resentment, and a past neither of them can escape.

title: Taken by the Wolf Duke
synopsis: Laria Rohan spent years branded a failure because she couldn't shapeshift like everyone else. When she finally transforms into a white fox, she's captured by the feared Black Wolf shapeshifter, Zenox Crassium, who mistakes her for an ordinary fox. Unable to return to her human form, Laria spends months as his pet before escaping. Three years later, the crown arranges for Laria to meet a potential suitor, only for her to discover it's none other than Zenox himself. He doesn't recognize her... but how long can she hide the fact that she's the runaway fox he's never stopped searching for?

title: The Genius Mage is No Incompetent Wife
synopsis: Countess Yumemi was a magical prodigy destined to become the kingdom's first female Magic Knight, until the king forced her into a political marriage. Her jealous husband sealed her immense power and free will with a cursed ring, leaving her abused, broken, and treated as worthless. After a near-fatal fall erases her memories of married life, the curse is shattered. Unaware her tormentors still believe she's powerless, Yumemi reclaims her unmatched magic and begins a thrilling, ruthless revenge against everyone who stole her future.

title: Ultimates (2024)
synopsis: THE ULTIMATES RETURN TO GREATNESS! Spinning out of Jonathan Hickman and Stefano Caselli's ULTIMATE UNIVERSE #1, rising stars Deniz Camp (CHILDREN OF THE VAULT, 20th Century Men) and Juan Frigeri (INVINCIBLE IRON MAN) assemble an all-new team of ULTIMATES in a series that kicks off the next chapter of the new Ultimate line. Six months ago, Tony Stark sent Peter Parker a radioactive spider to set him back on the course to become Spider-Man. Since then, Iron Lad (Stark), Captain America, Doom, Thor and Sif have begun to do the same for other lost heroes, building a network of super-powered heroes hungry for change… Now they must band together to destroy the Maker's Council and restore freedom and free will to a world ruled from the shadows!

title: Surviving As the Butler of the Connett Estate
synopsis: After her treacherous cousin steals her title and fortune, then tries to sell her into marriage, Brienne cuts her hair and disguises herself as a boy to escape. She finds refuge at the Connett Estate—located in a domain that acts as a self-governed city immune to imperial law—working as an assistant butler to the formidable Duke Ulrich Connett. Though feared across the empire as a ruthless war monster, Brienne discovers a surprisingly warm heart underneath his cold exterior—while Ulrich finds himself captivated by his brilliant, fiercely capable new aide.

title: My Father, the Possessive Demi-God
synopsis:
This series contains mature themes and graphic imagery that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
Young Claire lives with her mother and her twin sister in a humble country home. Feeling mature for her age, Claire is tired of being different from everyone she's ever met. However, when her father suddenly appears, she realizes that she wasn't the only "strange" one in the family. As she slowly learns about her family's past, she understands more about herself and her destiny.

title: Dear My Flawless Duke
synopsis: Everyone believes Edith Reynolds is broken after her own family brands her a madwoman. They bury the truth, and her mother, beneath rumors and polite smiles. But when she’s engaged to Grayson Riley Myers, the kingdom’s perfect duke and third prince, Edith finally gains the chance she needs to take revenge. Their marriage begins as nothing more than a contract, each intending to use the other, but beneath their calculated alliance spring feelings neither of them expected. As Edith uncovers her family’s deadly schemes, can she survive their betrayal and outwit the very people who destroyed her?

title: The Prince of Poison
synopsis: Erna Hardy, the daughter of a fallen noble family, leaves her quiet hometown behind and enters Schwerin’s high society in a desperate attempt to save her family's home. But her debut takes an unexpected turn when she catches the attention of Bjorn Deneister, the kingdom's infamous prince. Handsome, brilliant, and surrounded by scandal, Bjorn is determined to put an end to the rumors linking him to his ex-wife once and for all. As Erna becomes entangled in his world of gossip, schemes, and lingering heartbreak, she begins to wonder whether the notorious prince is truly as dangerous as everyone claims.

title: Exhuma: Blind Faith
synopsis:
As a child, Hwarim accidentally unleashed an ancient serpent spirit that has hunted her ever since. Protected by her late grandmother's shamanic legacy, she spends years in hiding until the spirit possesses a classmate to track her down. Now, with an innocent life at stake and nowhere left to run, Hwarim must confront the evil that has haunted her family before she becomes its next vessel.
 "This series contains mature themes and graphic imagery that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised."

title: Mega Lover
synopsis: Background character Yoyo Yee has always helped others shine -- until her million-sub YouTuber first love, Hugh Leung, opens an audition that could finally put her in the spotlight. With sharp-tongued friend Jimmy Tang by her side, Yoyo dives into the brutal world of content creation. But between self-doubt, jealous rivals, and old feelings she can’t ignore, can she survive the competition and become the leading lady in her own story? A story about chasing impossible dreams and finding the courage to believe in yourself.

title: Loki: Agent of Asgard
synopsis: Old God - New Trickster! Kid Loki's all grown up - and the God of Mischief is stronger, smarter, sexier and just plain sneakier than ever before. As the All-Mother's personal operative, he's ready to lie, cheat, steal, bluff and kiss his way through the twistiest, turniest and most treacherous missions Asgardia can throw at him... starting with a heart-stopping heist on Avengers Tower - and the death of Thor! And that's just the beginning! Would we lie to you? This is LOKI, true believer - we're lying to you RIGHT NOW!

title: Lost Man: The Death-Defying Player
synopsis: In a world where dungeons appear and skilled players battle for glory, Yukari Kanzaki dreams of clearing the legendary Luluheart Dungeon. Branded “powerless,” he is denied even the chance to enter. But when a Dungeon Break unleashes monsters into the world, Yukari saves an injured girl—only to discover she is Luluheart, the Demon Lord herself. Granted a chance to save the world, Yukari returns six years into the past, armed with the ability to regress through death.

title: The Aces Are Obsessed With Me
synopsis: Tae-oh Choi has always believed he’s the weakest player among a team of baseball phenoms. But when he decides to quit, the team’s most talented players refuse to let him go. What do they see in him that he cannot see himself? The answer could change his entire future.

title: The Otherworldly Family Man
synopsis: Years after losing his parents, Juhwan Kim has resigned himself to a life of loneliness. But on Christmas Eve, a mysterious man dressed as Santa grants his wish for a family of his own and transports him to another world. There, he finds an unlikely home with Lizzy, a traumatized widow, and her young stepdaughter. Determined to protect the family fate has given him, Juhwan must learn how to hunt, master his newfound magical powers, and survive in a world where kindness is a rare luxury.

title: My Wife Came to Her Funeral
synopsis:
Ji-young Ha devoted her life to a marriage she believed was destined, until her husband, Se-joon Hwang, brutally attacked her and left her for dead. Saved by a mysterious doctor and given a new face and identity, she infiltrates Se-joon's team at ZKA Entertainment as a screenwriter with one goal: revenge. Se-joon’s dead wife is back, and she's ready to direct his final downfall.
[This series contains depictions of assault and disturbing language that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.]

title: 3 Years with the Grim Reaper
synopsis: Stella Crowley was meant to die. But as death beckons, a Grim Reaper named Levi appears before her. Desperate to survive, Stella bargains for three more years of life. Determined to protect her family's legacy, she sets out to find a husband before time runs out. Levi, however, keeps meddling in her affairs, and when the empire's prince takes an interest in her, her plans spiral out of control. With a meddling Grim Reaper by her side and disaster on the horizon, can Stella find her happy ending, or does fate have other plans for her?

title: How to Win Over an Alpha Male
synopsis: When a sharp-tongued ordinary office worker gets isekai’d into the dating sim he used to play, he finds himself in the body of a cute-as-a-button in-game character and even gets to meet his favorite love interest! With everything going this perfectly, of course it is time to win over the man of his dreams. Except one wrong choice lands him on the route of the terrifying company president, whose personality is somehow even worse than his scowl. Can this loudmouth troublemaker turn the grumpy chairman into the lovesick puppy the game promised?

title: Dancer on the Court
synopsis:
Middle school MVP. A spot on the U16 national team. The future was bright for Jun, until his father’s brutal crime branded him the son of a criminal.
Amid public backlash and pressure, Jun finds solace in basketball, pouring himself into the game he loves to hone his skills and escape the weight of his troubles. Now, as the captain of Yeomyeong High, he must rally his teammates to glory and carve out his own future in the world of basketball, free from the dark past that once threatened to take everything from him.

title: All Kinds of Nonsense
synopsis:
At GTR Games, the newest corporate perk is a bonus for naming your office crush, and a massive jackpot for a mutual match!
Overworked illustrator Seong-eun has zero time for or interest in love. But when she checks the system, she's shocked to find three secret admirers. One is her childhood friend, Uyeon. But who are the others? Could it be Uyeon’s fierce rival, Tae-eun, or the mysterious new hire?
Is it possible that Seong-eun’s longtime friendship with Uyeon could develop into something more? You can’t rule anything out when the stakes are this high!

title: KESTREL
synopsis:
Violette’s fate takes an unexpected turn when she discovers that her little sister has stolen her fiancé and that they are planning on getting rid of her. As the elves invade the city to enslave humankind, Violette is forced to choose between Ravel, a mysterious elf with a mischievous desire for amusement, and Vincent, a charming doctor from her past whom she seems to have forgotten… 

This series contains mature themes including abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: The Accidental Legend
synopsis: Eo Jaseo is a weak and timid swordsman--until luck and misunderstandings make him look like a formidable master. As his name spreads through the martial arts world, one question remains: how long can he survive as a legend?

title: A Sibling’s POV
synopsis: College freshman Gayeong Cha has never had a boyfriend, thanks to her overbearing older brother, Ganghyeon, who scares off every potential love interest. Desperate to win over her longtime crush, Gayeong buys a mysterious bracelet that promises to keep her brother out of her love life. She slips the bracelet onto the sleeping Ganghyeon's ankle and goes to bed happily, only to wake up in his body the next morning. Now forced to live each other's lives, the siblings’ college days quickly devolve into a disaster of misunderstandings, ruined reputations, and romantic chaos.

title: The Martial Genius Who Remembers Everything
synopsis: So-un Jin, a third-rate martial artist with an exceptional memory, awakens 30 years in the past, just before the return of the Demonic Cult. He's been given a second chance, but that's where divine intervention ends. With no innate talent for martial arts, no legendary master to guide him, and only a small, powerless sect to call home, his future seems just as bleak as before. Can So-un use his knowledge of the future to change the course of fate?

title: Reborn as a Hatchling
synopsis:
After 999 years of painful endurance, Imugi can't wait to finally become a dragon. But after his death with just one year until ascension, he wakes up to find himself reborn as a hatchling with stubby little legs and a squishable cheek to boot!
Having never known kindness, he sets out into a world filled with magic and dragons, and with the love and help from those around him, gradually opens the door to his heart.
To become a dragon, he will have to take baby steps... and make friends along the way.

title: God of Killers
synopsis: Gungnir, the most feared killer in the criminal underworld, decides to retire from his profession to keep a promise he made to the love of his life. But on the night of his final job, his partner betrays him, and he and his lover are shot. He survives by an apparent miracle, only to wake up in the body of a high school student. Determined to uncover the truth behind the betrayal, he vows that in this second life he will seize the happiness he was denied.

title: Tomb Raider King: End Line
synopsis:
The hero who saved the world and the King of all the Relics, the Majesty Jooheon Suh.

He lives a “peaceful” life exploring and raiding tombs for the sake of his future daughter until he is prompted by the Rule Book to take part in the Majesty War. Initially dismissive, Jooheon intends to ignore the Rule Book’s odd demand until his daughter’s existence is removed from this world. With the knowledge that god-rank relics are behind his daughter’s disappearance, Jooheon takes a stance against the relics and fights against the anomalies brought about by his strange encounter with the Rule Book. Even if he must face literal gods, Jooheon will stop at nothing to bring back what was his.

title: Becoming the Queen At the Age of Six
synopsis: I transmigrated into the body of a destined-to-die 'background cannon fodder' character, and my six-year-old body is facing a massive trial. But I refuse to let fate trample all over me like it did in the novel. Even if it means becoming a villainess, I am going to survive!

title: That Was My Lucky Break
synopsis: Getting cheated on while you’re planning a surprise party for your boyfriend is bad enough. Having nowhere to go afterward? Even worse. Sophie thinks she can at least stay at her brother’s apartment for a while…until she discovers he has a roommate she never knew about. Now she’s stuck sharing a home with Liam, a charming veterinarian she barely knows. What starts as a temporary solution might just become the best unexpected twist of her life.

title: Nightmare Realm Summoner
synopsis: When the system warned the world that it was coming a week in advance, Alex couldn’t have been more excited. He was ready for a new life… but he wasn’t ready for his best friend to shove him through a portal into hell the moment the apocalypse started. Alex finds himself stranded in a nightmarish world where even the bugs are stronger than he is. But not even that is enough to ruin the apocalypse he’s been waiting for. Where others see certain death, he finds something else entirely... Opportunity.

title: Road to Mastery
synopsis: When the System transforms Earth, everyone gets magic—except Jack Rust. Armed only with his fists, he must fight his way through a monster-filled dungeon to survive.

title: Instinctive Proposal
synopsis:
After a one-night mistake with my secret crush, Taehan Ki, the CEO of Taeseong Bio...
I, Yeonu Seo, found myself pregnant with his child. 
I decided to quit my job, disappear from his life, and quietly raise the baby on my own. 
But this man keeps reappearing, unsettling my resolve and stirring emotions I can't seem to let go of. 
Please just let me resign, sir.

title: RAMYUNZ Save the World!
authors: Nuria Sanguino,Jjolee,Na Yoonhee,Yun-chang Lee,Manou Azumi,Yeajin Shin,Fidesia,Grace Park,Cathy Le
synopsis:
There's a new apocalypse in town...and it's turning everything bland! Four brave (and adorable) RAMYUNZ must travel across different universes and genres, isekai-style, to find special ingredients that will restore flavor to the world. 

Will CHICHEE, DAREE, JJANEE, and MAPPEE succeed in their missions and save everyone in time?

title: Golden Time
synopsis:
This series contains mature themes regarding sexual violence, suicidal and distressing imagery. Viewer discretion is advised.
The hit series “Light and Shadow” continues with “Golden Time,” a new adventure that follows Alex, the eldest son of Duchess Edna and Duke Eli, as he sets out to experience the world on his own. While gathering his travel companions, Alex feels strangely drawn to a shabby young boy named Kenny, not realizing that they’ve met before. That’s because Kenny is actually Yessica Solveg, the second princess of the Kingdom of Northian… and fiancée to their future king, the violent Duke Frederick. With her identity hidden, the two royals form a bond. But when budding love could ignite the flames of war, will this reunion cause more pain than bliss?

title: The Game That I Came From
synopsis:
This series contains strong themes and graphic depictions of bullying.
With the rise of a popular RPG called Tianyong Game, its max-level players called "awakeners" have come to dominate the real world in terms of wealth and power. Despite Ling Ce's natural talent for the game, it's nearly impossible for him to catch up to these players because he started playing the game a year after its release.
