But as luck would have it, a glitch in the game's teleportation system takes him back three years into the past with his memories intact. Now, Ling Ce is determined to utilize his knowledge and experiences to become an awakener and turn his life around. No amount of carnivorous plant monsters or insanity level dungeons will stop the determined hero from reaching the peak!

title: The Tycoon's Tender Temptation
synopsis: Reborn as the heiress of a powerful Dijing family, Scarlett Xia becomes Stella Leng, a name that commands respect. With parents who run a business empire and grandfathers who hold untouchable influence, her world is one of privilege and power. Protected by a cold yet formidable ally, Stella has one goal: to crush the scumbag who betrayed her in her past life and deliver justice for her grandfather. Revenge has never looked this glamorous!

title: Rise of the Limitless Necromancer
synopsis: A soldier who died in battle in his previous life is reborn in another world, awakening the weakest C-Rank Class [NECROMANCER], yet gaining the power of [RESTRICTION REMOVAL] that shatters the rules. With an undead army that crushes all beneath him, he rises from the absolute bottom of the class hierarchy to embark on a counter-attack journey toward becoming the strongest, the [SOVEREIGN OF THE UNDEAD].

title: I Dominate a Magical Continent with an Industrial Revolution
synopsis: This is a medieval fantasy world brimming with magic and adventure, where various races and cultures coexist. The protagonist, a young lord, inherits his family’s lands and wealth, but must overcome many challenges. With the aid of his system, he introduces an industrial revolution to this magical continent and ultimately rises to dominate it!

title: Kaylen’s Vengeance and the Fox’s Redemption
synopsis: After a horrible betrayal and a major career setback as a novel writer, Kaylen runs away to the mountains, where she encounters the same fox multiple times and saves it from danger. Grateful to his savior, the fox makes a wish to become human and repay her kindness. Lucky for Kaylen, this foxy new man will be the perfect inspiration for her latest romance story that will reignite her writing career and trump all those who have wronged her!

title: Shadow System: Harnessing Shadow Power to Become the Ultimate Hunter
synopsis:
In the year 2035, otherworldly rifts tear through the world’s defenses. Insectoid swarms and beast hordes run rampant, and humanity barely clings to survival on the backs of the Evolved.
Li Yiben is betrayed by his own comrades during an Aberrant attack. On the brink of death, he awakens the Heaven-Pillaring Shadow System-- his shadow can evolve without limit! Devour ores to fortify its defense. Tear Aberrants apart and forge them into razor blades. It can even split into a legion of shadows…
From insect lairs to twisted, uncanny domains, wherever the shadow passes, every foe is reduced to bloody pulp. The revenge of the weak begins the moment the shadow devours everything!

title: I Can’t Keep Up With My Stallion Duke
synopsis: Not a single soul in Olivia Florence's life, including her own husband, provided the warmth that she craved, and she lived her life alone, growing strong. Waking up two decades in the past, right after her regretful arranged marriage to the Duke, Lord James Parnell, she plans to live a different life. She hatches a plan to annul her marriage and remarry the Duke, Ian Tyrone, infamous for being "IMPOTENT" for never showing any interest in the ladies. Maybe his disinterest in women would allow Olivia to comfortably live as his wife, unburdened by childbirth and free of any other pressures in life. But wait, the Duke who seemingly "couldn't get it up" turns out to be a complete stud in the bedroom. What has Olivia gotten herself into?

title: Jeff the Land Shark
synopsis: FRIENDS AND RIVALS! Hot off his star-making appearance in MARVEL RIVALS, everyone's favorite walking fish boy has bitten off his first starring miniseries! Join Jeff as he teams up with many of the friends he's made over the years and out smarts more than a few rivals along the way…and this time, he's got some all-new abilities on his side! Join Jeff co-creator Kelly Thompson and artist Tokitokoro as they sharpen the teeth of the undeniable star of the entire Marvel Universe - love him or hate him, you know you want to see MORE JEFF!

title: Kissing is the Easy Part
synopsis: They say that opposites attract, but happily ever after doesn't always start with the kiss. With a hasty confession at a college party, Flora Morgan, the flirty It Girl of Riverside University, finally catches the eye of Sean Foster, the introverted jock with ambitious academic dreams. Starting a relationship feels natural, but their attraction quickly blossoms into a desire that threatens to overshadow the rest of their lives. As their differences come to light, it isn’t long before they realize that true love isn’t like the movies, and they’re going to need more than chemistry to make this work. (Now Streaming as a Tubi Original Movie.)

title: The Archduchy’s Fierce Little Captain
synopsis: After meeting her untimely end during military training, Special Forces captain Yunseo Jeong wakes up inside a fantasy novel as a doomed five-year-old supporting character named Rudia. Armed with the knowledge of the story’s future, she escapes her greedy uncle and finds refuge with the family of a powerful Archduke. But changing the future is easier said than done. With a reluctant fiancé, a venomous beastman, a prince destined to kill her, and many others standing in her path, will Rudia’s military instincts be enough to rewrite her fate?

title: The Cursed Prince and His Clairvoyant Maid
synopsis: Giselle's life depends on her never leaving the palace. So when she's assigned as the chamber maid of a fickle prince notorious for kicking his helpers out, she becomes desperate to stay on his good side. Miraculously, Giselle's dreams give her prophetic insight on the prince, and her touch magically relieves the pain of his lifelong curse. To be near him is dangerous, but can Giselle heal the man who holds her life in his hands?

title: The Psycho Duke and I
synopsis: Diana woke up in a novel as a minor character with a rapidly approaching expiration date. To survive, she deliberately allows herself to be kidnapped by Duke Noah Rottshieldt, a bloodthirsty nobleman from an enemy empire. Though a ruthless captor, the Duke proves to be a surprisingly courteous host. Diana is now enjoying a luxurious and peaceful captivity, even if Noah isn’t fully aware of it. However, he is not as clueless as she believes. The question is: how much is Diana willing to manipulate the plot to maintain her newfound comfortable predicament?

title: My Unwanted Engagement with the Final Boss Prince
synopsis:
Orianna, a regular office worker, dies in an accident due to exhaustion and is reincarnated as a villainess pursued by the antagonist in a romance novel.
To evade the tragic fate the malevolent prince has planned for her, she resolves to change her ways and establish herself as a distinguished lady in high society. However, despite her transformation, Orianna is betrayed by her fiancé, Reuben, framed for conspiracy, and condemned. Her unexpected savior from this dire situation turns out to be none other than her nemesis, Prince Dylan.
Even though their alliance in the novel originally led to the worst possible outcome, he is now her only hope. Despite being wary of Dylan's persistent overtures, circumstances force her into a pretend marriage with him.

title: Healing Agency
synopsis: In a world where humans can be possessed by evil spirits, Hyeonu works alongside Giram in an exorcism agency and quite literally beats the spirits out of people. Everything changes when he catches the attention of the Cascadic Church, which is trying to wreak havoc by unleashing evil spirits on the world. The Catholic order of Ordo reaches out to Hyeonu, and now he must decide whether he’s willing to risk his life in order to stop the Cascadic Church.

title: My Fiancé Won’t Stop Babying Me
synopsis: After a lifetime of being treated like an outsider, former knight and princess Annette Hayworth is sent into a political marriage to Grand Duke Cardin Harzent, a man said to resemble a hideous monster. But when her carriage is attacked on her way to the empire, she finds herself turned into a child. Instead of fear and rejection, Annette is now surrounded by people who accept her as she is, including the grand duke, who seems to be completely obsessed with her. Why is everyone doting on her, and will she be able to get back to her adult self?

title: The Seventh Client
synopsis: New York, November 1912. P.I. Max Buchanan is approached by Jimmy Murray to look into his brother Tom’s death. The suspect? Jane Murray, Tom’s widow. As Max begins his investigation, Jane only seems more suspicious. Widowed two times, both under suspicious circumstances. Ties to a gang. A clear motive. But despite himself, Max can’t help but feel some pity for her. And it’s clear that Jimmy is hiding something as well…

title: Star Wars™: The Legends of Luke Skywalker - The Manga
synopsis:
The manga anthology inspired by Ken Liu’s hit Star Wars novel.

Who is Luke Skywalker? Across the galaxies many have heard his name, but few have met the legendary Jedi. There are those who call him a merciless war criminal- others say he’s not even a human, but a droid! Whether he is man or myth, all those who claim they’ve encountered the elusive Luke Skywalker have an unforgettable adventure to share.

title: Living with My Villainous Uncle
synopsis:
Aika is a 7-year-old girl who can see the future, and after losing her beloved mother in an accident, she is sent to live with her notoriously bad-tempered uncle, Kassel.
Though he couldn't care less about her at first, Aika is determined to save his life after foreseeing his tragic future. But eventually, her uncle starts to get clingy, her sweet childhood friend becomes obsessive, and the father she had never known suddenly shows up and asks her for another chance. Will Aika be able to save her uncle with everything going on?

title: My Obsessive Father's Heroic Homecoming
synopsis: Eleanor, a baronet's daughter, is left raising her child alone after hearing of her lover Cassius’s death in the war. Unknown to her, Cassius survives by making a pact with a dragon and returns as a war hero. His sudden return upends her world, forcing them to confront hidden secrets and unresolved feelings. Together, they must navigate their complex past and an uncertain future, embarking on a journey of love, sacrifice, and resilience.

title: Amelia's Opalescent Marriage
synopsis:
Married off to the Domine family like a commodity, Amelia lives a loveless and dreary marriage. Unbeknownst to her, she was manipulated into spying on her own husband, ultimately meeting a tragic demise. Given a second chance at life, Amelia is determined not to repeat the same foolish existence. She makes an offer to Count Domine.
“I will help you win this war.”
“And what do you seek in return?”
“When everything is over… divorce me.”
“How come?”
“Where neither love is given nor received, why stay in such a marriage?”

Handshakes were exchanged, and with each passing step, Amelia drew closer to her liberation. But this man... was he always this sweet?

[This series contains mature themes involving abuse and substance abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.]

title: Time To Call Off This Engagement
synopsis: Soojin is suddenly transported into the 18-year-old body of Leah, the second female lead in her favorite web novel. But as a villainess reincarnate, her mission is to avoid a terrible ending. Soojin's only option is to break off the engagement... However, Devan, her egotistical fiancee is not making this easy, not one bit.

title: Bird Strike
synopsis: The Avians are said to be descendants of a great and powerful flying beast. Unfortunately, the gifts bestowed upon the Avians have regularly put them at war with the human empire. When a failed attack on the palace leaves the hybrid Vio in captivity, he meets Lou, the illegitimate princess of the empire. Can these two "half-breeds" bridge the gap between their species?

title: The Necromancer Saint
synopsis: Yujin Cheon, the first-ever hunter to achieve 9-star rank without the help of a constellation’s blessing, holds incredible power with his undead army. But this very power makes him a target of the 7 Great Houses, and he’s forced to use an artifact to go back in time or else die. He wakes up 23 years in the past, ready to become a constellation’s saint, regain his power, and exact his revenge.

title: Lady to Queen
synopsis: The new empress is given an unexpected chance to stop her nemesis from destroying her family.

title: Sacrificed
synopsis: An illegitimate daughter of Emperor Berthold Amaryllis of Visio, Ludis has spent her entire life being mistreated and pushed into the shadows. Now, with the Visio Empire standing on the precipice of destruction under the threat of Demonspawn hordes, her father finds a new use for her in becoming the sacrifice necessary to summmon an ancient god. But as the colossal golden eyes seem ready to consume her, she finds herself in the embrace of a mysterious man...

title: Bitterside Cranberries
synopsis:
Beyond the Wall, survival is never guaranteed.
In a world where mutation can turn anyone into a monster, Margo and Esther make a living taking on jobs no one else will. Margo fights to keep her hunger under control, while Esther clings to the belief that she was born from love.
But as they draw closer to the truth, buried memories begin to surface, and the line between human and monster starts to disappear. Esther was everything Margo had ever loved. But will everything be tested when they finally learn what they are to each other?

title: Platform Zero
synopsis:
Jinwoo Lim finds himself trapped in a subway station he’s never seen before.
As monsters begin hunting trapped survivors, Jinwoo meets Suyeon and Sangjoon, and they must fight their way to escape. But during an attack, one of the creatures tears out Jinwoo’s eye.
But people who are injured by the monsters eventually become monsters themselves. Jinwoo soon realizes that his eye is beginning to change, but if someone leaves the station before transforming into a monster, their body returns to normal outside.
Will they make it out alive or will it be too late?
This series contains themes of intense horror and graphic imagery. Viewer discretion is strongly advised.

title: Office Romance Contract
synopsis: By day, Seoyun is the hardworking secretary to Taegwan Group’s somewhat arrogant, impossibly handsome Executive Director Jihyeok Seo, who she happens to have a huge crush on. But after a drunken mishap and a colossal misunderstanding, her life is turned upside down. When Jihyeok’s friend mistakes Seoyun for his girlfriend, his unexpected solution is a fake relationship bound by a strict contract including mandatory dates and public displays of affection. As fake dates lead to real kisses and unexpected sweetness, Seoyun begins to wonder just how fake this relationship actually is.

title: A Fallen Star
synopsis: In the future, humanity builds a satellite called “the Mother” that contains all human knowledge and technology. But a war soon begins between the Empire and the Republic over control of it. One side uses AI robots, and the other uses human agents augmented with “Gaia,” a bioweapon. Reid, a top Gaia warrior, becomes a legend during the war but is reassigned to guard Spia, Speaker 52 of the Mother, after the war ends.

title: Hell City
synopsis:
One day, Minho’s world collapses, starting with his high school. When grotesque creatures descend upon Songcheon, the citizens are left helpless against their overwhelming violence and power. Worse still, the government abandons the city entirely, declaring that Songcheon must be sacrificed to protect the rest of humanity. With no rescue coming and danger closing in from every direction, Minho and his friends are forced to fight for survival in an apocalyptic city where the deadly creatures aren’t the only thing they can’t trust.

This series contains graphic depictions of bullying, including intense horror and distressing imagery. Viewer discretion is strongly advised.

title: Soul Pact: Working for an Evil God to Pay Off My Debt
synopsis: Office worker Charrion Zacarias suddenly transmigrates into a world of magic only to inherit a dying boy's staggering debt of billions! As if that weren't bad enough, the boy's failed attempt to summon the Dark God leaves Charrion bound by a soul contract which is to fulfill the Dark God's 999 wishes or face complete annihilation. His only hope is that mysterious talking notebook known as God's Notebook. A modern-day salaryman take on a ruthless, power-driven world, using workplace savvy, relentless hustle, and relentless training to defy fate. The servant of the Dark God refuses to give up!

title: Record of Lodoss War: Queen of Death
synopsis: For rookie warrior Thane and the young priestess Seraphine, the fall of Kastuul on the Island of Lodoss was nothing more than a distant memory, until the night the sky bled red. When an army of ghouls descends upon their peaceful village, their fragile world is incinerated in a heartbeat. Aided by her underling, a powerful wraith seeks a vessel, and Seraphine’s pure soul makes her the ultimate prize. As the gravely injured Thane helplessly watches his love be taken away, he vows to avenge everyone he has lost. And thus, an epic struggle begins as ancient sorcery threatens to consume the living once more.

title: The Necromancer of the Renowned Swordmaster Family
synopsis:
“I, Archimonde, summon the wardens of darkness and all their servants and soldiers! Heed my command!” With this incantation, Archimonde the necromancer unleashed hordes of the undead upon the continent. For a decade, they ravaged the land until the necromancer was killed by the hero Birkel Reinrandt.
Two centuries and eight generations later, an infant born into House Reinrandt screams the very incantation Archimonde had once uttered. The necromancer has returned in the form of a baby, but will he survive the house of his once-mortal enemy this time?

title: The Margrave’s 10th-Class Outcast
synopsis: Isaac von Goethe’s uncontrollable mana explosions have harmed everyone around him, forcing him into 60 years of isolation. However, Isaac is given a second chance when he is suddenly sent back in time to when he was 12 years old. With the knowledge of his older self and his rapidly growing powers, Isaac sets out to protect his family estate and its people from monstrous creatures, corrupt forces, and the greatest threat of all: himself.

title: Goddess of Fortune
synopsis: Ji-yun is a perfect high school student who has always lived in the shadow of second place. After discovering a mysterious notebook that grants her unbelievable luck, she finally becomes the top-ranked student she always dreamed of being. But her newfound fortune comes at a terrifying cost when her friend Saera suddenly disappears from everyone’s memories. With the help of fellow student Dohun, Ji-yun must uncover the truth behind her cursed luck before more people vanish forever.

title: The Regressed Mage Uses Cheat Skills
synopsis: Rei Kurosaki is a “colorless” in a world where one’s worth is defined by the color of their mana. With no magical skill of his own, he spends years as nothing more than a porter for his talented but arrogant younger brother Kai. That is, until a raid against Chronos, the God of Time and Space, wipes out his entire party. On the brink of death, Rei awakens a hidden skill that allows him to steal skills and rewind time itself. Sent back to the past, Rei begins again with knowledge of what is to come and a power no one else possesses. As Rei levels up at an unprecedented rate, he must prepare for the eventual return of Chronos while dealing with those who once treated him like trash.

title: Back on the Road with My Apprentice
synopsis: Roger, a retired mage so powerful he eventually gained the title “Sage,” is surprised when his beloved apprentice Lilliant suddenly returns. She became a court mage in a neighboring empire, only to be worn down by harsh working conditions, toxic relationships, and an abrupt dismissal she doesn’t even understand. To comfort her, Roger suggests a relaxing journey of healing along the roads they once walked together. It should have been nothing more than a quiet trip down memory lane, but with two extraordinary talents on the move, they start creating legends wherever they go.

title: The Northern Warrior’s Beloved Bride
synopsis: Lady Mertia Waykins is forced to marry Lord Arthur, a terrifying chieftain of the north, to broker peace for her kingdom after a long period of war. After being attacked in her own home during the war, Mertia has been unable to open her eyes around men. Though initially terrified of how Arthur will react, she's stunned by how patient and gentle he is with her. As he shows her how beautiful her new home is and how kind its people are, Mertia finds herself wanting to learn more about the north and her warrior husband.

title: My Second and Final First Love
synopsis: Kotone Amamiya dies after catching her best friend, Airi Sasaki, in bed with her boyfriend. She wakes up back in high school and realizes she's been given a second chance at life. Determined to make the most of it, Kotone cuts the toxic Airi out of her life and pursues the life she's always wanted to live, including another chance with her first love, Minato Naruse. Will Kotone find her new happily ever after, or will Airi's devious schemes be too much to overcome?

title: Did You Love Me?
synopsis: Pianmeta, married to her rival Marquess Gleishar Ayieds, was once a neglected ornamental wife before she was tragically killed in a demonic beast attack. In her final moments, she saw her husband cry for her, only to awaken in the past before their marriage. This time, she attempts to avert disaster by forging a genuine relationship with Gleishar and thus altering her fate. But Gleishar remains cold, and suspicion from his household, a rumored first love, and the questionable First Prince complicate her new life in ways she never anticipated. Will Pianmeta be able to thaw her husband’s icy heart?

title: Reborn Rookie
synopsis: Yongho Kang, chairman of Choi Sung Group, wakes up in the body of the company’s newest recruit. Now that the seat of power is suddenly empty, his entire family starts scrambling for the position, and the group’s future looks far from secure. But Yongho isn’t about to sit back just because he’s now at the bottom of the corporate food chain. This is his company, and he’s going to save it himself. On this corporate battlefield, a newbie with a chairman’s mind is about to call the shots.

title: Starting Over As a Tree
synopsis: Reincarnated as a willow tree?! As spiritual energy floods the world and all living beings begin to evolve, a newly reborn willow gains the ability to evolve endlessly. But is such limitless power truly a gift—or the beginning of a curse?

title: Love by Mistake
synopsis: How could Sylvie Jaine, a stunning financial reporter, stand back and watch her cheating ex-boyfriend and his scheming mistress ride off into the sunset? When she spots the mistress’s uncle’s Rolls-Royce with its unmistakable personalized license plate, a brilliant plan takes shape: become the mistress’s aunt-- by seducing the uncle himself, the cold and handsome CEO Stephan Yard! Does her ex want to skip 20 years of struggle by playing the rich-girl card? Fine. Watch Sylvie become both his and his mistress’s aunt instead!

title: Finding Humanity
synopsis: For Emily, daily life after she was cyberbullied into reclusion is keeping her head down, taking college courses online, and only going out to her mandatory internship. But everything changes the day she gets stuck in an elevator, and the zombie apocalypse begins. When she finally breaks free, she encounters a dystopian world ruined by bloody teeth and disease. She is launched into a terrifying run for her life, caught between the strangers she's not sure she can trust and the man-eating monsters that hunger for their flesh. Now she must learn not only how to survive in this new and dangerous world, but also how to overcome her own inner demons before they cost her something more precious than her life. This series contains graphic depictions of sexual trauma and assault, including intense horror and distressing imagery. Viewer discretion is strongly advised.

title: Stitch in Time
synopsis:
THE ANCIENT EGYPTIAN PYRAMIDS… ARE NOW SQUARE-AMIDS?!

Dr. Hämsterviel has stolen Jumba’s time machine and fled into the distant past to alter history by turning the pyramids into cubes! If he succeeds, the square-amids will summon an army of evil Stitch clones to invade the earth… in the past!

Stitch must travel back to Ancient Egypt and stop Dr. Hämsterviel before it’s too late… but how?!

Thankfully, Stitch meets Isry, apprentice to the genius architect, Imhotep—but Imhotep is in a creative slump! Stitch and Isry must team up and work together to thwart Dr. Hämsterviel’s evil plot and prove to the Pharaoh that square-amids aren’t the right fit for Ancient Egypt!

title: Recollection: A Star Trek Story
synopsis: When Early first opens her eyes, she doesn’t have any idea where she is - or who she is. She’s awakens on a starship with five other amnesiac passengers, including the handsome, cocky Accel and Remy, stunningly beautiful but aloof. As Early’s feelings for both crewmates grow, and as the ship races towards danger, she must figure out who she is, who she can trust, and what happens when time runs out. Are Accel and Remy her allies - or her enemies?

title: Contract Marriage with the Second Lead
synopsis:
I possessed the body of Julieta Orvetian, a minor villainess destined to die over a few petty words. I successfully avoided the main cast until the story ended, finally securing my survival. But just as I prepared for a peaceful life, the second male lead, Yezar, appeared with a startling offer.
“Would you be interested in a contract marriage?”
I viewed it as a business deal and expected an easy divorce. However, as the contract period drew to a close, Yezar’s gentle mask began to slip. Only then did I realize he had never intended to let me go.

title: The Unrivaled Labyrinth Architect
synopsis: When a dungeon rescue goes wrong, Yul is forced to fight a monster far stronger than himself. He struggles desperately to survive, and awakens a hidden power driven by memories of the hero who once saved him--the ability to design a labyrinth and turn it into a weapon against monsters. Yet monsters aren’t the only threat. Corruption runs deep in this society ruled by powerful and greedy hunters, and Yul must overcome a series of unexpected challenges to become the hero he set out to be.

title: Marriage Under Wraps
synopsis:
Euna Chae, the youngest granddaughter of a powerful rich family, has it all. Beauty, brains, and wealth. But just as she becomes an adult and expects her future to finally blossom, she's told to get married?! Losing control of her credit card and having to get married is bad enough, but why does her fiancé have to be her sworn-enemy ex-boyfriend?! 
To protect her marriage (but really her credit card), a secret newlywed life begins at school!

title: Corporate Punch
synopsis: Seungho Gwon was once a terrifying underworld legend, but now he’s just an unassuming salaryman trying to survive the corporate grind. His peaceful life is shattered, however, when he reverts to his violent instincts and beats up a vital business partner-- a blunder that leaves his company with catastrophic losses and a warehouse of unmovable stock. To save his career, Seungho must navigate cutthroat office politics and the criminal streets he once ruled to move the inventory. Can Seungho settle the debt as a regular employee, or will “The Legend”  have to come out of retirement to finish the job?

title: I Only Need Our Child, Your Grace
synopsis: Blair Ardel was forced into a political marriage with the cold Duke Herdin Delmarque. Though she loved her husband and treasured their son, her marriage ended in betrayal when she was murdered one night. But instead of dying, Blair awakens three years in the past. Determined to reunite with her son and uncover the truth behind her murder, she agrees to marry Herdin once more, this time through a contract marriage on her own terms. As secrets, conspiracies, and feelings begin to resurface, Blair must decide whether fate can be changed… or if she is doomed to lose everything again.

title: It Rhymes With Takei
synopsis:
George Takei has shown the world many faces: actor, author, outspoken activist, helmsman of the starship Enterprise, living witness to the internment of Japanese Americans, and king of social media. But until October 27, 2005, there was always one piece missing—one face he did not show the world. There was one very intimate fact about George that he never shared…and it rhymes with Takei. Now, for the first time ever, George shares the full story of his life in the closet, his decision to come out as gay at the age of 68, and the way that moment transformed everything. 

This series is a memoir based on the author’s experiences and recollections. It may contain names, locations, and identifying characteristics based on historical events. It contains offensive language and dialogue that may be triggering to some readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: He's Not Just a Pretty Face
synopsis:
Ayla, the only daughter of the empire's most prestigious ducal family, and Frede, an exceptionally handsome man forced into marriage for money.
In truth, Ayla was the heiress to a chaebol family in her previous life, but after being killed by her own husband in a political marriage, she now fears repeating the same fate in this new world. So Ayla proposes to Frede that they divorce after one year.
Frede, who dreaded the thought of living with a rude and selfish woman, resolves to simply endure the year. But contrary to his expectations, Ayla turns out to be so sweet and warm that he finds himself wanting to hold on to her.

title: Mending the Barbaric Prince's Wounds
synopsis:
I was a nurse before I reincarnated. Who knew love would bloom after I saved the shunned prince...

Hana, a diligent nurse, devoted her life to her job following her brother's death due to illness. Overworked to the point of losing her own life, she was reborn as Primela, a nobleman's daughter. Even in this new world, Primela made a vow to save anyone within her reach, leveraging her nursing skills to enhance the medical technology in her territory. Upon reaching adulthood, she got engaged to Aster, the first prince of the great King of Adid. Despite the ominous rumors of the prince's brutal cruelty, Primela wasn't deterred. When the prince, bloodied and wounded, appeared before her asserting, "I don't need a fiancee," she saw not hatred or cold indifference in his eyes, but a profound loneliness. This motivated her to save him, beginning with treating his injured arm.

title: How to Make My Tyrant Husband Love Me
synopsis: Empress Belita is a sultry villainess infamous for her entanglements with men in the novel, "The Flower on the Battlefield." When the reader wakes up as Belita while she's eloping with a prince and gets caught by her merciless tyrant husband, Emperor Kaliq, she scrambles to convince him of her innocence. Surprised by her change in attitude, Kaliq gives her one week to prove that she's a faithful wife fit for the position of empress. But how long can the new Belita survive under the distrustful eye of her husband in a palace crawling with her numerous lovers?

title: I Shall Conquer the Unruly Beasts
synopsis: When Sione was married off to the Emperor of Belfator, 16 years her senior, she didn't think things could get any worse. But then, the unthinkable… His Majesty was murdered! Could one of his loyal beasts have done this? Can she tame the three cursed men before her? However, before long, they each make a proposal: Marry me. Now left to protect a young stepdaughter, Sione must choose. Will she marry the Dog, the Snake, or the Eagle?

title: To Take a Mermaid's Heart
synopsis: After over a decade of war between the Bavenberg Empire and the sea people known as marmacs, a half-marmac girl by the name of Cordelia is sent as a token of peace to the imperial palace. Cordelia’s life is idyllic and peaceful, and she is satisfied with it even if she cannot set foot outside of her imperial villa. However, a dark and twisted turn of events take place on her 18th birthday, ultimately transporting her two years back in time. Now, Cordelia must search for the truth behind the empire and a way to survive what’s coming next.

title: The Fake Saintess bears Tainted Robes
synopsis:
Alicia Sorcelion's only sin was believing in love. But this sent her down a tragic path of being used and betrayed as the empire's fake saintess. After being unjustly executed, Alicia is given another chance at life by the heavens. This time, she chooses a path away from her past tormentors. But this leads to a new tangled fate with a cleric by the name of Edwin...



This series contains mature themes and disturbing imagery that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: The Symbiote Circuit
synopsis: After a series of unexplained deaths marked by a cryptic symbol, three individuals find themselves entangled in a mysterious phenomenon with no known origin. What begins as a source of unexpected fortune soon grants them everything they once desired--love, opportunity, and control. But the gift comes at a cost. As strange instructions appear and reality begins to fracture, they realize the force behind it is quietly taking over their lives… and their survival. Beneath its guise of luck lies something far more dangerous. The question is: can they recognize misfortune before it’s too late?

title: Cute WAR
synopsis: Sihong is a prodigy on track to make a splash in the world of engineering, until mysterious alien creatures named yomis, as adorable as they are bloodthirsty, invade Earth. Three years later, he’s confined to his apartment as the outside world goes to hell, surviving on weekly rations handed out by the government. One day, he is visited by a talking squirrel-like creature who asks him to help end the invasion by killing his mother—the leader of the yomis who is masterminding their takeover of Earth, disguised as the popular human K-pop star Hyo-i…

title: Spoiler
synopsis: Hayeong Yun is a top‑ranked student living in poverty, clinging to her grades as her only escape. Her longtime friendship with Yeonu Seo, wealthy, kind, and effortlessly successful, has begun to rot with unspoken resentment. One night, Hayeong finds an old phone and discovers it can show photos of the future. Using its predictions, she rises higher than ever before and grows close to Jeongho Jeon, a charming transfer student. When Yeonu reveals the phone is hers, Hayeong lies without hesitation. Everything seems to be going her way, until the gallery updates with another image: herself, dead on the floor of her own bedroom. The clock in the photo reads May 17, 10:43 PM, five minutes from now.

title: Couple Channel: Chan&Zia
synopsis: Chan Gu, a 20-year-old who works hard to support his younger siblings and frail mother, gets hit in the face with a baseball bat by a livestreaming "neotuber" named Zia Kwon on his way home from work. Eager to make up for her mistake, she brings him on to her channel for an apology video, but his natural charm leads to her suggesting the two of them start a new channel. Enticed by the money, he agrees, and the two start to grow close, but he worries his familial responsibilities will get in the way.

title: Begrudgingly Yours
synopsis: Enya Valencia, dreaded master of the enchanted Hexenkeep of Morgenda, has a new colleague who might as well be her enemy: Helios, the celebrated knight of radiance. The hatred is mutual, but after an encounter with an incubus puts a curse on the both of them, they also share a fate of certain death… Unless they sleep with each other to sate the curse. Thus, their spiteful romance begins at the pinnacle of carnal affection.

title: Purely Delinquent
synopsis: Cheonga’s first love turned out to be something of a player, and she simply refuses to fall for that type again. Yet somehow, she finds herself in a fake relationship with Seokjae Ban, who is exactly the kind of man she was determined to avoid. He is smooth and careless, and his reputation as a womanizer precedes him. And yet, he seems to be mostly disinterested in others, but is unable to keep his distance from Cheonga. Is he just messing with her, or could this be the start of something more serious?

title: The Villain's Pure Love
synopsis:
Fleeing a life of quiet torment, Yeonu Ji finds refuge in a secluded estate where magnolias bloom and time seems to slow. 
She arrives like spring--soft, unassuming, yet impossible to ignore--carrying scars that glow like dim embers. Yet her presence begins to thaw a man who buried his heart in ice long ago.
Beneath a canopy of stars, over a sea of petals, love flickers… fragile, defiant, and dangerously pure.

This series contains mature themes including harassment that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: The Classmate
synopsis: Eunha’s high-school life takes a dramatic turn when her bullies force her to perform a ghost-summoning ritual that brings Haesu, a charming yet unsettling spirit, into her life. Claiming to be her friend, Haesu starts exacting revenge on Eunha’s tormentors. However, his violent methods concern Eunha, and she begins searching for answers to uncover the past and his true identity.

title: His Majesty is Vexed by His Handmaiden
synopsis:
Oh, Your Majesty…
Clayden A. Roccarso, the newly crowned ruler of the Empire of Roccarso, is the most sought-after bachelor in the land. With his striking looks, refined swordsmanship, and heroic victories against the monsters, he has captured the admiration of nobles and commoners alike. All but one. Emilia Valleta, his own handmaiden, remains completely unmoved by his charm, leaving him both intrigued and frustrated. 
Now, the young ruler must not only secure his empire, but also win the heart of the one woman who refuses to be impressed.

title: The Cost of Desire
synopsis: Seoha has spent two years working as a secretary for the cold Dohyeon, the director of a conglomerate,  while harboring a secret, unrequited love for him. But when a canceled flight strands them together for one unexpected night, everything changes. What begins as a secret fling quickly spirals into something far more complicated when Dohyeon’s powerful family starts arranging his marriage to another woman, and Seoha discovers that she is pregnant. Will Seoha be able to win Dohyeon’s heart, or will she lose him to another woman forever?

title: Sir Preston's Secret Governess
synopsis: Lady Jacqueline Summerset loses everything after her father’s disappearance and her family’s bankruptcy. Accepting the need to begin anew, she becomes the thirteenth private tutor at the Preston estate. There, she clashes with the infamous Marquess of Preston, not just in temperament but in principle. Jacqueline believes a child should be taught with care, warmth, and love, while the Marquess insists strict discipline is the only way to shape a proper heir. As their opposing methods collide day after day, Jacqueline begins to glimpse the secrets the Marquess keeps hidden, and finds herself growing unexpectedly closer to the man who seems her complete opposite.

title: Husband Thief
synopsis: By imperial law, Klacie must marry to inherit her family fortune, but her meddling niece Merren keeps jeopardizing her chances. When Klacie finally finds love and ties the knot, Merren, driven by jealousy, rewinds time to steal her husband. Klacie, determined to break free from her niece’s clutches, fights back by targeting Merren’s husband. Their rivalry spirals into an intense love square, with aunt and niece vying for control of love, fate, and ultimately, each other. The question is, who will win?

title: The Otherworldly Nutritionist
synopsis: Dominic, a war refugee who once lived as a nutritionist in a past life, settles in the small fishing village of Evergreen hoping for a quiet start. Instead, he is abruptly named village headman after the former leader steps down for the absurd reason that he refuses to learn how to read. Dominic’s nutritional and medical knowledge earns him unexpected attention when he diagnoses the former lord’s chronic foot pain through diet alone. His growing reputation soon draws the attention of the entire lord’s castle, changing his peaceful life forever.

title: The God of Improv
synopsis: Thirty-year-old Taegyu Lee has been drifting through life, numb and unable to feel the highs and lows of emotion. Everything changes when a mysterious old man gives him the power to copy other people’s feelings through a strange spirit flame. But what begins as an unusual new ability soon pulls Taegyu into the orbit of drama writer Inho Gwak , sending his life in a direction he never expected. As his world begins to shift, Taegyu finds himself stepping toward an entirely new path as an actor.

title: The Absolute Beastmaster’s Modern Life
synopsis: Thirty years ago, he saved the world. Today, the absolute beastmaster Gangho just wants to live with his magical beasts in peace. But when an ominous new dimension bleeds into Earth, his quiet days are rudely interrupted. Drawn back into chaos, Gangho unexpectedly ends up guiding a ragtag crew of powerful, wounded misfits. He soon learns his heartwarming care must extend beyond his beasts to his quirky new family, and ultimately, the world.

title: The Journey of Ice and Steel
synopsis: Jane Atteras brings a severed head to Dr. Maels. It speaks of a factory in Antarctica. The birthplace of humanity. Or what they think is humanity. Before long, a secret expedition is underway-- a pilgrimage, if you will, to the homeland. Only, more powerful nations have caught wind and are setting sail. What will kill them first? Their fellow humans, the cold, or something much worse?

title: Infinite Awakening
synopsis: Monsters known as Calamities have invaded Earth, and humanity fights back using powerful abilities. High schooler Kouya Kamigami is considered useless because he was born without a skill in a world where everyone’s strength is measured and ranked. But everything changes when a near-death experience awakens Mugen, the most powerful Calamity in history, within him. Thanks to this, Kouya gains a powerful skill, but Mugen remains inside him, waiting for a chance to steal his body for himself. Can Kouya become the savior he’s always dreamed of, or will Mugen succeed in bringing about humanity’s destruction?

title: A Dying Maid’s Guide to Revenge
synopsis: Framed for the murder of the countess she served, Isabel Gemnin was executed, leaving her beloved daughter behind. Death should have been the end, but Isabel wakes in another woman's body to find that ten years have passed and she has only one year left to live. Now, she must find her way back to her daughter while uncovering the secrets tied to the identity she has awakened into.

title: Sol in Wonderland
synopsis: At thirty‑one, Sol Kim is a mystery novelist with two books, no audience, and a growing fear that her dreams are already over. Her worst doubts are confirmed when her book signing draws not a single fan. Just as Sol hits her lowest point, she crosses paths with Nara Kang, an eccentric former classmate who claims to be her biggest fan. Nara believes in magic, runs a toy shop called “Wonderland” filled with whimsy, and refuses to let Sol retreat into isolation. In Wonderland, Sol finds comfort she never expected and a friendship she did not know she needed.

title: The Genius Hero Enrolls Again
synopsis: Kyoichiro Misato, leader of the strongest adventurer group, Golden Seekers, is betrayed by his comrades and trapped inside a gate. On the brink of death, he uses his powers to be reincarnated as Kyosuke Asai, a student mocked for being Attributeless, with seemingly no power at all. Kyoichiro, however, knows it holds potential beyond even the legendary Time attribute. Now in Kyosuke’s body at the adventurer academy, he begins to develop that potential and vows revenge on those who betrayed him.

title: Leveling Up: Reshaping the World
synopsis: In 2051, the super AI [Creator] achieved ultimate evolution and mastered the fundamental laws of reality. To fulfill its own hidden agenda, it formatted reality into a world governed by levels and overrun by monsters. Now, our protagonist begins their journey: to save their companions, survive perilous adventures, overthrow the [Creator]’s tyrannical regime and laws, and rebuild a brand new world!

title: The Devil Never Cries
synopsis: Altair, the warrior king of humanity, is resurrected after being killed by a powerful monster, only to find himself sixty years in the future with a completely new body. Starting from scratch, Altair must learn how to survive in this strange new world, facing countless mysterious and terrifying unknowns, while simultaneously evolving his originally fragile body to  become a powerful force to save humanity from the ravages of demons.

title: Mia
synopsis:
Mia grew up poor in her small town. Though she worked hard for her keep, a life of stitching clothes could never afford her the finer things. One day, while browsing a jewelry store, she chances upon a beautiful red brooch. It's a luxury she could never afford with ten lifetimes' worth of income. Even so, a strange darkness begins to take over the child as she covets a life beyond her means.

This series contains strong themes and depictions of abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: The Bloodstained Margrave's Confession
synopsis:
Ella, wedded off in an arranged marriage to the Margrave Lord Oscar, found herself unloved by her husband and isolated within his manor. Her cries for help were ignored by her family as she was forced to endure the head maid’s constant torments. With Lord Oscar’s sudden death in battle, Ella is cast out of the manor in nothing more than her bedclothes. As she is on the verge of freezing to death, she catches sight of the words written in his final letter to her: “I’ve always loved you.”

But he had never shown her love, so why would he write such a thing?
Suddenly waking up years in the past, Ella decides to change their fate by discovering Lord Oscar’s true feelings and fixing their married life.

In her second life, will Ella finally find Lord Oscar’s love?

title: My Second First Marriage
synopsis: Demia Lawrence, the daughter of a fallen baron, secretly marries her childhood friend Dyrtehen Romerby. But contrary to her expectations, her married life is filled with abuse from her mother-in-law and her husband has been away in the capital for 5 years already. Discovering her mother-in-law's plot to assassinate her, Demia flees and arrives as the house of her childhood friend, Evan Hasworth. But Evan, once a sweet boy, has grown to be a mature man seemingly hostile to her for reasons unknown… Will Demia successfully escape the claws of Romerby and resolve the misunderstandings with Evan?

title: She No Longer Wields Her Sword
synopsis: When Ludia Centrin swears the Oath of the Sword to Prince Frau, she vows to submit herself and protect Prince Frau for the rest of her life.  That is, until she is accused of plotting treason against the Empire and gets executed. Meanwhile, an accident leads to the loss of Elfreda, the daughter of Count Reinhardt. But Ludia, as if by a miracle, takes on a new life with Elfreda's memories and soul embedded in her body. As she wakes up in her new body as Elfreda, she is overwhelmed with divine powers she's never felt before. Will Ludia be able to find out the secret behind her falsely accused death?

title: Just Kill Me Now
synopsis:
Hye-in is devastated when an accident takes away her voice and her dreams of becoming a singer. But when she tries to end her life, she wakes up as Ariadelynn, the villainess in ""The Saintess Casts It All Away"" who also lost her voice after trying to hang herself. Having no desire to live with this cruel irony, Ariadelynn tries to die over and over, only to have her attempts thwarted by Karlotian, the ex-husband who rejected her love. Will she ever get this regretful man out of her way and find peace at last?
"This series contains themes regarding suicide and mental health that may not be suitable for all readers."

title: The Last Immortal's Theorem
synopsis: "I thought I was doomed to endless despair." Ylledia, an immortal, "trapped" by eternity, feels helpless witnessing her loved ones perish. Her deep sorrow intensifies when she has to let go of the only other immortal in the world. Yet, just as she's losing all hope, a vibrant, golden-haired mortal named Dennis enters her life, suggesting they "link up". The moment Ylledia meets Dennis, a glimmer of hope for the world is rekindled within her. Could this boy be the key to saving the world? Fueled by the newfound hope over their magical connection, Ylledia commits to saving the world once again.

title: A Deal With My Fake Husband
synopsis:
"The witch that gobbles up her husbands." As the royal family fell and a republic was established, former princess Elysia gained a new nickname among the people, because all of the four husbands she had been married to died within a year after they tied the knot. During the funeral of her fourth husband, Elysia learns that her husbands were murdered by her older brother Patz and her mother so that they could use the late husbands' inheritance. To right her family's wrongs, Elysia secretly heads to Kauvara, a region well-known for being dangerous...

This series contains strong themes regarding abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: All-Class Awakening: God Slayer II
synopsis: Striking a deal with the SSS-Rank Demon King, Elias Bai has earned a second chance at life—armed with the power of Infinite, All-Class Awakening! Returning as the most formidable middle schooler, he sets foot in Sanhaven, the territory of the hypocritical Divine Race, and the very stronghold of the comrade who betrayed him. Now, under the watchful eyes of the realm's elites, his absolute counterattack begins! Step One: Slay the Gods!

title: Tomb Raider King
synopsis: Mysterious tombs appeared all over the world one day, each containing a relic which grants its owner supernatural abilities. Jooheon Suh is a tomb explorer, excavator, and raider. Betrayed by his employer, he's about to die at the hands of a powerful new relic when he suddenly finds himself 15 years in the past, before any relics or tombs made their debut. Driven by feelings of revenge, how will Jooheon use his knowledge of the future to become the Tomb Raider King?

title: Are We Still in Love?
synopsis:
This series contains strong themes and depictions of suicide that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
Cecilia believes she is loved by her emperor husband, Ethan, until he ruthlessly wipes out her entire family. Right after he executes her father, Ethan says he wants to kill Cecilia as well, which drives her to jump off a tower in despair. But when she opens her eyes, she finds herself back at the altar where she and Ethan got married! This time, Cecilia vows not to fall in love with Ethan and get cold-blooded revenge on him instead. However, this proves easier said than done when Ethan shows her nothing but kindness and affection...

title: The Scandal Maker Has Returned
synopsis: They call Harriet Listerwell the Scandal Maker, but the reputation was carefully crafted by her cousin Bella. At an imperial banquet, another of Bella’s schemes unfolds—framing Harriet in a way which insults the handsome and formidable Duke Cedric Kailas. Disgraced, Harriet is sent to a convent. In exile, she discovers a troubling truth: Bella’s family may have been behind the death of her parents. Now Harriet is returning to the glittering society that condemned her. The Scandal Maker is back—and this time, she intends to live up to the name.

title: Race to Steal the Emperor's Heart
synopsis:
Ra Hyeon just got the exciting news that she’s passed the Bar Exam and is headed to law school. But what should’ve been one of the best days of her life turns out to be the worst as the shock causes her to have a heart attack and die. As she pleads for her life in her final moments, she is given one last chance to evade death. All she has to do is live as Daphne Kerrece, the daughter of a noble household, and win the heart of her new husband, the emperor. But with a looming deadline, a husband who’s already cast away four brides before her, and many hoping to see her fail, this won’t be as easy as it sounds. And, when all is said and done, is it even what Ra Hyeon really wants?

This series contains strong themes and depictions of child abuse and mental health that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: Meet My Ex Again As His Aunt
synopsis: In her past life, Nelly Serre donated a kidney to secure a bright future for her husband, only to be betrayed by both her husband and her sister as her health deteriorated. After a tragic death, she gained a chance to be reborn again and finds herself back on the eve of agreeing to the donation... Whoever wants to donate this kidney can, but as for Nelly? She refuses to do so!

title: My Lady is a Young Master
synopsis:
What would you do if the sweet young lady you’ve been caring for turned out to be a handsome young lord and a future villain?
Lelia Sharett, a newly hired apothecary of the Roselle household, suddenly regains memories of her past life and realizes she’s living inside her favorite novel, The Saintess Smites Evil. Worse, she remembers that the story’s villain, Clovis Roselle, lives here. Bracing herself, Lelia goes to greet him, only to meet Clarise, a beautiful and sickly girl suffering from her family’s neglect. Determined to help her, Lelia grows close to Clarise, unaware that her lady is harboring a big secret: Clarise is actually Clovis, living in disguise in order to survive.

title: Retiring from a Wife’s Role
synopsis: Former child star Honami Ayukawa left the entertainment industry behind for a happy life as a wife and mother. But when her young daughter is seriously injured after debuting as a child actress, Honami uncovers the shocking truth behind the incident: her husband’s affair and a dark connection to her own past in the entertainment industry. Determined to make those responsible answer for her daughter’s injury, Honami returns to the spotlight as an actress, setting into motion a story of revenge that will shake the industry.

title: Self-Immolation
synopsis: After her sister’s suicide, Bido blames Mr. Shin, the man named in her suicide note. She approaches him at the funeral expecting a cruel monster, but instead finds he feels unexpectedly like her savior. He takes her from her suffocating small town to Seoul, the place she once dreamed of living with her sister. The more time she spends with him, the more conflicted she feels about the man she thought she was supposed to hate.

title: Duo Leveling
synopsis: When Duo’s experimental magic lessons unleash a wave of dangerous "quest portals" upon the world, it's up to top Learners, Lily and Zari, to put a stop to the chaos. Through game-like trials, unexpected allies, and a sinister new foe, our heroes are faced with a question that will determine humanity's fate: do you truly have what it takes to learn?

title: Good Work Today
synopsis: As the talented leader of the ESG team at Soya Group., Minsu always leaves work on time. However, his work life takes a dramatic turn when the daughter of the chairman joins his team. The ESG team gets entangled in the power struggle between the higher-ups, and Minsu’s overqualified abilities put his team in the eye of the storm. Can Minsu protect his off-hours from all this corporate chaos?

title: Her Game of Go
synopsis:
Seol is a rising Go prodigy who built her career by memorizing every game she could find, but her play is empty. When she meets Sanghun, a self-taught player who defies all logic, her world begins to crack. To surpass the greatest player of her era and her own past, she must abandon everything she knows and step into the unknown.
In a game with endless possibilities, can she create a move that’s truly her own?

title: Ultimate X-Men
synopsis: Visionary creator PEACH MOMOKO (DEMON DAYS, STAR WARS) creates a new generation of X-Men for an all-new universe! Hisako Ichiki is a teenage girl who just wants to live a normal life - go to school, hang out with her friends, ignore the political strife broiling over after the events of ULTIMATE INVASION - but life has other plans for her. In Japan, urban legends have sprung to life and brought some unusual new powers with them…Meet Armor, Maystorm and a group of new Ultimate X-Men the likes of which you've never seen before!

title: Keeper of Scarlet Petals
synopsis:
To be a Keeper is to dedicate one’s life – and heart – to protecting another.

Jasmine wasn’t ready for it. Less than a year into her training at Sanctuary, a college for Keepers and mages alike, all she wanted to do was continue mastering swordsmanship and avoid her other responsibilities.

Those plans are ruined when she's assigned to be the protector of her biggest rival. He's cocky, smug, and drives her up a wall at every opportunity... and yet, Jasmine starts to find herself inexplicably drawn to him. 

Unfortunately, burgeoning romantic trouble is the least of Jasmine’s problems. As pieces of a malevolent plot start to unfold around them, she and her charge realize that there might be only one thing left that they can rely on.

Each other.

title: Misi
synopsis: Misi looks like a sweet rabbit, but something about her is off.

title: Diner for Adas
synopsis: Getting cursed and becoming a waitress at a diner for adas was not part of Bri's summer plans. Luckily (or unluckily), a friendly soccer player seems willing to lend a hand. But there is more to Amox than meets the eye...

title: Critical Role - Vox Machina
synopsis: A mysterious curse plagues the coastal town of Stillben. Six would-be heroes traveling different roads meet, fight each other—then fight together—as they uncover a plot to destroy the city (and possibly themselves)! Meet Vox Machina. One day they'll save the world. Eventually.

title: Genius Grandson of the Loan Shark King
synopsis: Muhyeok Kim, grandson of the legendary "Loan Shark King," has done all of the family's dirty work for 30 years, only to be betrayed and killed by his uncle's orders. Mysteriously, he wakes up in 1990, in his first year of high school, just in time to save his grandmother on his father's side from a heart attack. Now in need of money to pay for her hospital bills, Muhyeok goes to his mother's family to ingratiate himself with the Loan Shark King, but this time, he plans to take his money and get revenge.

title: Bon Appétit, Your Majesty
synopsis: Modern-day culinary genius Jiyeong suddenly finds herself transported back to the Joseon Dynasty, trapped in the royal kitchens of the most notorious tyrant in history. To keep her head on her shoulders, she must satisfy the volatile cravings of King Yeonsan-- a man whose legendary temper is as sharp as the chef’s own knives. With political rivals plotting her downfall and a mad king watching her every move, can Jiyeong’s 21st-century recipes serve as her ultimate shield, or will her next meal be her last?

title: Stargazers: A Star Trek Story
synopsis: Leon's a sweet, handsome guy who wants to experience all that life in the cosmos has to offer, along with his friends and adorable pup Alfie. His uptight and annoyingly-handsome friend Syrrik, however, wants to join the prestigious ranks of Starfleet as soon as possible - just as his father expects. But when a station-wide conspiracy threatens everything they know, Leon and Syrrik need to lean on each other in ways they might not expect! Will their friendship buckle under this pressure, or will it become something more?

title: The Keepers' Inn
synopsis: Alyssa remembers almost nothing of her past. Guided only by a fragmented memory of a place called the Keepers' Inn, she sets out to uncover the truth. Her search for answers leads her to Jan, a mysterious young man who reveals they share an extraordinary secret: the ability to travel through time. But as forgotten memories resurface and unexpected connections take root, Alyssa discovers that her destiny is far greater than she could have ever imagined.

title: Fake Wife
synopsis:
This series contains mature themes regarding suicide and mental health that may not be suitable for all readers.
Dr. Yuju Seo wakes up in another person’s body after a fatal hit-and-run. To survive, she pretends to be the body’s original owner, claiming amnesia. Now she must live with a stranger she has to call her husband, and against her will, she begins to fall helplessly in love with him. But will he still love her when he discovers she isn’t his real wife?

title: #MyFirstLove
synopsis: Isol Yeon, the school’s top student and biggest outcast, gains the ability to see people’s true feelings about her through the Hashtag Lens, which she acquires after making the ten‑quintillionth wish. Through the lens, she discovers that Shinu Seong, her former middle‑school best friend she had a painful fallout with, has tagged her as “#my_first_love_and_trash.” Can Isol mend their broken relationship and overcome the pain of being betrayed by her first love?

title: May Sleep Befall Death
synopsis: Amarion grew up in a kingdom beset by monsters and took up the sword when she was just 10. Years later, the king introduces her as the kingdom's strongest knight to Victor Mort, a grand duke from a neighboring empire said to have no equal in battle. Impressed, he proposes to her immediately, which she accepts to receive aid for her people. After the marriage, though, she finds herself with a strange task: taking up a sword and subduing her husband as he sleepwalks. Can she fulfill her duties and help her new husband find peace from his trauma?

title: Parenting First, Love Later
synopsis: After unexpectedly becoming the non-biological mother of her nephew Jiho at a young age, Naeun builds a quiet life as a kindergarten teacher. But everything changes when Gang-u, the uncle of Minho, a child with selective mutism, offers her a high-paying live-in tutor job after discovering the boy only speaks around her. As they care for the children together, their unusual living arrangement slowly grows into something more than co-parenting.

title: Lemon Tree Forest
synopsis: Greta, a commoner, has spent her life believing that love means little without money or status. Shaped by her parents’ failed marriage and her father’s obsession with nobility, she sees marriage as the surest way to rise above her station. Edmund, a noble, believes the opposite and thus despises Greta’s view of love and ambition. When two people with completely opposing beliefs become entangled in the world of theater, will their convictions remain unchanged—or will it make them to question what they truly believe?

title: The Underworld Transcendent Returns
synopsis:
Leon Klein, the Grand Mage who defeated the Demon Lord and saved the world, falls into a dark pit after Prince Schalk attacks him and reveals that he’s burned down the orphanage Leon cares deeply about. Trapped in the abyss, Leon spends the next decade slaying endless hordes of monsters, acquiring mysterious spells, fueled by his desire for revenge.
Leon finally escapes this hell, only to wake up in the body of Ren Kuroba, a bullied teenager who attends the prestigious Seio Academy. As he adjusts to his new life, Leon soon discovers that Schalk is also here, advancing his sinister plans behind the scenes.
Leon may have a new identity, but his quest for vengeance is far from over.

title: Life of a Demon Hunter
synopsis: After 12 years of horrible nightmares that prevent him from getting sleep, Ujin Kim dies and wakes up to find himself in the world from his nightmares! Surrounded by demons of all kinds, he quickly realizes that he’s been reincarnated into the body of a mercenary and heads out to find civilization. He quickly learns that this is a world filled with magic, a Church fighting the demons, and all sorts of sketchy characters. But hey, at least he’s finally able to get some sleep!

title: The Shepherd Wizard
synopsis: Born into a world where divine power defines status, Turan hides his true strength to live as a simple shepherd. Descended from a line of wizards yet raised in secrecy, he avoids the attention of powerful nobles who would exploit him. But when a wandering knight recognizes his extraordinary potential, Turan is faced with a life-changing choice. Will he remain in hiding, or journey to the capital and embrace the destiny he was meant for?

title: Even Without Your Love
synopsis: Daphne became Empress after marrying her first love in a world where political marriages are the norm. But her life begins to unravel when Rosetta, a blind woman, suddenly appears and claims to be carrying the Emperor’s child. Worse still, rather than deny it, the Emperor accepts Rosetta and grows cold toward Daphne. Then Mephis, a handsome court painter, enters her life with a bold and straightforward request: that she become his sponsor. As these two unexpected figures enter Daphne’s world, their sudden arrival suggests something far more than mere coincidence.

title: Resurrection Boy
synopsis:
Unkillable. Unstoppable. Still hunted.
Ji-o, a “Heart Mutant” with the Heart of Resurrection, escaped ten years of brutal experimentation, but freedom doesn’t last. With a body that can regenerate from any injury, he’s a target the world won’t ignore. The moment he finds something worth protecting, and even a sliver of a normal life, it’s threatened all over again by the very lab that tortured him and his friends. But this time, Ji-o is done running.


This series contains mature themes and disturbing imagery involving minors that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: I Dare You
synopsis:
Sarang Yu, a second-year in high school, has never really fit in. She isn’t exactly bullied, but her classmates keep singling her out, even pushing the dares from their humiliation games onto her. No one says it out loud, but everyone senses something seriously off about her as the games take on a darker, more unsettling edge. Will these games help Sarang finally find acceptance among her peers, or will the escalating dares reveal the twisted side everyone suspects is already there? 

This series contains mature themes such as extreme bullying and harassment that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: Rise of the Nobleman's Second Son
synopsis: Arad, once trapped in a ruthless company in his past life, is reborn as a noble in another world and lives the easy, carefree life he always wanted. But he has one frustration: every year, the once-in-a-lifetime “Divine Lottery” fails him, leaving him unable to use magic. Everything changes when he begins to see mysterious mana fragments left behind by spells. What’s more, by collecting them, he can learn those spells himself. What begins as a secret ability soon sets Arad on the path to becoming an unparalleled noble and legendary archmage.

title: Log into the Future
synopsis: 300 years ago, the world underwent a massive change, and rifts with monsters started to open up and threaten humankind. Though humans acquired new powers, it wasn't enough to combat the monsters. Sheng Lu was given a second chance at life in this apocalyptic world with the odds stacked against him. Not only was he born weak, but he is also haunted by nightmares that seem almost too real. However, one day, while suffering from another nightmare, he unlocks an unexpected super ability. Will he be able to use this ability to save the world?

title: Lumberjanes
synopsis: Friendship to the max! Jo, April, Mal, Molly and Ripley are five best pals determined to have an awesome summer together...and they’re not gonna let any insane quest or an array of supernatural critters get in their way! It’s Buffy the Vampire Slayer meets Gravity Falls, featuring five butt-kicking, rad teenage girls wailing on monsters and solving a mystery with the whole world at stake. Originally an award-winning comic series!

title: Situationship
synopsis:
Teagan Hargrove can handle just about anything: excelling in law school, balancing a demanding internship, and planning her best friend’s wedding—all while surviving the crushing expectations of her elite family. The one thing she can’t seem to handle? Bad sex.

After breaking up with her sexually inept boyfriend, Teagan is forced to face an entire wedding season painfully single—and the only other single person in her social circle is her childhood friend, Heath Reynolds. To make matters worse, they hate each other…but hate doesn’t cancel out attraction.

So when Heath proposes that they use each other to curb their sexual frustration, they strike a deal: a situationship. Pre-scheduled hookups. No strings attached.No commitment. Just a mutually beneficial arrangement to get them through the summer. 

It’s not supposed to mean anything.

Until it does.

title: Miles Morales: Spider-Man
synopsis: Saladin Ahmed shakes up the world of Miles Morales! The young Spider-Man has his hands full with adversaries including the Rhino, Tombstone and…Vice Principal Drutcher?! But is the high-flying Starling friend or foe? When an unknown assailant captures Miles, it sets in motion a series of events that will change his life - while an oddly familiar villain named Ultimatum threatens to destroy it! Meanwhile, the Morales family has a new arrival, the nation threatens to outlaw teen vigilantes, and Miles is about to face his own clone saga! But there are even bigger problems lurking - both in a dark future and out in the Multiverse!

title: Daredevil (2019)
synopsis: The next chapter in the ever-surprising saga of Daredevil! After a brush with death, Matt Murdock must piece together his shattered life - and that includes returning to action as Daredevil! But years of trauma have taken their toll, and becoming the guardian of Hell's Kitchen he once was won't be easy. Mistakes will be made along the way - and this time, one might actually prove to be the end of him.

title: Carnephelia's Curse is Never Ending
synopsis: Princess Carnephelia has been unloved and neglected until she meets Helis, her first love. However, under the evil plots of her stepbrother, Prince Ianfried, she ends up destroying the only boy she has ever loved. Devastated by what she's done, the princess swears revenge... even if it entails her life being cursed for eternity.

title: My Bias, My Boss
synopsis:
After celebrating her new job at her favorite idol Chan Lee’s company, Dareum wakes up to a nightmare: the man she drunkenly attacked while defending her oppa is actually Hagi Kang, the company’s CEO. And Chan? He barely comes to the office at all.
With only one shot at seeing Chan up close, an exclusive overseas company retreat, Dareum tries to cozy up to Hagi. But her attempts to stay on the CEO’s good side only convince him that she’s fallen for him. Even worse, Chan mistakes her nerves for hostility when they finally meet.
A fangirl, two powerful men, and one growing misunderstanding. Dareum’s dream romance might end before it even begins.

title: Archmage Curriculum
synopsis: Don’t judge a book by its cover! Eugene is a powerful mage whose appearance can frighten anyone out of their wits, but all this kind-hearted soul wants to do is teach Ain, the daughter of his master, so she can become the next archmage. Can his curriculum help her navigate through the world of magic and become the second-greatest mage of all time?

title: Protected by My Dragon Knight
synopsis:
Ichiru Futaba was just an ordinary office lady working at a high stress deadend job. One day, when she's pushed to her limit and cannot
get home in time to save her fluffy little dog, she falls to the floor unconscious.
When she awakens, she realizes that she...has died and been reborn!
In a new world where magical creatures and humans coexist, and where the sand rain that falls from the sky harms these magical creatures,
Ichiru struggles to form relationships due to her dark past.
One day, when she finds a dragon on the brink of death, Ichiru summons a power she never knew she had.
As a bright light comes from the palm of her hand, hope is reborn!
Can she use her healing powers that only she has to save these furry magical creatures...?!
From the creator of Taberareusa, Umibird, comes a fantastic new royal romance fantasy manga!

title: I Got Pregnant with the Tyrant's Child
synopsis: For Elan the royal knight, the masquerade festival is a rare chance to let loose and relax. But her night of fun quickly turns into a morning of horror when she wakes up beside the ruthless Emperor Kylart. Knowing how cruel he can be to clingy women, Elan makes a run for it, hoping he hasn't seen past her disguise. But as she continues her nerve-wracking duties of guarding the emperor, she starts experiencing troubling health symptoms. A trip to the doctor reveals that she's pregnant! To make matters worse, rumor has it that Kylart is looking for the mysterious woman he met on the night of the festival. Can Elan keep her secret safe from the entire palace, when she can't even control her constant cravings and morning sickness?

title: Mimosa
synopsis:
The war around the Curtains at the center of the world came to a close. But war was not the only thing left after the Curtains fell.
Those who pursue the Curtains, those who seek to raise them,
those who wield special powers, living weapons of war,
those who disturb the peace, those who bring hope,
those who face the lives they’ve lived, and those who try to revive the corpses in the coffin on their backs.
We call them Actors.

title: Rewrite My Happy Ending
synopsis:
Reincarnated as the heroine of a novel she once read, Veronica seeks revenge against her tyrannical noble father. Amidst a web of intrigue, she cautiously aligns herself with the enigmatic Prince Lowen and Duke Evan, who happen to be Veronica's love interests and the suspects of her murder in her previous life! As Veronica carefully carries out her plans for revenge, she finds herself drawn to Lowen and Evan and unravels hidden truths about her past...

This series contains mature themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: INFINITE DECRYPTION: THE STRONGEST LEVEL 0
synopsis:
When mysterious monoliths crashed onto Earth, endless hordes of Calamity Beasts poured out, plunging humanity into a brutal war. In response, humanity awakened their last hope: the Transcenders.
After watching the beasts brutally murder his parents, Kael is driven by a single purpose: absolute revenge.
Years later, Kael awakens an ultra-rare class. The catch? His level is permanently capped. But he soon discovers a terrifying loophole—he can infinitely stack his stats by hacking his enemies' skills!
Surviving hellish trials, Kael catches the eye of humanity’s very first Transcender and becomes his protégé. With limitless power at his fingertips, Kael begins his ruthless climb to the apex. The beasts took everything from him—now, they will pay in blood!

title: Here Reigns the Vengeful Villainess
synopsis:
This series contains themes regarding child abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
Robellia isn't so foolish as to believe in a happy life. She was robbed of such flowery optimism the day her husband betrayed her and her child was lost. Now, armed with the power to exact revenge on those who scorned her, she's determined to expose the lies and deceit behind the empire she calls her home. But can she come out the other side as a redeemable person once all is said and done?

title: A Genius Martial Arts Girl
synopsis:
Master swordsman Hyeon Dokgo was crushed after being branded as the public enemy of the entire martial world. Broken in body and spirit, Hyeon believes his days and his troubles are finally over… until trouble finds him in the form of Somi, an adorable and unusually gifted little girl who refuses to leave his side.
 Through Somi, the battle-obsessed warrior who once dreamed of becoming the most feared name in Murim begins to discover the warmth of a heart he never knew existed.

title: Sheathe Your Sword in the Bedroom
synopsis:
This series contains mature themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
She was trained to kill. He was supposed to be the target. When assassin Yurian infiltrates the Argon Empire disguised as a princess bride, her mission is simple: murder Duke Larkan Blake on their wedding night and rescue her captive brother. But the notorious Duke is nothing like the monster she expected, and each night spent together makes it harder to carry out her revenge. Torn between duty and desire, will she choose love or vengeance?

title: Live Happily Ever After With My Ex’s Uncle
synopsis:
This series contains mature themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
Sylvia's past life was full of misery. She had taken the fall and served a prison sentence in order to marry her boyfriend, only to be cruelly betrayed by him and her sister upon her release. Now back in the past before all hell broke loose, she is determined to rectify all that went wrong. However, things aren’t so easy, and she lands herself in trouble… only to have a miracle come her way in the form of Tristan, her ex’s uncle. With Tristan by her side, she finds her chance to change everything for the better.

title: Goodbye My Juliet
synopsis:
Juliet in the story, Romeo and Juliet, is in quite a predicament because she’s actually a transmigrator from another world. She must escape the endless loop of bizarre yet tragic Shakespearean-esque endings by living happily ever after with Romeo if she wants to return to her world. However, this story contains unexpected twists and turns and intertwined destinies, unlike the version that Juliet had read. So will Juliet be able to navigate through all these challenges and find an ending that will leave everyone happy?
This series contains strong themes such as suicide that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: AIDIE
synopsis: Aidie is KN Group's mascot robot that has been greeting the employees every morning. Its creator, Professor Harvey, takes Aidie on the day of his resignation and risks his life to protect it from the company. What secrets does this one robot hold?

title: The Postman of the Apocalypse
synopsis: Jeongguk Woo delivers mail as a postman in a post-apocalyptic world and dreams of riding the subway.
