When headquarters announces plans to revive it, Jeongguk is eager to join, but government worker Yonghan Cho personally bans him, citing the lack of dangerous missions in Jeongguk’s file. Infuriated by the snub, Jeongguk accepts the deadly task of delivering a letter to the AAA, a militarized area infamous for refusing mail. Once he arrives, he discovers the letter is addressed to Yonghan's sisters, who beg him to help them escape. Will he follow the postman rules, or risk everything to help them?!

title: The Iron Overlord of Sichuan
synopsis:
Bearing the traitor’s brand, Se-un Tang spent a lifetime creating the tools of the Murim's destruction, waiting for a single moment to strike. 
But when the decisive moment comes, he is instead thrust back in time, carrying the weight of a future that hasn't happened. 
Let the furnace roar, let the hammer sing, and let their blood quench the steel. 
The Demon Smith stands before the anvil once more to forge a path tempered in vengeance.

title: A Warrior’s Daily Log
synopsis:
There is a land where elves and wizards roam, where warriors and demon kings clash for the fate of the world—and the name of this fantastical land is none other than… Seoul, South Korea?!
Sent by magic from his fantasy world to modern Seoul along with his party of colorful heroes, will former warrior and very ordinary student Huiwon be able to gather his party and save it from the “evils” of the Demon King?

title: Living with the Dangerous Beast
synopsis: Sohwa is a red fox with white hair, separated from her family and living alone in the mountains. One day, she comes across Dohwi, an injured and abandoned wild cat, and decides to take care of him. But little does she know that Dohwi is actually a fearsome tiger, reborn after a thousand years of life. Dohwi conceals his identity well, but as the years go by, he matures into quite the hunk and grows more and more attached to the beautiful fox. Sohwa grows suspicious amidst frightening dreams of being chased by a tiger, not to mention making steamy hot love with him, and their relationship is about to take a drastic turn... for better or worse.

title: Be a Bad Boy!
synopsis: Suyeon has a weakness for bad boys, a lingering habit from her toxic ex, Huiju. While her current boyfriend, Jehyeon, is sweet and gentle, Suyeon feels a strange sense of dissatisfaction. When Huiju suddenly reappears as her new team leader, Suyeon makes an impulsive wish—and the impossible happens. Overnight, Jehyeon transforms into the edgy bad boy of her dreams. But there’s a twist: when she arrives at work the next day, her "bad boy" ex has turned into a perfect gentleman. Between her bad boyfriend and good ex, Suyeon’s life gets complicated.

title: The Garden of Secrets
synopsis: When infamous mercenary Leopold Gregory gets falsely accused of murdering Hareid Bakadi, the last thing he expects is to wind up working for the dead man’s wife, Hena! He uses a fake name to further avoid detection and even winds up getting close to Hena’s son, Daniel. Leo intends to figure out who framed him, but along the way, he finds himself drawn to the mysterious lady of the house who still has no idea he’s a suspect in her husband’s murder. Will his search for the truth end up ruining what he’s built with Hena and Daniel?

title: My Meddler in Love
synopsis: Jiyu thought her first relationship would be nothing but happiness, until an uneasy suspicion takes root. Her boyfriend seems a little too attached to his female friend, and Jiyu can’t tell whether she’s being paranoid or not. Desperate for clarity, she downloads an AI dating advice app called Love Meddler. Instead of gentle reassurance, it hits her with brutal honesty. As the app starts “meddling” in her love life, Jiyu is left wondering how an AI understands her so well. The thing is, perhaps it’s not AI at all and rather someone who has recently re-entered her life…

title: A Crush Curse
synopsis:
Jugyeong is a powerhouse Chief Producer who has never felt a single spark of true love. But her life shatters when a rogue celestial’s forbidden arrow strikes her by mistake. Consumed by a supernatural fever, she stumbles into the arms of Hyeonu. One look at him is all it takes for the curse to ignite, forcing a desperate confession to a total stranger. Now, Jugyeong must navigate a cutthroat industry and a vengeful executive director.
In a world where a cold heart leads to a cold grave, can she turn a forced obsession into a love worth living for?

title: COPYCAT
synopsis:
A serial killer is staging corpses as “self-destruction art” and selling them to the ultra-wealthy for tens of millions. When failed artist Suchan Kim recognizes the concept as his own—stolen from an exhibition the world laughed into oblivion—his obsession with proving this mutates into something darker: a hunger for the recognition he never received. In a world where spectacle is worth more than life, will Suchan expose the killer, or become part of the masterpiece?


[This series contains depictions of disturbing imagery that may be upsetting for some readers.]

title: Assistant Manager Kim Hates K-Pop Idols
synopsis: Assistant Manager Yiwol Kim has spent five years working a day job—and five years doing “stand-in stanning” for his boss’s daughter’s favorite idol group, spArk. During yet another spArk-related overtime, he collapses… and wakes up nine years in the past with a second chance at life. But this chance comes with a cruel condition: to undo his sister’s death, Yiwol must debut as a member of spArk himself. Thrown into the idol life he never wanted, he’ll have to survive fame, internal politics, and his own reluctant heart.

title: Overwatch: Undivided
synopsis: In the aftermath of Talon’s strike on Watchpoint: Gibraltar, the heroes of Overwatch take in their devastating defeat. But Vendetta is far from finished, launching attacks around the world on research facilities, military bases, and major cities. As Sojourn rallies the weary heroes to face Talon wherever they strike, she receives crushing news that calls everything she’s stood for into question: When the world says it doesn’t need heroes, can Overwatch still stand, undivided?

title: Daytime in the Bunker
synopsis: Seou always knew that running away from the son of a murderer would eventually haunt her, but she never expected to be locked underground with him. Years after she abandoned Wonhyeok following a bloody secret on some stairs, a twist of fate traps them together in the suffocating darkness of an abandoned bunker. As the heavy door clicks shut, Seou must decide if the boy she betrayed is here to finally protect her, or if he’s been waiting all these years to exact his revenge.

title: The Sword-Eating Swordmaster
synopsis:
Only a swordmaster can slay another.
Arhan believed the tales of Liam Karavan, the founding father of his house, were nothing more than legend, until a deadly swordmaster slaughtered everyone dear to him.
In his darkest hour, Liam comes to him as a guiding spirit, revealing the true power of their bloodline--the power to devour blades and inherit the strength and memories held within.
With each sword consumed, Arhan draws one step closer to vengeance.
To avenge his loved ones and restore House Karavan to its former glory, he must survive the perilous path to becoming a swordmaster.

title: Greedy
synopsis:
After five years of devotion, Yuju Han was dumped by her boyfriend for her best friend. With nowhere to vent her rage, she crosses paths with Tae-i Go, the nation's hottest and most controversial superstar. He’s wealthy, breathtaking… and terminally ill.
When a fake dating scandal between the two sets the internet ablaze, Tae-i offers Yuju a "golden ticket": a chance to turn her life into a masterpiece of revenge. The price? Just a little bit of love.
Will Yuju remain a victim, or will she finally get greedy?

title: Wings of Starlight
authors: Allison Saft,STACY KING,ALICE BORGANTI,SARA CERUTTI,CLAUDIA COCCI,ALESSIA MONTAGNER,RACHTA LIN,GIANLUCA GRASSO,ARANCIA STUDIO
synopsis: It’s been centuries since a warm-season fairy in Pixie Hollow has crossed into the Winter Woods, and while most fear the legends of monsters lurking in the frozen lands, Clarion, can’t help being intrigued by Winter’s stoic beauty. But under the watchful eyes of the current monarch and the court’s seasonal ministers, Clarion has little time to dwell on daydreams while the days to her coronation dwindle away. That is, until reports of a monster crossing from Winter into Spring make their way to the palace. But instead of finding a monster at the edge of Winter, she finds Milori, a young guardian of the Winter Woods. Together, they form an unlikely bond as they race to save their lands. But as their alliance warms to something more, they will discover there is a reason a warm-season fairy and a winter fairy must not be together. And the cost could be just as deadly as the monsters that prowl the Winter Woods.

title: One Night After 19 Years
synopsis: Eunseol Jeong and Yusin Ma have been inseparable since they were children, but lately, something has shifted. Returning from his army service, Yusin is often sought after by girls in Eunseol’s orbit, all while he has been quietly shielding Eunseol from guys interested in her. When their families go on vacation together, Eunseol and Yusin find the boundary of their friendship tested. Together, they’ll have to decide – what if their relationship was never just friendship?

title: The Glutton: Devourer of Kings
synopsis:
Humanity's world was destroyed by the Demon Kings. Stripped of everything, Awakener Ash Si sacrificed himself in a devastating explosion to drag Demon King Voralune, The Glutton, down to hell.
Instead of death, he opens his eyes ten years in the past, long before the tragedy occurred. He discovers his powers have awakened early, and surprisingly, he also possesses Voralune’s power of Gluttony.
Armed with this advantage, Ash decides to act in advance. With his return, everything in the world seems to be changing...

title: Disqualified Friend
synopsis: Haesu and Jinheon are childhood friends, but Haesu has a boyfriend and Jinheon is a gruff star athlete who just loves to tease her. After Haesu is dumped by her boyfriend Jeong-un because she just doesn’t do it for him anymore, Haesu is understandably distraught and turns to Jinheon for a man’s perspective. Little does she know that her tearful bid for validation will spark a flame that could threaten their 13-year friendship…

title: The Intrigues of the Chevalier D'Eon
authors: Lucile Guyot,Li Lu,Original Universe Creators,Stephan Boschat
synopsis:
Versailles, 1756.
At the court of King Louis XV, everyone is talking about Chevalier Charles d’Éon de Beaumont, a mysterious androgynous figure as beautiful as he is intelligent, who draws every gaze and every desire.
Alexandre is 21 years old. For the past three years, he has served as Charles’s squire, quietly suffering from an impossible love for the master to whom he is utterly devoted. At times, he dares to hope for more as their bond deepens, yet he fears being cast aside one day in favor of someone more interesting.
Sent to Saint Petersburg on a spying mission, the two men cross paths with Gaïa Vassilievna Parchoukova, a young woman as dangerous as she is intriguing, who may well become their downfall. When reality forces the heart back into line, masks begin to fall, and by the time they return to Versailles, nothing may ever be the same again.

title: Royal Wedding
synopsis:
This series contains mature themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.
His Royal Highness of Wistad has a secret: not only is he an Omega, but he's a mere puppet of the Alpha he's trapped in a relationship with. Suffocated by this one-sided imprinting, he seeks a way out--and it comes in the form of Marstiel, the richest Alpha in the kingdom. Marstiel is rumored to hold the secret to undoing an Alpha's imprint, but is His Highness willing to pay the price?

title: A Princess’s Guide to Save the Dragons
synopsis: Yumi Clarke was literally worked to death by endless overtime. But her lifelong wish of being spoiled comes true when she reincarnates as a video game princess. Wealth and luxury are finally hers… until palace politics turn deadly. Yumi’s brother plots rebellion, the elven emperor wages war against dragons, and the handsome stranger who rescues her turns out to be Qastor Ace, the dragon prince himself. Caught between warring factions, Yumi must decide whether to play the role she was given or rewrite the game routes entirely.

title: Necromancer, the Ultimate Scourge!
synopsis: In a world where magic and monsters exist, Lin Moyu has hit the age of acquiring his very own profession. While most would be lucky just to obtain a high-level combat class, Moyu becomes the ultrarare necromancer! Being the first and only one of his kind, he has no idea of the potential he possesses on his journey to level up and face great challenges. What new heights will Moyu achieve with his unique army of undead?

title: The Possessed Acting Prodigy
synopsis: Struggling actor Hyeonsu Kim suddenly gains a strange ability after an accident: he can dream the dreams of the dead. These aren’t hazy nightmares or random visions, but vivid relivings of emotions and experiences that don’t belong to him. When Hyeonsu channels those experiences into his roles, his acting becomes terrifyingly real, as if he’s truly possessed. But how far can a haunted genius go before the dreams start consuming him?

title: Non Tua
synopsis:
Vibia has served as a Vestal Virgin since childhood, sworn to chastity and charged with guarding the sacred flame of Vesta. Breaking her vow means death. Her ordered life collapses when she is pulled into the lethal intrigues of Emperor Domitian’s court. Behind its beauty and splendor lurks Julia, charming and dangerously manipulative. Drawn into a tense triangle with the mysterious freedman Leonides and the hardened centurion Quintus Sirius Aquila, Vibia must navigate a treacherous landscape where her vows of purity become political weapons, her every action is watched, and one misstep could mean death in the clash between holiness and the corrupting force of imperial power.
This series contains depictions of mature content that may be not be suitable for some viewers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: Mickey x F1®: Racing to the Top!
synopsis: The Duckburg F1 fan club, leaded by Mickey Mouse, is invited to shadow a racing team to create a behind-the-scenes documentary. But when that team suddenly collapses at the very beginning of the season, Mickey Mouse, Donald Duck and friends step up to keep the project alive, filling key roles themselves and recommending Jun, a talented taxi driver chasing his lifelong dream of winning Formula 1, only to discover his teammate is his sister Lia, his ultimate rival who left him in the dust years before. Will Jun, with the help of Mickey Mouse, be able to overcome the old grudge, make peace with his sister and finally play as a team? It will be a long journey, to be covered at full speed on the Grand Prix tracks!

title: Night Shift in Another World
synopsis: Chan Lee thought his life hit rock bottom when he lost his office job. Then he started working at a convenience store connected to another world. With customers ranging from dog men to goblins and dragon girls, every shift brings new chaos. Between supernatural mishaps and late-night shifts, Chan soon builds an unlikely community of loyal regulars.

title: Reborn to Choose My Own Male Lead
synopsis: She dumps the male protagonist callously only to find that she's betrothed to an overbearing man from another novel.

title: Rise of the Dragon Overlord
synopsis: Luke Foster thought he was doomed when he awakened as a Dragon Tamer, the most useless hidden profession in existence. Dragons are so rare and powerful that for eight centuries, no Dragon Tamer has ever succeeded in taming a dragon. But without one, he can't even unlock his basic skills, leaving him powerless in a world ruled by fighters. Then everything changes after Luke activates the Super Treasure Map System. The mysterious system leads him to the ultimate prize: a real dragon egg! And so, this "weak" Dragon Tamer is about to flip the world upside down.

title: Daughter of a Superstar
synopsis:
Rumin is an acting prodigy with a Newtube channel that often goes viral. As it happens, she is also the spitting image of her favorite A-list actor Hajin Jeong. A shocking turn of events reveals that Hajin is actually Rumin’s biological father. The cold-hearted actor reluctantly takes her in, but pointedly vows no affection. However, as Rumin’s raw talent shines, Hajin finds himself becoming an unlikely mentor. Having long fantasized about Hajin being her father, can Rumin finally make her dreams a reality? 

This series contains strong themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: The Aura of a Genius Actor
synopsis: Struggling actor Yu-myeong Shin has spent the last 15 years of his life trying to make it big, but has always failed to. After a devastating cancer diagnosis, he’s drowning his sorrows when a yeon-gwi, an acting ghost, appears and offers to send him back in time and with an added boost of life energy to start his career over. Yu-myeong leaps at the chance and becomes a college student once more, running into Ryushin Seo, his one-time rival. But this time, Yu-myeong has the acting chops to back him up, and even Ryushin will have to acknowledge him!

title: The Reborn Prodigy of the Ducal Family
synopsis: Once the commander-in-chief of Earth’s resistance and a legendary monster hunter, Hanseong was dragged into another world and enslaved by the Empire through a binding spell. For ten long years, he fought their wars, crushed their enemies, and was discarded like a weapon. But death wasn’t his end. Revived by the Stone of Reincarnation, he awakens as Dale, the heir to a powerful ducal house. With unmatched brilliance and a burning desire for revenge, Hanseong begins his second life to destroy the Empire that once enslaved him.

title: The Legend of AAAA
synopsis: An ordinary villager is tasked with accompanying a hero who smashes every crate and pot he comes across on his journey! Can this sort of hero truly stop the Demon King and save the world?

title: Ankle Breaker
synopsis: A crushing defeat in middle school drove Gang-hwi away from basketball. Even as a freshman at Jeon-gwang High, famous for its explosive run-and-gun style, he wants nothing to do with the game. Instead, he channels his competitive drive into one-upping Ilrok, his towering freshman rival. But when their fierce rivalry leads to a one-on-one on the basketball court, Gang-hwi’s spectacular ankle breaker changes everything, with the varsity coach calling him the missing piece for a national championship run. Can the undersized speedster be the key to championship glory?

title: There's No Such Thing as a Bad Lady
synopsis: Raised in the slums of Ebelstein, Derek knows all too well that magic cannot bridge social divides. Through harsh lessons and hard-earned discipline, he rises to become a second-tier mage, scraping by as a mercenary. Life takes a different turn when he is appointed as a magical tutor to Diella Duplain-- the temperamental youngest daughter of a noble house, unable to wield magic despite her lineage. Though Derek is her last resort before exile to a convent, Diella clashes with him from the start. Together, will they be able to prove that there’s no such thing as a “bad” lady?

title: Pretty Collection
synopsis:
Mocked for having top-tier talent but the worst looks, Yeppeum Kim falls into despair, betrayed by those she trusted and robbed of everything she worked for. But then, a seeming miracle transforms her into someone breathtakingly beautiful. In the following days, she watches a dreamlike new life unfold before her eyes. Fame, attention, and endless praise are intoxicating, but something feels off. Soon, she realizes this beauty isn’t a blessing. It is a curse.
[This series contains strong themes and disturbing imagery.]

title: A Delinquent’s First Love
synopsis: Shy and lonely college junior Dorae Lee never expects to see her high school crush again until she runs into Haewon Cha, who’s just as handsome as she remembers. When Haewon suddenly confesses his feelings, Dorae is completely thrown off. Because one, he already has a popular girlfriend who happens to be Dorae’s friend, and two, he believes he’s still eighteen years old. After a car accident erased five years of his memories, Haewon is stuck in the past and determined to make Dorae his girlfriend. Now the two are confronted by the question: Can first love survive reality?

title: Too Many Heroes for the Demon Lord
synopsis: Berje Deias was once a by-the-book Demon King, but after being reborn, he is determined to break every rule there is. His second attempt at life, however, takes a chaotic turn when a kidnapping of a princess doesn’t quite go to plan! Can he defeat an entire continent of heroes with his wild, untested methods?!

title: A Wimp’s Tower Strategy Guide
synopsis: Mysterious black towers have appeared all over the world. Inside them are monsters, danger, and the promise of power and fame. Only a select few are chosen to enter as players. Everyone calls it a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, but 25-year-old Juhyeok Bong calls it a death sentence. He is a timid, anxious self-proclaimed “wimp,” perfectly content with staying under the radar… That is, until he is named as a player. Will he risk everything by entering the tower, or keep running from the one chance that could change his life?

title: Reincarnated as the Grand Duke’s Third Son
synopsis: Born at the bottom of society, Jake survives by leading Sabertooth, a mercenary group loyal to him. Yet he is ultimately betrayed and killed by the nobles he served. But instead of death, he awakens to a new life with soft, frail hands and the title of the third son of House Valdek, the most powerful family in the empire, rivaling even the crown. Surrounded by wealth and splendor, Jake realizes he has been granted a second chance to fulfill his ambition. So he sets off, determined to rise as high as possible. Look out, world, here comes Lucian Valdek!

title: My Wavering Husband
synopsis:
The timing couldn't be worse. Sohui is pregnant, and her divorce from Jihyeok is already in motion. She spent three years trying to earn his love before deciding that holding on was merely a selfish dream. Now, she must protect her unborn child from a marriage that was never meant to be. Or was it?

As Jihyeok faces the crushing void left by the divorce, his own family moves to sabotage his position at the company. Between corporate traps and a secret that could change everything, what is in store for this star-crossed couple?

title: Observing My Mom’s Friend’s Son
synopsis: Se-i Lim spends time with her mother, Hyejeong, at Taeseung Mall, where they meet Myeonghyeon, the mall’s CEO. Myeonghyeon asks Se-i to tutor her son, Seunghyo. However, Se-i accidentally walks in on Seungju, Seunghyo’s older brother, naked. Seungju accuses Se-i of being a pervert, but Myeonghyeon doesn’t believe him. Seungju insists Se-i is the only one who has seen him naked, and Myeonghyeon, confused, wonders if Seungju might be gay. Concerned, Myeonghyeon asks Se-i to investigate Seungju for three months. Will Se-i uncover the truth?

title: The Final Case
synopsis:
Late-stage cancer. 3 months to live. How will retired detective Insu Kang make the most of it? When seeing the death-row convicts he arrested all escape from a prison van, he finds his answer: finish the job. It’s something he could never do as an officer, but the law didn’t do its duty. The problem is all the escaped convicts are moving far too swiftly for it to be a coincidence. They have someone behind the scenes giving them a helping. And this someone also has Insu’s daughter in their sights.

This series contains strong themes and disturbing imagery.

title: The Player with 13 Hidden Traits
synopsis:
In the game world of Pangaenia, Hyeonmyeong is known as “the Phantom,” an anonymous legend admired by players. In real life, however, he is jobless and still getting over his recent breakup.
When his character is killed and permanently deleted, his only remaining goal to become the first gamer to beat Pangaenia is shattered. Soon, however, Pangaenia begins to merge with the real world, and Hyeonmyeong gets a chance to start over--this time, with 13 hidden traits.

title: Spring Fever
synopsis: Bom Yun is a shy and overworked high school ethics teacher who’s assigned to the most avoided class at Shinsu High School. The cause of its reputation is Jaegyu Seon, a confrontational guardian who terrifies the faculty. Yet as Bom gets to know him, she discovers a devoted uncle with an unexpectedly tender heart. Though Bom tries to keep her distance when Jaegyu openly pursues her, she soon finds herself hopelessly falling for this quirky but charming giant of a man.

title: Black Panther: A Nation Under Our Feet
synopsis: National Book Award winner and New York Times Best-Selling author Ta-Nehisi Coates confronts Black Panther with dramatic upheaval in this astounding run. When a superhuman terrorist group sparks an uprising, Wakanda will be thrown into turmoil! A group of heroes, including Storm and Luke Cage, come together to aid T’Challa, but can Wakanda’s king survive this tidal wave of change?

title: Veteran of the Apocalypse
synopsis:
When Seongho logs off Survival Life for the final time, the last thing he expects is for the video game to become reality. Worse still, the game is set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies and deadly monsters. 
Having awakened as a hunter with the ability to open dimensional gates, Seongho rushes to build a hideout in another realm in order to survive as he works to level up his skills and abilities, preparing to save the world from impending doom.
But with other hunters emerging and forming parties, there may be more to worry about than just monsters…

title: Mirror World: God-Tier Revenge
synopsis:
Fifty years after the fusion of the Game World and Reality, a top-tier warrior emerged. He dedicated his life to the world but was ultimately killed by the highest authority out of fear.
Before his death, he awakened the SSS-Rank hidden skill [Mirror World] and sealed his soul beneath the surface of a lake. The King covered up the history and fabricated a new one; from then on, the warrior was known to the world as a traitor.
Decades later, the warrior has awakened in the body of a dying man, using the [Mirror World] skill to begin his revenge.

title: The Goddess of Abundance and Her Troublemaker Apostle
synopsis:
Earth’s life force is depleted, and it’s dying. Humanity’s only hope lies with Dispatchers, heroes sent to otherworldly realms to retrieve energy for survival. Chansu Oh is one of them, but despite his legendary father, he has zero talent.
However, things change when Chansu is sent to the Block-Style Territory Expansion World as the Apostle of a forgotten, weakened Goddess of Abundance. Armed with nothing but a modified harvesting skill and a desperate drive to find his parents, Chansu must reclaim his territory block by block. From wretched outcast to genius apostle, the hunt to restore his Goddess begins now!

title: Defiance of the Fall
synopsis: Zac is in the middle of the forest when the world changes. The whole planet is introduced to the multiverse by an unfeeling System. Alone, surrounded by deadly beasts, demons, and worse, Zac must find the means to survive, get stronger, and seek out his lost family in this new cut-throat reality with only a hatchet for his weapon... or die trying.

title: The Otherworldly Genius Method Actor
synopsis: Ujin Kang is an ordinary nobody—until one day, he gains a strange ability. Whenever he reads a script or screenplay, he’s pulled into a mysterious dimension where he can relive the character’s experiences. When he ends up showcasing a performance born from that dimension, his acting is so overwhelming that it leads to a massive misunderstanding. Mistaken for a once-in-a-generation acting prodigy, Ujin is suddenly thrust into a world of media and celebrities far beyond his quiet, insignificant life.

title: Duchess's Lo-Fi Coffeehouse
synopsis:
Loanna was raised in neglect and isolation as an illegitimate child of the Count Louis family. She gets married off to Duke Bruggen, who orders her to keep quiet and out of the way. Free from all expectations or responsibilities, she roams around the castle and runs into a coffee bush.
A passionate barista in her past life, Loanna remembers exactly how to brew a perfect cup of Joe. The trouble is, no one in this realm seems to know what “coffee” is, nor its wonderful benefits. As a matter of fact, coffee fruits are regarded as “evil”.
As a coffee aficionado, Loanna is determined to turn this reputation around.
This series contains strong themes such as child abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: Marriage of Convenience to an Obsession
synopsis:
Olga devotes a thousand days in prayer for her husband to sit on the throne, only to be killed at the hands of her cheating husband.
The goddess brings her back as her half-sister for a second chance at life, but she still finds herself at the risk of marrying her murderous and adulterous ex-husband once again.
Her only hope is to propose a marriage of convenience to the Beast of the Duchy, but a strange turn of events leaves the reluctant duke little choice but to accept the offer.
Now, the unlikely newlyweds face struggles on both ends – avenging Olga’s death and figuring out how to share a bed together.

title: Everybody Loves the Villainess
synopsis: After a lifetime of pious devotion, High Priest Sia expects a tranquil death. Instead, she finds herself reborn into the body of the universally despised Elena. Just as she adjusts to her scandalous new life, men from her past begin to reappear. The twist? These seemingly virtuous men are now inexplicably obsessed with her villainous new self. Sia hoped for eternal peace, but it seems her former followers have more earthly and amusingly persistent intentions for her second life!

title: Kariel the Warrior
synopsis: In a world where warriors are chosen to wield a holy sword and defeat the Demon Lord every hundred years, Kariel is only a guide, bound to support others from the sidelines. He dreams of rising beyond his rank, but the Demon Lord of this era has already been slain. Despite this, the world begins to unravel instead of heal. Monsters grow unpredictable, a mysterious knight hunts champions, and secret organizations move in the shadows. Traveling with his childhood friend Reina, Kariel is drawn into a dangerous mystery that may determine the fate of the world.

title: For Your Perfect Ending
synopsis:
After being killed by the obsessive male lead Killian, Ines finds herself back in the real world as Sum. Determined to live differently this time, Sum resolves to finally claim a happy ending.
But to her shock, she meets Haewon Lee, a school celebrity who looks exactly like Killian. As Sum grows confused by Haewon’s kindness-- so unlike the arrogant and violent Killian she once knew-- Haewon hides his true intentions, carefully shaping himself into someone Sum would love. What awaits them in the future?

title: The Cleaner
synopsis: Isu Jin’s seemingly ordinary life comes to a violent end when he and his father are suddenly targeted by a powerful conglomerate. He survives. But his father does not. In a world where crime and authority are one and the same, Isu enters the underworld to hunt the truth. His fight is no longer just for revenge… It’s to expose a corrupt empire, no matter the cost.

title: Until the Soul of the Fallen Queen Knows Love
synopsis: Born ungifted in a world ruled by supernatural abilities, Learis Graine survives years of neglect and cruelty until she awakens the most exceptional gift, along with memories of a past life as a queen. Determined not to repeat her tragic fate, she hides her new power and chooses life among the ungifted. But when Prince Edward Laybatein uncovers her secret, he does the unthinkable and declares her his fiancée before all the guests at the grand ball. Thrust into royal intrigue against her wishes, Learis must decide whether she can rewrite destiny and build a world where one’s innate power no longer defines their worth.

title: Before the Grapes Ripen
synopsis: Every month, Suyeong’s mother receives one million won—money bound to a life-saving debt from years ago. After losing contact with the family behind it, Suyeong goes on with her life, unaware of how closely their paths will soon cross again. Transferred to a newly formed content team, she meets her new manager, Tae-eun—the same man she once saw publicly disgraced months earlier. Bound by an unspoken past and a debt neither of them chose, they keep their distance. But how long can that last?

title: I'd Rather Live as a Villain
synopsis: After years of hiding his brilliance as a loyal executive aide, Taesik Yun finally has the chance to face the superiors who once stole his work and destroyed his reputation. He secures his seat as the new Division Director through a high-stakes, 10-billion-won contract marriage to his boss, Munjeong Kang -- the fierce legitimate heir fighting to keep her empire from her illegitimate brother. But as he steps into the spotlight to claim his revenge -- can Taesik survive the cutthroat succession war while navigating a fake marriage that feels increasingly real?

title: Please Assist with This S-Class Mission
synopsis: After a decade stuck as an E-Class hunter, Hara is suddenly hit with an S-Class Awakening Quest: date the nation’s beloved news anchor, Seheon. There’s just one problem—he’s tied to an embarrassing event from her past she’d rather forget. Still, the promise of S-Class power is too tempting to ignore, so Hara proposes a contractual relationship to Seheon. What starts as a desperate deal for “Official S-Class Mission Assistance” quickly turns into a strange, unpredictable romance.

title: The Divine Ring Descends: The Strongest Otherworld
synopsis:
When darkness invades the city, zillions of human warriors come into being, but Aiden isn't one of them. One day, he comes across a mysterious ring and is sent into the Orc Realm where humans are forbidden, by a treaty. He magically survives his execution, lifts the Orc Tribe's sacred hammer, and becomes the tribe leader. Just then, he is transported back to his original reality.

This series contains strong themes and graphic depictions of bullying and discrimination.

title: The Mighty Delinquent of the Dan Clan
synopsis: Hongmun was a lowly warrior who secretly mastered the Dan Clan’s forbidden martial arts. In a battle against the Black Flame Sect, he met his death. But when he opened his eyes, he had become Wolbin Dan, the infamous fourth young master of the Dan Clan. Now blessed with a body perfectly suited for the martial arts, he is determined to rewrite the past and prevent the destruction of the Dan Clan with his own hands.

title: Emblem Wars
synopsis: Among the numerous emblems to exist, only one is said to be cursed with the fate of ruin—the Emblem of Asura. After a man who serves an unseen will reduces Vahn’s life to ashes and casts him into a timeless abyss, Vahn endures 999 long years of torment before awakening the true power of ruin. Reborn as vengeance incarnate, his retribution begins.

title: Boy4Friends
synopsis: Ji-in Yang is just an average otaku until a boy who looks exactly like her favorite anime character transfers to her class. Mireu Shin is overly friendly from the start, and she eats up the attention, much to the dismay of her longtime friend, Bongjun Choi, who begins expressing his feelings more openly. Even Dongsu Mun, her quiet academy comrade, wants to spend more time with her. To complicate things further, swimming sensation Hyeonu Gwon appears, acting like they’ve known each other for years. Suddenly, it feels like every guy in Ji-in’s life wants to keep her all to himself!

title: The Nine Cloud Dream: Zero
synopsis: Soyu Yang is better than you and he knows it. Even in his dreams, he is the chosen one. A martial arts grand master, Yukgwan, speaks to him in a dream and brings him into a parallel world with superhuman abilities and “errors,” mutations that turn you into a monster. One of these errors is a former disciple of Yukgwan, now a dragon, and terrorizing the parallel world. Soyu and Kara, his anti-romantic partner, are chosen to hunt the dragon, but Soyu meets another who says he’s the fake version of him…

title: My Desire is Not a Sin
synopsis: On their ninth anniversary, Ian receives what seems like a perfect gift, a building in the most coveted part of the city for the expansion of her art gallery. With the steamy night that followed afterward, it was set to become the most romantic anniversary ever… until her husband sneaks out in the middle of the night to cheat on her.

title: My Bias is Obsessed with Me
synopsis: Seha lives for Alexandrite, her favorite character in a dating sim game. When she learns he dies in other routes, the shock sends her into the game itself as Lady Arianell, a minor side character. Determined to save him, she decides to play the villain and force his romance with the heroine. Her plan seems simple until Alexandrite falls for her instead, his flirtatious brother also takes an interest, and the story veers wildly off-script. Can she save her fave without becoming his downfall?

title: Love Thy Enemy
synopsis:
"You were the most worthy opponent I had... Farewell, Beatrice."
Sierratica Tiar Yerphinen, my sworn enemy.
I died by his sword... until I didn't?!

Beatrice Shelle Marcean wakes up five years after the day of her death in a new kingdom—a new body, in a new family. She has gone from duchess to princess—and the man from her past, Sierratica Yerphinen, barges into her land to offer a treaty. He is now an emperor, seeking a bride from her new bloodline! Now living as princess Shroina, our female lead must do whatever it takes to push away from his pull. She won't repeat the same mistake twice.

title: The Second Male Lead is Actually a Girl
synopsis: Rosa remembers her past life. She remembers reading about the Helios Empire in a novel before dying suddenly in an accident. Reborn as Rosa Veronica, she works hard to make ends meet until someone from the Duke of Estella's estate comes to fetch her. Meeting her biological father turns her life upside down as she's forced to live the life of Rozenta Estella, the sole heir and only son of the Duke of Estella. She decides to embrace this new life as the narrative unfolds. Despite knowing the story, she's surprised the male and female leads have not become the characters she's read about. Rosa learns to navigate Rozenta's life while fostering a budding friendship with Theodore and Vivian, though happiness doesn't last as all three grow up and enter the roles they've been born into.

title: I Thought I was the Real Daughter
synopsis:
Selena’s whole world is turned upside down when Sienna, the daughter of a maid, suddenly claims that she’s the real daughter of Count Estarion.
Sienna remembers everything about Selena’s childhood, making everyone believe that she’s the real daughter. Her once supportive brother and father, who are everything to her, turn cold and kick her out of the house. Even her close friend and fiance turn their backs on her.
With nowhere to go, she is saved by the only person who treats with her kindness, Eideun Calypso, a war hero who was once a lowly slave. He asks Selena to be his private tutor and teach him high society etiquette.
Why is Eideun being so generous to her? Will Selena be able to find out the truth about her identity? Will she take revenge on those who betrayed her trust?

This series contains strong themes and graphic depictions of abuse.

title: The Devilishly Trash Duke
synopsis:
After a fatal tragedy, our heroine wakes up as an unknown character named Aurora in a novel she has once read. While coming to grips with her new reality, she’s sent to marry the Duke of Ettica, a.k.a. infamous piece of trash. This trash duke knows no bounds!

"Could you punch me right now?" Not only is he a scumbag, but he's a perv too?!

"If I end up falling for you, I will become your loyal little dog." What has Aurora gotten herself into?

Perhaps it’s the start of puppy love…? Or perhaps it’s leading to something more…

title: Superhuman Streamer
synopsis:
Uhyeon Baek logs into Reverse Planet expecting a VR game, only to discover that the world is painfully real. A decade of grief and experiments turns him into a superhuman contract killer, and he finally executes the director behind his suffering. But when he returns to his original life, the ghosts of his fallen companions follow him. Haunted and restless, he goes back to Reverse Planet, only to realize he's entered the real game this time. Paired with superstar streamer Soyul Kang, his lethal efficiency goes viral... and puts him on the conspirator's radar.
"This series contains depictions of disturbing imagery that may be upsetting for some readers."

title: Sweet Romance, Spicy Roommates
synopsis: Eunseol unexpectedly runs into her high school ex, U-hyeon, after years of separation. Their reunion quickly becomes awkward, but after some drinks, the tension fades, and a drunken kiss leads to a night at a motel. The next morning, Eunseol panics, unable to remember the night. As she tries to move on, she’s confronted by her past when she runs into her ex. Will she overcome the past and rekindle things with U-hyeon?

title: My Very Own Akashic Records
synopsis: Yuya Shirasaki is a weak Awakened with no Natural Skill--a fact that causes his death in Earth’s final apocalyptic monster invasion in 2034. But when he opens his eyes again, he finds himself 10 years in the past and poised to use his knowledge of the future to save Arisa Miyanaga, a similarly weak guildmate. Doing so unlocks his Unique Skill, Akashic Records, which gives him perfect knowledge of any dungeon. However, the guildmaster of his old guild seeks to hasten a catastrophic monster attack, which Yuya must stop. Can he save the world this time around?

title: Star Wars™: Darth Maul - Black, White & Red
synopsis: One of the most famous villains in STAR WARS lore stars in epic tales illustrated in stark black and white — and his own iconic red! When a prison ship — transporting a cult known as the Final Occultation — goes offline, Darth Maul is sent by Palpatine to investigate. What he finds on board is the stuff of nightmares! On another mission to singlehandedly conquer a mining colony, unexpected opposition leads him into an intense battle of life and death — and Maul learns one of his most valuable lessons! He may be fiercely loyal to his master and a true believer in the Sith, but will a journey to a remote moon change his mind? And why has Palpatine sent his apprentice to an ancient world? And who will pay the price…for patience?

title: Fence
synopsis: Scrappy fencer Nicholas Cox has big dreams of following in the footsteps of the father he’s never known, but when he’s accepted into the elite Kings Row boarding school, he’s thrust into a world of cutthroat competition. Facing down privileged classmates, grueling tryouts, and the stuffy rules of his new school, Nicholas discovers that it will take more than determination to prove himself worthy of a place on the team. And when his roommate ends up being his rival, the seemingly unbeatable Seiji Katayama, he'll have even more competition to contend with—on the piste and in his heart.

title: His Recovery Magic Worked Too Well!
synopsis: Neglected and abused for killing her mother in childbirth, Patricia Alben leaves home at an early age to join the army, where she thrives thanks to her exceptional mana. There, she meets Theo, a bastard prince assigned to her unit. Pity turns into closeness as she trains him, until they’re sent on a suicide mission where Patricia is gravely injured saving Theo. Healed by Theo’s magic, she awakens as a child and is adopted by her former family. Meanwhile, Theo slaughters his own family and claims the throne…

title: Becoming A Family With The Duke and His Dear Son
synopsis: After being transmigrated as Ibellia the Villainess, Soyoon strives to twist the plot in order to survive in her favorite web novel. Her plan is to break off the engagement with Duke Cassis Adelhardt and live a quiet life on her own. However, the Duke and his young son Lucius would not let her go so easily. “Lady Ibellia... Will you be Lus’ mommy?”

title: The Archmage Becomes the Swordmaster's Youngest Daughter
synopsis: Rosette was a mage and assassin who lived as a mere tool, mistaking control for love, until her choices led her to kill Duke Adrian, the Empire’s legendary swordmaster. Haunted by regret, she uses ancient magic to send herself back in time and fix everything that went wrong. However, although she succeeds in returning to her childhood, she ends up being adopted by the very duke she murdered in her past life. Will Rosette’s knowledge of both magic and the future be enough to rewrite a tragic destiny and change fate itself?

title: Rebirth of the Divine Demon
synopsis: Feared as the Divine Demon, Cheon Jeong lived and died on the battlefield, knowing nothing but violence. When death finally claims him, it should have been the end. Instead, he awakens thirty years later in the body of Mujin Hwa, the powerless heir of a ruined clan. His overwhelming strength is gone, replaced by a frail body and enemies closing in from every side. To protect the siblings now in his care and reclaim a clan on the brink of collapse, the fallen legend must begin again and build a future from nothing.

title: Vigilante 2
synopsis: After graduating from the Korean National Police University and becoming a detective, Jiyong is assigned to investigate a suspicious report and comes face-to-face with a nationwide jeonse scam. As he confronts criminals who slip through the cracks of the legal system without proper punishment, Jiyong begins to question the rules of vigilante justice he once set for himself. While pursuing the scam’s ringleaders, the four vigilantes receive a threat from someone who knows their true identities and begin to sense the looming presence of a far greater evil. This series contains depictions of mature content that may not be suitable for some readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: The Killer Attorney
synopsis: Hogil Byeon is a third-class killer in the criminal organization Glory Club, with no way up and only one way out. He pivots into law, but his knack for killing doesn’t disappear. Juggling courtrooms and bullets, Hogil starts redefining justice his own way. The law has limits, but Hogil doesn’t. When a lawyer has killer skills, justice is served… with a bang!

title: Who Made Me a Princess
synopsis: A modern-day woman awakens reborn as Athanasia, the doomed princess of a novel she knows by heart, destined to be executed by her own father, Emperor Claude. Determined to survive, she plans to live unnoticed and escape before her fate can unfold. But when she encounters the ruthless emperor years earlier than the story dictates, her careful plans begin to unravel. Trapped inside a narrative that already knows her ending, Athanasia must rewrite her destiny before history repeats itself.

title: The Merciless Hero
synopsis: After playing the game Guardian of Humanity for years and becoming an expert, Je-u Han finds himself dragged into a new server of the game and forced to play at the weakest level. The problem is, death in the game means death in real life too. As Demon Kings rise and imperial forces collide, even the routes he once mastered twist into unfamiliar danger. Can Je-u break free from the patterns that doomed every past run, or will a world that no longer follows its established routes prove too much of a challenge?

title: I Woke Up As a Notorious Troublemaker!
synopsis: A burned-out employee of a toxic company falls asleep one day and wakes up as Christina Vonluk, the infamous villainess. Despite her hopes for a quiet, overtime-free life, she quickly learns that Christina’s past crimes have marked her for punishment. Exiled to the Londan estate by royal decree, she’s placed under the watch of Cedric, the gorgeous but socially inept young lord who despises her. Determined to survive, she sets out to rewrite Christina’s fate only to find herself entangled in secrets, schemes, and unexpected romance. Surrounded by the handsome grandson of the duke, the silver-tongued crown prince, a mischievous mage, and Christina’s adoptive brother, will this overworked white-collar worker be able to thrive in this magical realm?

title: All You Need is Perfection
synopsis: College freshman Da-in Kim enters Myeongmun University determined to craft the perfect campus life: top grades, meaningful friendships, and even a handsome boyfriend. However, her plans unravel quickly after meeting her stunningly beautiful namesake, Da-in Kang, and a reserved guy named Su-hyeon Cha. When Su-hyeon publicly rejects her in favor of the “prettier” Da-in, her carefully built vision begins to collapse. Surrounded by students chasing their own ideal selves, can Da-in figure out what perfection really means?

title: The Vampire’s Alchemy
synopsis:
Build a powerful house and restore the proud heritage of the vampires! But first, some desserts and shopping!
Anne wakes up from her sleep when Eden, the alchemist of time, removes the spear that had put her in a 200-year slumber. The world has changed greatly during that time. Humans have won the war of the races, made great technological advancements, and created a wonderful thing called ice cream. She must now venture through the world of humans with Eden to build a house worthy of her name.

title: The Tale of the Skeleton Messenger
synopsis:
120 years have passed since the First Emperor’s death. Venlyra, a powerful rogue and trusted herald of the Emperor, awakens from a long slumber to a crumbling empire that has strayed from the light. Once more, the Skeleton Messenger makes the rounds, bound for a decaying throne, and for the embers of a self long thought extinguished within.
Hear ye, hear ye! Hark, and heed the Emperor’s words!
The hour of reckoning is upon you!

title: BLACK SURGE
synopsis: Nagi Kujo is a genius surgeon who helps patients in countries affected by armed conflicts. When he finally returns to Japan to treat his adoptive father, the man who saved him and taught him medicine, Nagi learns that his father has been killed—not by accident, but by someone’s design. Determined to uncover the truth, he turns his skills toward a different kind of surgery, cutting deep into a conspiracy that reaches far beyond the operating room.

title: All-Class Awakening: God Slayer
synopsis: Elias Bai, Captain of God's Legion, stood as the world's strongest Awakener until a brutal betrayal claimed his entire squad. Dying as a mere pawn of the ruling elite, he suddenly wakes up twenty years in the past—back in middle school, long before his awakening. With his loved ones still alive, Elias refuses to let history repeat itself. To save his team, exact vengeance on the traitor, and overthrow the corrupt system, he must walk a lonely road to unrivaled power.

title: Soul Sealer's School Life
synopsis:
Qin Jing can’t remember when he first realized it, but it seems that everyone who falls for him ends up being targeted by misfortune.

So Qin Jing came up with a plan: by acting cold and cruel when they confessed their feelings, he always managed to push them away and keep them safe from his “curse.” But… why doesn’t this strategy seem to work on the new transfer student?

With Qi Yu—a mysterious boy who has just arrived at the school—misfortune strikes far more violently than it ever did with the others. What will Qin Jing have to come up with this time to protect him too?

title: Don't Mess With My Duke Dubless!
synopsis: Jade is a professional fangirl on a mission. After being reborn into her favorite novel, she's determined to save her tragic bias, Duke Dubless, by finding him a perfect match. But her "expert" knowledge of the plot proves useless when her chaotic matchmaking schemes end in a hilarious disaster, throwing her directly into the arms of the duke himself. He was supposed to fall for a storybook heroine, not his adoring, meddling, and slightly unhinged number one fan…!

title: Ties that Bind Us
synopsis:
Raised to obey, not inherit, Ava “the Screwup” Moretti struggles to claim her place as the youngest child of one of New York’s most powerful mob families. But one steamy night with a stranger gives her a taste of freedom she was never meant to have. When she learns that her one-night stand is Nick Caponelli, heir to her family’s rival, desire threatens to shake the delicate balance between two powerful mobs. Based on the hit Wattpad story with over 6.6M reads.

This series contains mature themes that may not be suitable for some viewers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: The Villainess Lives Again
synopsis:
From childhood, Artezia Rosan's happiness was dependent on ensuring the success of her brother. As a master manipulator and schemer, she became his most valuable ally in seizing the empire’s throne. That’s exactly why her brother's betrayal cut so deeply when Artezia was imprisoned as punishment for all of her crimes. Soon after being rescued by Grand Duke Cedric Ebron, she vows to help him overthrow the cruel new emperor by sacrificing her own life with forbidden magic. Now waking up several years earlier back in time, she will forsake her own family to help Cedric at all costs. They say that blood is thicker than water, but can Artezia destroy her brother while her own romance blossoms amidst the chaos? Based on the hit novel.
[This series contains themes regarding domestic abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.]

title: Part-Time Couple
synopsis: Da-in never expected to reunite with her first love, Seojun, under such bizarre circumstances. Claiming that marriage is the only way to escape his supposed fated death, Seojun proposes a 100-day contract marriage. Refusing to be at a disadvantage, Da-in negotiates her own terms and plunges into an unconventional newlywed life. What starts as a calculated agreement slowly unravels into something deeper, as unresolved feelings resurface and the countdown to day 100 threatens to change everything.

title: Reborn As the Character That Never Existed
synopsis: After dying four years ago, a writer who is skilled at making tragic characters was reborn into one of the novels she wrote, but as Thalia Remetio, a character that didn't exist in her story. Thalia is the older sister of Loina Remetio, the female protagonist. Fortunately, Loina and the second male lead will have a decent childhood. However, unfortunately, this is only because they are destined to face many hardships in the future. Knowing the fate of not only Loina but all of the characters she loves, what will Thalia do now?

title: The Murdered Princess and the Innocent Traitor
synopsis: When she was discovered as a lost princess, Brigit was overjoyed to be reunited with her older siblings. However, she is ultimately murdered as a sacrificial offering. Before her soul dissolves, she strikes a deal with Nidhor the dragon, who turns back time to when Brigit was yet to be found by her family. Unwilling to attempt revenge, she resolves to flee the empire. However, complications arise when she meets Raymus, a duke who is destined to become a traitor to the empire. Can Brigit run from her doom, or will she face down destiny and fight back?

title: Insanely Radiant
synopsis: Being the high priest's powerless illegitimate daughter, Radiana is tricked into becoming a human sacrifice instead of her half-sister. Just when she's about to be burned alive as a tribute to Prince Oratio, the sun god's son, Oratio sees her struggling to survive and takes an interest in her. He then saves her and brings her back to his palace in the divine realm, where he offers to let her live in exchange for spending a passionate night with him. However, Radiana proves to be harder to seduce than the arrogant and obsessive sun prince expected...

title: The Possessive Tyrant and His Sleepy Cat
synopsis: Some people are reborn as the villainess, some people are reborn as the heroine, but after getting hit by a truck, I've been reborn as... a cat? Not only that, but I've reincarnated into a world that sees cats as cursed monsters destined to ruin the empire! But you'll protect me, won't you, Emperor? I'll make you love me--even if it means using every cute cat trick in the book!

title: Don't Look Back, Seisia!
synopsis: Lady Seisia Lidyne is on the run and settles down in a commoner village as Sha, a healer. The villagers are wary of the new face, but if only they knew she also came from a family of dark magicians. Seisia keeps her magical powers hidden, until she encounters a wounded nobleman by the name of Dian, who is in need of her assistance. But after she heals him, the man decides to stick around the village with her a little longer...

title: Demonic Frontline: The 13th Flying Dragon Company
synopsis: Once an embarrassment to his clan, Jin Seonu starts a new life after being sent to the frontlines, only to be killed years later by his very own brother! But what’s this? He wakes up only to find himself back where he was 10 years earlier? Armed with his knowledge of the future, he returns to the frontlines once again to prove himself for real this time!

title: Caught in the Dark Navy Admiral’s Net
synopsis: Selah Cardi is a former marine biology student who woke up in a romance novel as an inconsequential extra. Eager to survive the plot, Selah manages to rescue Maria so that she and Duke Herbert, her fiancé, will be indebted to her. But then Admiral Ellaim notices her and her magical abilities that allow her to breathe underwater. Selah soon discovers that Ellaim is a merman called a siren, and that he needs her powers to recover from a mysterious illness. Will her dream of retiring by the sea in peace ever come true?

title: Star Wars™: The High Republic
synopsis: In the glory days of the Republic, two hundred years before the adventures of Luke, Leia, Han, and Chewbacca, the Jedi stand as guardians of galactic peace—until a powerful new adversary called the Nihil arrives.

title: Sea of Thieves: The Last Bite
synopsis: A new crew of rogues have sailed to the pirate paradise known as the Sea of Thieves, but things aren’t right aboard ship. With their captain lost and tempers fraying, one question’s still on everyone’s minds - which of them broke their oath and stole the Last Bite? There’s adventures to be had and treasures to be taken from these untamed shores, but as their bond of trust dissolves, the crew’s maiden voyage may prove to be their final journey…

title: The Swordmaster Who Leapt Through Time
synopsis:
The Kingdom of Vanroah has fallen.
Lansen, the last prince, flees with the remaining survivors to a faraway land. Vowing to one day revive the kingdom, he becomes a swordmaster at a young age, only for a treacherous incident to strip everything away.
Powerless to protect those he loves, he uses an ancient artifact to travel 10,000 years back in time to the Age of the Arcane. There, its rich knowledge and wisdom help him avert disaster in the present.
But each time he turns back the clock, new secrets emerge, entangling the past and present in ways he never foresaw.

title: Gunhild
synopsis: The 12-year-old orphan, Gunhild, lives in a world where humans revere the powerful Asgardians as gods and fear the mystical Jotuns. The fire Jotun Gunhild leaves behind her human village upbringing to embark on a great adventure where she will prove her worth by becoming a god. Gunhild is an award-winning Norse Mythology series by the stellar Fred Tornager, published by Saturday AM.

title: The Visitor of the Night
synopsis: Every night, a man comes to Seyeon’s dreams, but who is he? Four years after losing five months of her memory, Seyeon is haunted by a faceless man who appears strong, tender, and intoxicatingly passionate. Who is this man who visits her every night? Is he her lost lover? The father of her child? Or just a stranger? How far will she go to uncover the truth?

title: Dating Sim[on]
synopsis:
After thousands watch his messy breakup stream, Simon goes from star streamer to heartbroken social outcast. But everything changes when Rina, a curious runaway android who looks exactly like his favorite VTuber, gives him a brain-rewiring kiss that turns his reality into a living dating sim. Suddenly, Simon is hunted down by lethal agents and assassins seeking to recapture the state-of-the-art bot. Now forced to use "date triggers" to survive these high-stakes encounters, Simon must protect Rina while rediscovering what love really means.

In this Romcom Survival Dating Experience, it’s Date, or Die!

title: The King's Forbidden Flower
synopsis: Peony Marshall, a noble-born girl with nothing to her name but the memory of her childhood friend and first love "Zach," prepares for nunhood. Every day, she prays to see Zach one last time... until one day, Zach, whose real identity is King Ernest Edward, finds Peony and takes her away as his imperial concubine. In the palace, Peony realizes how erratic Ernest's behavior is and begins to fear for her life. Will Peony survive long enough to figure out the cause behind his strangely split personality, or is she doomed to wilt in Ernest's clutches?

title: My Angelic Husband is actually a Devil in Disguise
synopsis: Setia only accepts the marriage offer from Miere Lunaira because she needs the money to get out of her family’s debt. But her rich yet dim-witted husband goes missing one month into their marriage, ultimately being presumed dead. Three years later, Setia is shocked to see her “dead” husband has returned as a hero. Although their marriage contract is about to expire, Miere has no intention of letting his wife go. What’s more, Miere is a lot craftier than he lets on...

title: The Grand Duke is Mine
synopsis: After being used as a pawn by her selfish family and poisoned by her evil third husband, Ignette wakes up in the past with a chance to redo her life. This time, she's determined to preserve her first marriage to Grand Duke Askalon, who was her only saving grace in her previous life. But in the grand duke's absence, she finds herself drawn to his kind and dashing envoy, Hatz, who helps her adjust to her life as the grand duchess. Will Ignette have a successful marriage and find happiness this time around?

title: Can't Go Too Far with the Unrelenting Duke
synopsis:
After years of grueling work as a maid, Amelie publishes a hit novel and becomes the youngest professor at the Royal Academy. But she seems less lucky in the romance department when a fortune teller says anyone she marries will die an untimely death. Therefore, Amelie decides to spend a passionate night with a handsome stranger before succumbing to her destiny as a spinster. However, she soon learns that he's not only her student's guardian, but also an unrelenting duke who'll stop at nothing to win her over. Will the star-crossed lovers somehow find their happily ever after?

"This series contains strong themes such as child abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised."

title: Will My Doting Husband Love Me Again?
synopsis: How do you win over your husband... while in another woman's body? That's precisely the task at hand for Adeline Tiaget - formally known as Charlotte Valerian. When Charlotte's step-father's incessant scheming leads her to be poisoned to death, she is given a chance to live on in the body of the most beautiful woman in the empire. Now, all there's left to do is exact her revenge and make her former husband fall in love with her again.

title: Astonishing X-Men
synopsis: Cyclops and Emma Frost re-form the X-Men with the express purpose of "astonishing" the world. But when breaking news regarding the mutant gene unexpectedly hits the airwaves, will it derail their new plans before they even get started? As demand for the "mutant cure" reaches near-riot levels, the X-Men go head-to-head with the enigmatic Ord, with an unexpected ally - and some unexpected adversaries - tipping the scales!

title: Another Typical Fantasy Romance
synopsis: Lithera Merto is just another typical female lead transmigrated into a typical novel with a typical life. Unfortunately, her happily every after is anything but standard. Divorced from her supposed male lead and now saddled with the work of a princess and nobles who conspire against her, she takes another chance at happiness by meeting the Duke who she's been exchanging letters with for years.

title: Something is Killing the Children
synopsis:
When the children in a sleepy Wisconsin town begin to go missing, all hope seems lost. Most children never return, and those that do have terrible stories of terrifying creatures that live in the shadows. But even monsters fear the mysterious stranger that arrives shortly after. She believes the children and claims to be the only one who sees what they can see... Her name is Erica Slaughter. She kills monsters. This is all she does, and she bears the cost because it must be done. Experience the horror phenomenon by the Eisner-Award winning team of visionary writer James Tynion IV and celebrated artist Werther Dell'Edera! 

This series contains graphic depictions of violence against minors, including intense gore and distressing imagery. Viewer discretion is strongly advised.

title: A Hero Who Knows His Stuff
synopsis: For 20 years, Hyeonseok fought monsters in another world before finally managing to save it and be sent back to Earth as a reward. Now a former deliveryman named Chanseok, he looks forward to enjoying modern conveniences, only to discover that Earth is very different from what he remembers. Monsters have started appearing from Erosion Points that pop up at random, and people with innate abilities become Hunters to defeat them. Reluctantly, Chanseok applies to become a Hunter himself, mostly for the money. He saved the world once before, so how hard can it be the second time?

title: The Patron of Villains
synopsis:
One day, I woke up as a noble inside the game I used to play. Unfortunately, the game ends in an apocalypse. With ten years left, I track down the future villains while they’re still kids and decide to raise them myself, hoping that a better childhood could stop them from destroying the world. Now, with criminals dropping like flies, the kingdom thinks I’m the terrifying mastermind pulling all the strings. What on earth is happening? 
I just wanted to enjoy the sweet noble life!

title: The Despised Dark Mage Lives Again
synopsis:
Moments before victory, dark mage Kai Austin is betrayed and loses everything. His death becomes a reset, sending him five years into the past—to the day of the class assignment ceremony—with all of his magic intact. Armed with max-level dark magic and every memory of the future, Kai refuses to let history repeat itself.

This time, he will protect Colette, stop the coming disasters before they begin, and destroy those who once betrayed him.

title: Unrefined Love
synopsis: Yeoreum Lee, a university student, unexpectedly reunites with her first love, Suyeong Ji, and his fiancée, Han-gyeong Bae, the owner of the café where she works. Their relationship began in high school when Yeoreum's mother worked as a housekeeper at Suyeong's family home. After years of heartbreak, they meet again, but this time, Suyeong unknowingly drinks a potion that makes him fall in love with Yeoreum. With the potion's effects lasting one year, will their love become real, or will it fade once the potion wears off?

title: Living with Romeo
synopsis:
Sol, a college student, returns home for the first time in three years, only to find her mother Mi-ae living with a young guy named Romi Oh. At first, she thinks he’s Mi-ae’s boyfriend, but it turns out they’re just housemates.
Sol somehow ends up living with them, although she doesn’t like Romi at all. She believes he’s too brazen and carefree. However, in time, she finds herself inexplicably drawn to him…

title: FOG LAND
synopsis:
Witness the corruption of reason and divinity. Escape the nine hells of Fog Land.
Driven by his conviction that everyone deserves education, science teacher Dante Kang agrees to teach in Fog Land, a mysterious international prison that houses the world’s most notorious criminals. But his very first class gets interrupted by a violent prison riot, after which, he finds himself in the cell of his mysterious captor.
Dante must now travel through the nine circles of hell and escape Fog Land.

title: The Cruelty of Salvation
synopsis:
Olivia Liberty is the first commoner ever admitted to Herolington University. However, she cannot be properly recognized because she is a woman and must instead use the name of a man, Oliver, to receive credit for her creations.
Meanwhile, Noah Astrid, Prince of Herod, takes notice of Olivia, who is beloved by the commoners of Herod. Noah seeks to involve her in royal affairs to raise the royal family’s popularity and asks for her hand. But while every other member of the royal family treats Olivia affectionately, Noah alone continues to treat her coldly. Will he come to regret it?

title: The Grand Duke’s Bride is a Warrior from Hell
synopsis: Alicia Sirius Rayne, a timid, stuttering spinster betrothed to the rumored "Grand Duchess Serial Killer," falls into Hell after opening a mysterious artifact. Now, she must adapt to survive. Years later, she has become a fierce warrior. But as she sets out to conquer all of Hell -- she wakes up in the past. Armed with a second chance at life and a new goal, Alicia must actively pursue the feared Grand Duke Reikart Tessen to secure her destiny. Can this fierce warrior from Hell win the heart of the man who has "killed" six grand duchesses?!

title: A Kind Intruder
synopsis: After Ihan Jeong’s mother and brother died in a car crash when she was just 9 years old, she was raised by Chio Han and his parents, who lived next door. Now about to attend university, Ihan suddenly finds herself living with Chio under one roof, and she realizes that she feels more than just familial affection for her brother figure. While trying to deal with her trauma and the awkwardness of freshman life, Ihan meets Yujin Seo, a champion judoka at their university who is the spitting image of her late brother. And now he's moving in next door?!

title: MIME
synopsis: A mime, crushed by failure, is reborn in silence. With power drawn from the void, he hunts those who shattered him—but as the lines between vengeance and self-destruction blur, he must question: Is it justice he seeks, or the final act in his own tragic performance?

title: The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl
synopsis: Wolverine, Deadpool, Doctor Doom, Thanos: There's one hero that's beaten them all-and now she's got her own ongoing series! (Not that she's bragging.) That's right, you asked for it, you got it, it's SQUIRREL GIRL! (She's also starting college this semester.) It's the start of a brand-new set of adventures starring the nuttiest and most upbeat super hero in the world!

title: Wynd
synopsis: In a world where magical heritage is punishable by death, a young boy named Wynd must hide his true identity — and pointy ears — from everyone in Pipetown, even if it means he’ll never have the normal life he wants. With nothing but his powers and his best friends by his side, Wynd goes on a dangerous journey, uncovering the truth about his mysterious heritage and navigating the escalating tensions between Humans and Faeries. Can he protect himself and his found family by embracing his magic, or will the forces against him prevail? Acclaimed writer James Tynion IV and visionary artist Michael Dialynas team up for a fantasy epic that dares you to spread your wings and fly.

title: Stitch & the Samurai
synopsis: While fleeing the Galactic Federation, Stitch's spaceship malfunctions and he makes an emergency landing... not in Hawaii, but in sengoku-era Japan! Discovered by the hard-hearted warlord Lord Yamato and his clan, Stitch's incomparable cuteness is no match for the battle-weary samurai, who decides to bring the "blue tanuki" home with him. Will Stitch's love of chaos turn into a formidable advantage for the samurai's influence? Or will his cute and fluffy form disarm the noble lord's stern façade?

title: Shadow Princess
synopsis:
After the fall of the Kingdom of Jarthewer, Princess Lisselotte and her maid, Hannah, escape to the Grand Duchy of Ralus, home of the princess’s fiancé, Vincent Ralus. Though Hannah has lost her memory after nearly drowning, she stays strong, enduring Lady Charlotte’s daily abuse in hopes of a better future. 
But everything changes when Vincent asks her to pose as Princess Lisselotte for the 10th-anniversary ceremony of the Jarthewer Republic. Returning means certain death both for her and the princess, but if they can pull off the deception, it may be their only chance at freedom. Stuck between the handsome but cold Vincent and his mischievous and buff guard, Diego, can Hannah succeed in her dangerous role?

title: Prison Guard Zero
synopsis: Jihun, once part of an elite secret special forces unit, returns from overseas duty to the devastating news of his sister Jiyun’s death. Her boyfriend Minjun is blamed, but Jihun soon learns Minjun entered Yeokseon Prison under a false charge to uncover the real killer. When Minjun is found dead inside the prison, Jihun refuses to accept the official story. Taking on the role of a correctional officer, he infiltrates the prison to expose the truth behind both murders—and the hidden forces controlling the facility.

title: How is This Hot Duke Just a Background Character?!
synopsis: After reincarnating as Leticia, a minor extra in an otome game, the “new” Leticia unexpectedly inherits her twin sister’s engagement to Lionel, a rumored chubby and awkward duke-to-be. But Leticia sees the potential beneath his rough edges and takes it upon herself to help him grow. As Lionel transforms into a refined and handsome noble, his feelings for her deepen rapidly. Though she only wanted a peaceful life as an extra, Leticia suddenly finds herself at the center of an intense, ever-growing devotion from her now-irresistible fiancé.

title: Some Day You Will Give Birth To Me
synopsis: Born to a sorceress and a prince of the Holy Empire, Evanna is forced to ascend the throne in a world that shuns magic. Though she works hard to pray her powers away, Evanna is despised by all. Her only hope through abuse and isolation comes with the discovery of her mother’s grimoire. The magic within sends Evanna back in time, to before her parents met. Her goal: to guide them to a better future than the one she came from! But can she really do that… as a toddler?

title: Chronicles of the Lazy Sovereign
synopsis:
The path to greatness begins… tomorrow!
It’s always a day too early for a great procrastinator like Yeonho Wi to start training. So how did someone as lazy as him become a great warrior renowned for his virtue, benevolence, and might? Follow the historian’s journey to uncover the hidden secrets of the lazy master of martial arts.

title: Maria The Telepathic Animal Healer
synopsis: Maria Lwelin reawakens in the Larson Empire with the power to communicate with animals. Upon learning that the crown prince is willing to grant one wish to the vet who can heal his pet panther, she jumps at the chance for an exciting new adventure!

title: The Genius Midfielder with the Killer Pass
synopsis: 17-year-old Yujun Song lives for soccer. However, when he suddenly becomes color-blind, he has no choice but to walk away from his dream. 15 years later, after a car crash, Yujin finds himself on the brink of death and makes one last wish: to step onto the soccer field one more time. In the next moment, he appears to have been given this chance as he finds himself back in his 17-year-old body. On the pitch, strange bands of colorful light dance around him. With the colors as his guide, can Yujun become the midfielder he always dreamed of?

title: Return of the Demonic Instructor
synopsis: The world is destroyed by a demon invasion and Bigang Sa is forced to serve in the demon army for centuries. After a failed human uprising, Bigang transports himself back into his body, ten years before the arrival of the demons. Can he use his centuries of demon warrior training to create a new class of murim fighters powerful enough to ward off the coming invasion?

title: Finding a Ticket Into Your Heart
synopsis: After a brutal breakup, Yubyeol flies to Spain alone where one wild, blurry night with a stranger named Seonu changes everything. Back in Korea, fate brings them together again… but this time, they only have 90 days before Seonu must return to Spain. Between unresolved heartbreak, unexpected chemistry, and a deadline she never asked for, can Seonu find his ticket into Yubyeol’s heart before the final boarding call?

title: Star Wars™: Lost Stars
authors: Lucasfilm Ltd., Claudia Gray, Yusaku Komiyama
synopsis:
Seduced by the Galactic Empire's promises of unity and change, the planets of the galaxy and the hearts of their people fall under the Emperor's control one by one... 

Sharing a love of ships and an admiration for the Empire, childhood friends Thane Kyrell and Ciene Ree enroll in the Imperial Academy in hopes of realizing their dreams of joining the fleet. The more they learn, however, the more their loyalties -- to the Empire and to each other -- are put to the test. 

Will Thane and Ciena's friendship -- or even they themselves -- survive the trials ahead?

title: Red Aura
synopsis: A young, bumbling countryside girl called Asa dreams of travelling the land of Tengriya to master her powers and become a Nomad. She can't help but fall head first from one problem into the next, into meeting new friends and foes alike, onwards unto a world she knows less than she knows herself. Because that is the Nomad way!

title: Azarinth Healer
synopsis:
Ilea Spears wanted a fight, not a life behind a desk. So when this boxer-turned-med student wakes up in Elos -- a dangerous fantasy world where combat is a daily requirement -- she’s more than a little thrilled. 

There, she unlocks the long-lost Battle Healer class, an unusual blend of combat strength and healing magic, and discovers she may have finally found her calling. 

As she travels across the realms, leveling up faster than anyone expects, she begins to earn a reputation as something of a legend: the healer who isn’t afraid to punch back.

title: Star Wars™: Darth Vader - Black, White, & Red
synopsis:
One of the most iconic villains of all time, Darth Vader, gets his own entry in Marvel’s smash hit monochrome anthology!

Exciting tales from a galaxy of talents featuring the Dark Lord of the Sith! Jason Aaron returns to the world of Star Wars, teaming with artist Leonard Kirk to present a new tale of terror!
