Peach Momoko spins a story in her signature style! Daniel Warren Johnson brings Vader to life like never before! David Pepose makes his Star Wars debut! Marc Bernardin takes Vader on a mission you won’t soon forget! Frank Tieri sends the Sith lord to the planet Hoth! Steve Orlando goes cerebral with the corruption of Darth Vader’s mind! Plus more chilling tales of evil told in stark black and white — and the crimson glow of a lightsaber!

title: Ungracefully Grace
synopsis: With her family, staff, and title being threatened after her year-long exile, Grace must now use her wits and strength to protect herself against her two-faced stepmother, half-sister, and father who have turned against her.

title: Vincent the Great
synopsis: The demons took his farmhouse, his wife, his peace. Now Vincent Burns lives to kill as many as he can. The excommunicated exorcist, along with Sister Beatrice and local sheriff Chloe, has found himself in the middle of a demonic plot to bring Hell itself to the United States, yet the biggest puzzle is the white-haired girl he found in a suitcase. Demons not only die upon biting her; flowers bloom from her wounds. Vincent and Beatrice must keep her safe until they know her purpose, while Chloe must keep her sanity against the demon horde.

title: The Swindler Couple of Ardel
synopsis: The legendary con artist in the pleasure city of Ardel, Sue Rolanne, is hired by an aloof duke to pull off the ultimate grift: deceive the king. To infiltrate high society, the pair stage a sham marriage and what began as a “contract couple” turns into a high-stakes, kingdom-wide con.

title: The Handmaiden Dreams at Sunset
synopsis: From her first day as a maid in the Yufgenschult Estate, Dahlia Belohr is repeatedly warned to not go near the annex where a "ghost" is rumored to live. However, one day, she is forced to go to the annex to deliver a parcel and sees the famed ghost herself. Contrary to the rumors, the ghost is neither hideous nor violent but is handsome and kind enough to gift her books. Interestingly, it seems like the famed ghost has taken a liking to Dahlia too, because the next day, she is told that she has been assigned to the annex.

title: Distress
synopsis: Lenny, a young French student, arrives in Montreal to pursue his journalism studies. As part of a class assignment, he meets Anoki, a quiet Algonquin student, and the two are paired up as a team. Their investigation soon draws them into a mysterious monster hunt. Caught between myths and legends and possible deception, the two boys challenge each other’s beliefs and gradually form a deep bond. But what will happen when they are forced to share their secret?

title: Red Hot Revenge
synopsis:
A good girl. An obedient daughter. A submissive wife.
Scarlett spent her entire life being the prized doll on the shelf; first for her father, and now for a cruel duke who is to be her husband. Tired of the belittling and manipulation, Scarlett finally decides to take matters into her own hands and fight for a life of freedom. And that's the thing about girls who've been forced to be quiet their whole lives – no one's ready for what'll happen when they finally decide to speak up.
This series contains themes regarding grooming and abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: If You So Desire My Despair
synopsis: Orphaned at a young age and drowning in her father’s debt, Anastasia spends her days as a starving noble. That is, until her uncle offers her a way out by getting her engaged to his enemy, Duke Theodore Redford. Upon moving in with her fiancé, Anastasia has to endure all sorts of mistreatment from the cruel duke and his servants. But her lonely and depressing life takes a turn when she encounters a certain gentleman at a ball...

title: All Hail Lady Blanche!
synopsis:
To Blanche, everything seemed hopeless. Until she realized it was all a game. One she made, to be exact. Now she has a goal: Become the villain's right-hand man! But wait. Why is she the one saving him...?
Blanche, who is timid and kind but is despised by her family, cannot overcome her family's contempt and attempts suicide.
After that, when I opened my eyes, this world was the game world I made!!
To survive in this world, I must have the villain Ricardo to my side. But Ricardo's condition is strange?!

title: The Glass
synopsis:
Lara and Suni are childhood friends who meet again after 10 years. Suni is a member of the world’s most successful idol group, "THE GLASS''. Lara is looking for a job while planning her wedding with her fiancé, Mark. After a small accident, they meet again and - thanks to Suni's help - Lara gets a job as her new manager! However, Suni has a secret… she’s been in love with Lara since childhood, and now she is determined to keep the promise they made to each other when they were little girls... to marry her.
Suni and her teammates (Eva, Dana, and Lia) will fight to achieve their dream of being the first idol group to win a Grammy, but will their love and drama keep it out of reach in the end? Music, dance, fashion, and a lot of passion... "see us, hear us" we are THE GLASS!

title: The Northern Duke Needs a Warm Hug
synopsis: When the talented imperial wizard Nisha makes an unconventional deal with King Frei, she goes on a mission to lift the curse of the Grand Duke of the North, Lanfel Delore! Turns out that the dark and handsome Duke Lanfel isn't as strong as he appears to be, and it seems like the freezing gray days of winter is a bit too much for the Duke's frail body. While Nisha does her research around the Duke's manor to lift his curse, she simultaneously becomes his caretaker. Little does she know that her deal with King Frei could bring her and Duke Lanfel together in more ways than one...

title: A Happy Ending for Villains
synopsis:
Sasha is the cunning villainess in the novel ""War Wagon of Fire"" who uses the evil sons of the Serpente Family to plunge the Xerkesia Empire into chaos. But when the reader wakes up as a younger version of Sasha who's trapped in a hidden corner of the Serpente manor with the Serpente children, she's baffled because this was never mentioned in the novel. The children's uncle claims it's only for a week to protect them from the plague that killed their parents, but when a week passes without anyone letting them out, Sasha senses that dark intentions are afoot...

This series contains themes regarding child abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: The Ex-Mercenary Prosecutor
synopsis: Jeonghwan, once a legendary mercenary, returns under an identity no one expected— a prosecutor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his mother’s mysterious death, the tragedy that robbed him of his peace and future. To take his revenge, Jeonghwan must wield two weapons: violence for those who stand in his way, and the law for those who must be judged.

title: It’ll Be Okay
synopsis: Mouse was just a regular college student when her legs suddenly started to go numb. At first, she brushed it off, thinking it was nothing. But as the symptoms worsened and even walking became painful, a visit to the hospital revealed something she never expected. What do you do when your body begins to betray you, and nothing feels certain anymore?

title: Friend Request
synopsis:
Online, Yuni is a glamorous influencer. In reality, she lives in poverty with her timid, overworked mother, Deulre. After a horrific family tragedy leaves Yuni orphaned, she’s suddenly thrust back in time and finds her mother a teenager again.
Determined to rewrite the future, Yuni enrolls in her mother's high school to protect her teen mom from her toxic friends and the choices that led to heartbreak, abuse, and death. But changing the past isn't easy—especially when your own mother sees you as the enemy.
Can Yuni save her mother… and heal their broken bond in the process?

title: Your Ryan
synopsis: In the quiet village of Feltham, Eloise Surbiton leads a peaceful life far from the hubbub of the city, tending to geese and secretly fawning over dashing war hero Lt. Col. Ryan Wilgrave from afar. When her father mentions that a certain military man named Ryan will be moving to the nearby town of Cambourne, Eloise is thrilled — only to have her hopes dashed when she meets her new neighbor Ryan Thornton, a gruff soldier who is the opposite of the Ryan Wilgrave she knows. Little does she realize, there may be more to Ryan than meets the eye…

title: Beware of Double Trouble!
synopsis: “There are plenty of fish in the sea,” or so they say. Easier said than done for Gahi Kim, whose crush is rising K-drama star Yubin Choi. Despite going to the same university as Yubin, Gahi can only daydream and grumble to her bestie and roommate Sara, as there’s never any sign of her crush on campus. But then, while having drinks at a nearby pub, Gahi meets a boy who’s the spitting image of Yubin. Seemingly more outgoing and down-to-earth compared to her idol, this look-alike is just the beginning of Gahi’s campus drama…

title: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life
synopsis: Once a loyal hound to a powerful magic family, Aster was used, betrayed, and killed. But death wasn’t the end—it was a second chance. Back in the back alleys of his youth, Aster now holds the future’s secrets in his hands. This time, he won’t serve anyone. Can a man who once served power learn to become his own master?

title: The Luckiest Mage
synopsis: Seo-joon used to be the unluckiest man in the universe, until one final disastrous twist of fate led to his death. Reincarnated as a Black Mage, he discovers a special ability called Ultimate Karma, turning him into the luckiest being in existence. Determined to find a way back to Earth and reunite with his mother, he embarks on an epic quest where he must face power struggles, lost loves, and shocking betrayals.

title: The Max Magic Level Great Sage’s Return
synopsis: In 1970, “The Great Sage,” Minato Ichikami, saved the world by destroying the invading “Demon God” and its forces. After this intense battle, Minato Ichikami died. After 50 years, he wakes up in a teenager’s body by the name of Minato Kusanagi! Now, the year is 2022, and our hero is inside a student’s body. What’s more, 50 years of peace has weakened magic severely. However, this peace doesn’t last. As demons start returning, Minato Ichikami, now Minato Kusanagi, vows to protect his new life and face his enemies. Witness the return of The Great Sage in this modern era!

title: Defense Breaker
synopsis:
Jihun is pulled into Knight Defense, a game where he must lead the kingdom’s knights against endless waves of monsters. Weighed down by the scars of his real life, Jihun chooses not to fight and turns his back on humanity. But as soon as he does, the system unveils a new path: the Monster Faction.
Defense is over. It’s now time for offense.

title: Undercover Wife
synopsis:
Beauty was her curse. What others envied and longed for only brought her misery. Scarred and weary, I-yeon decided to hide her crafted-by-god looks. 
In doing so, she gained a new identity, the ugly secretary, I-yeon Yu. She endured the mockery and lived quietly in the shadows until one day...
"Let's live together."
Do-hyeon An, the only heir of the powerful Wooseung Group, suddenly proposed to her. 
No one can ever discover their contract marriage or her true identity. Under the same roof begins a thrilling and breathtaking romance of secrets and deception.

title: The Villain Profiler
synopsis: After surviving a brutal childhood tragedy and awakening from a mysterious coma, Shinyeok Lee returns with the mind of a genius profiler and fifteen years’ worth of knowledge that no one can explain. Now, he reads the lies of the living and uncovers the truths of the dead, solving crimes no one else can. But every case brings him closer to the murderer who destroyed his family. Can Shinhyeok expose the ultimate villain, or will the darkness he studies consume him first?

title: Youth Blossoms
synopsis: World War III has ended, but Jimin’s troubles are only beginning. A superhuman bloomer, he’s enslaved in a scrapyard, where his life changes after he finds and repairs Aurora, a discarded battle bot. Post-war exploitation of the weak and clashing factions has given rise to the Second Lost Generation. Even if they escape, they’ll still have to grow up in the chaos. But can they outrun the Stalker Bot and the mercenaries hot on their trail?

title: Mia is Back
synopsis: Mia was Taesu's first love, who suddenly disappeared one day. After five years of silence, she reappears as a freshman at his university. But she's not the girl he remembers. He plays it cool, trying to ignore her, but can first love truly be forgotten? Or will fate give them a second chance?

title: Zodiac Girls
synopsis: Nina the cat lost the Zodiac Race by one spot, and she's held a grudge for millennia. When she forces a divine do-over, unlucky student Cosmo Lee becomes the reluctant referee. His mission? Gather twelve Zodiac Spirits for the ultimate competition. The catch? They've all possessed girls from his school. Can an ordinary boy survive refereeing an extraordinary battle between Heaven-sent superpowered heroines?

title: I’ll Be Anything You Desire
synopsis: Princess Roxiana of Cantar seems destined for a life of happiness as she departs to wed her childhood fiancé, Prince Lucas. But when her carriage is ambushed by mysterious assailants, Roxiana finds she’s been betrayed. Branded a slave and stripped of her royal title, all hope appears lost…Until she is rescued by Grand Duke Floyd Lathean of Torcan. Roxiana must contend with dangerous forces, all while her feelings for the Duke grow. Betrayal or love, which will out?

title: Preppity
synopsis: Watch as Cassidy, a bubbly, outgoing cheerleader, and Valerie, a book-smart, rather uptight introvert, find common ground in their shared interests and personalities as they go beyond surface-level differences!

title: REVIVE
synopsis:
Genesis weapons—Heroes of the war, or dangerous threats?
In Tristan, humans and mechanical lifeforms called “cobas” live side by side. Three years ago, the war finally ended, brought down by the Genesis Weapons.
Ode, once a Genesis Weapon himself, investigates the secrets of the M3 company, seeking memories of his life before becoming a weapon. When he discovers children being used in experiments to create others like the Genesis Weapons, he sets out on a journey to find the comrades who escaped with him and to uncover what M3 is after.

title: Swimmer Boy
synopsis: Have you ever pretended you were good at sports to impress your crush? Enter high school student Haemin Oh, who desperately wants to catch the attention of Ina Jeong, recently elected president of the school swimming club. Ina is recruiting, and despite barely knowing how to float, Haemin somehow ends up making her think that he’s an expert at the sport. Before long, Haemin has to prove himself in the lane. Sink or swim, it’s time to make a splash!

title: Last Love
synopsis: Seol-a’s boyfriend dumps her over text for a woman with better standing, and now they’re getting married. Seung-hu Ji, the CEO, witnesses Seol-a berating her ex for it, but to her surprise, he reacts by taking her out to dinner after. After a drunken night in bed, she finds out she was his first, but could he be her last? Seol-a must now manage dating her company’s CEO and the blowback of Seung-hu spurning other women over her, one of whom is now dying to ruin Seol-a’s life.

title: DARK MOON: Two Moons
synopsis:
“Ah, so it’s you. The one that’s taken my place.”
Still keeping their true identities secret, Sooha and Heli return to school as an official couple when suddenly a mysterious girl with Sooha's face named Selen appears.
Sooha, with whom they have made countless memories together in the current, and Selen, with whom they share deep and fond memories from the past.
As two people who never should have met collide, a dangerous and heartrending romance begins once more.

title: The Knight of the Sightless Sky
synopsis:
A consuming fire, a dead king, and a family in ruin. 

Ten years after witnessing her mother’s murder, a vengeful maiden returns to the palace as a deadly assassin. But her revenge plot shatters when she discovers an unlikely truth that makes her blade waver. 

Caught between the eyes of silver and violet, the barbed rose must decide... follow the treacherous path of vengeance or uncover the secrets that bind her fate to the kingdom’s fragile crown.

title: The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero
synopsis: Twenty years. For twenty long years, the thirteenth saint Lee Geon was trapped inside the Tower of Demons after being backstabbed by twelve of his allies. These twelve "saints" were warriors chosen by the twelve zodiac gods to defeat mysterious monsters called "calamities" that were massacring the planet. Though no god had chosen Geon as a saint, he became the mightiest of them all, which made him a hero... and a target. But now, Geon has brawled his way out of the tower, and he's back stronger than ever. All that's left is to exact brutal payback on each of the saints, but none of these powerful beings will go down without a fight. Will Geon be able to stay in one piece while achieving the divine revenge of his dreams?

title: ZOMBIE PAPA
synopsis: Minseok loses his daughter again and again in a world overrun by zombies. He’s been mysteriously given 100 lives to save her and has watched her die in 99 of them. On his final one, he dies before they even make it out the front door–except this time, he wakes as a zombie. But a zombie papa still has a father’s heart. Now stronger than ever, he’s ready to take on the world to protect his baby girl.

title: Lv. 99 Princess of Black Flame
synopsis: When portals called “gates” opened in 1997, humanity was thrown into chaos as monsters ravaged the planet. Countless lives were lost, including Eunha Cha’s mother. Left to fend for herself, Eunha one day mysteriously awakens a new power. Drafted into the military to fight alongside other Hunters, she sets out on what was supposed to be a routine mission inside a C-rank gate. But when she becomes trapped inside, she’s forced to fight relentlessly against waves of monsters as the gate resets endlessly... until a voice calls out to her.

title: Born to be the Grand Duchess
synopsis: Annette Fraise was supposed to die as the novel’s wicked villainess. Instead, she’s using her 21st-century charm to survive her marriage to the cursed Grand Duke of the North, Loic Blenheim. Between one awkward accident, a magical curse, and a one-year marriage contract, love might just become the plot twist that changes everything.

title: Protect the Fake Saintess!
synopsis: Dana, a Korean high school senior just days away from her college entrance exam, meets an unlucky end. Hit by the infamous "romance fantasy truck" and reborn in another world, she figures she might as well make the best out of it, but she suddenly stumbles across the Saintess's secret! "I don't want to die, so I guess I'll keep the cat in the bag, Saintess!"

title: The Top Assassin in Another World
synopsis: Kai Shinjo, an ordinary high school student by day and a deadly assassin by night, hides behind his quiet, dark demeanor, making him an outcast among his classmates. One day, his entire class is transported to another world — a realm of swords and magic. There, a woman named Leonora reveals they were summoned as Hero candidates to defeat the Demon Lord. Each student receives a Blessing, but Kai’s power, Appraisal, seems useless compared to others’. Yet, with his assassin’s skills and cold precision, Kai begins to move in the shadows of this new world.

title: When Love Calls Upon Me
synopsis: Reborn with memories she never asked for, Jian Song wants nothing more than a quiet, ordinary life. But everything changes when she meets him again—the man she once loved beyond reason, and the one who shattered her. No matter how hard she tries to stay away, fate keeps pulling them together in ways she never expected. As her new life begins to mirror the tragic patterns of her past, she must face one question: can she rewrite her story this time, or is she doomed to repeat it?

title: Predator: Day of the Hunter
synopsis: Hunt. Kill. Repeat. In the near future, a young girl sees her family slaughtered by the deadliest and most feared hunter in the universe: a Predator. Years later, though her ship is barely holding together and food is running short, Theta won't stop stalking the spaceways until the Yautja monster who killed her family is dead - or she is. And when she crash-lands on a tundra planet, her odds of surviving are looking slim! Her only hope is to trek through the wilds to the nearest outpost. But the cold isn't the only thing she has to worry about: A Predator watches in the shadows, ready to strike! Ed Brisson (IRON FIST, GHOST RIDER) and Kev Walker (DR. STRANGE, DOCTOR APHRA) forge a violent, heartbreaking and unforgettable new chapter in the PREDATOR saga not to be missed!

title: Overprotective Butler
synopsis:
Protected his entire life by his loyal butler, Sejin, young heir Lee Haneul is discovering the real world for the very first time. As he tastes freedom, friendship, and first love, long-buried secrets begin to resurface.
Why does Sejin seem to care for him as much as he watches over him? The discovery of a terrible secret about his birth will fundamentally change Haneul’s view of the world—and his feelings for his butler.

title: Maid in Heaven
synopsis:
An orphan, Sherl Wathson, leaves her job in London to work at the Taylor Mansion.
Rumors and a cloud of mystery surrounds the mansion as strange occurrences keep popping up.
Will Sherl and the other maids be able to get out alive or were they all doomed to begin with?

title: Marriage of Convenience
synopsis: After being stuck in a loveless marriage and dying in misery, Bianca d’Arno wakes up at 18 with a chance to start all over again. Determined to rewrite her fate, she vows to turn her previously distant husband into an ally instead of an enemy. But in a world where marriage is currency, can she build love out of a transaction, or will history repeat itself?

title: Reincarnation of the Fist King
synopsis: Wuseong Dan, the man who ruled over the martial world with his fists alone. After unexpectedly losing a duel against two practitioners of the Demonic Way, he’s reborn into the body of the wild child heir apparent of the affluent Silver River Merchants. Not one to leave debts unpaid, be they to his benefit or detriment, Wuseong sets out on his path of revenge in the body of Jineon Lee. Using his knowledge of martial arts from his past life and the wealth of his current life, he only has one goal: get stronger and kill those who killed him.

title: Undercover at Chaebol High
synopsis: Dakyung Lee, an elite member of a criminal organization, learns of the death of her beloved boss. Upon discovering that Chairman Lee was behind it, she vows to take revenge. Yet, since he’s protected by the Sa Yeong Group, all her attempts appear futile. Just as Dakyung is about to give up, she uncovers details about the chairman’s son. In a final bid for revenge, she infiltrates his son’s school, Chaebol High School.

title: School of Romance Fantasy
synopsis: Sanho suddenly finds herself as the academy’s only commoner after her school transforms into the world of a romance fantasy novel. Armed with memories of reality, she’s thrown into chaos when a strange mission appears: win over three potential male leads and uncover the truth behind this altered world. Amid dazzling nobles and hidden dangers, can Sanho complete her mission and face the secrets waiting for her?

title: The Murderer Targets Brunettes
synopsis: Reincarnated as a green-eyed brunette in the novel "The Murderer Targets Brunettes",  Selenia knows that the murderer in question will be arrested within a year. To avoid being murdered herself, she holes herself up in her room until her adoptive father betrays her and has her sent to the mage tower. To her surprise, the master of the tower is Eon de Grandnoir, the very murderer she's trying to avoid! The tower is staffed entirely by green-eyed brunettes, who seemingly work there of their own free will. Can Selenia survive and solve the mystery in the process?

title: The Overpowered Support
synopsis:
Ho Kim, an avid enjoyer of the RPG "Dragon Slayer Academy", is the single most powerful support in the game. 
After spending countless hours, he eventually manages to reach the major milestone of raising 1,000 heroes to S-rank and is presented with a hidden quest.
Tempted by the possibility of raising his S-rank heroes to the more powerful EX-rank, he accepts the quest without a second thought, only to find himself trapped inside the game world...

title: Warrior Grandpa and His Supreme Granddaughter
synopsis:
A fallen clan, a lone survivor, and a warrior grandfather.
Jinsan Yu, once a legendary martial artist, swears to the heavens he would survive until Seol, a child with an extraordinary gift, comes of age.
Through fate’s hand, they encounter allies and enemies alike from the unlikeliest of places, and unearth deep conspiracies concerning the Yu Clan’s downfall.
“I’ll protect you, Grandpa!”
The supreme cry of his youngest granddaughter ignites a dying warrior’s spirit.

title: Code Name: Tarantula
synopsis:
Nayoung, a newlywed bride, looks forward to welcoming her husband back home after working overnight as a police detective. But she comes home only to learn he had been murdered.
Unable to trust the police, she takes matters into her own hands to uncover the truth.
Too bad for them, though. Nayoung turns out to be a former North Korean spy and notorious elite assassin known to intelligence agencies by the code name "Tarantula." How will the Tarantula avenge her husband's death?

title: Where the Golden Rose was Plucked
synopsis: Every rose has its thorn – even one so fair and bright as Karen Shanaire, a star ballerina in the Empire of Gloretta. Karen, who is secretly a spy for the enemy state of Qustia, must extract valuable intelligence from her latest target, Glorettan war hero and key arms manufacturer Duke Arcturus Kloen. Arcturus begins a relationship of convenience with Karen to ward off scandal, unaware that her intentions are anything but benign. Thus begins the deadliest dance of all: a ballet of love, death, and war.

title: A Cadet Becomes a Prophet?!
synopsis: Fernan Fallenberg, heir to the Empire’s most prestigious household and a prodigy of the Imperial Academy, was infamous for valuing everything by money and keeping others at a distance. One day, he is struck by lightning, and a foreign presence tries to invade his mind. Resisting with force, he instead witnesses the Book of Prophecies reveal itself—foretelling the world’s end.

title: Breakers
synopsis: Choose your player: a noble hero intent on saving the world, or a devious demon prince hell-bent on conquering it? A normal choice when playing a new game, but when gaming nerd In-gong Ju wakes up inside the VR game Knight Saga:RE, he finds himself playing as Siutra, a tiny, gnome-like ninth prince of the demon kingdom. In-gong must work quickly to unlock a range of potentially overpowered skills to help him level up and win over his siblings before the Day of Massacres, when they’ll all be slaughtered by the game’s antagonist, Zephyr Ragnaroth.

title: Hello, Little Griffin!
synopsis: 26-year old Hansol's finally got a place of his own! But on moving day, he opens the door to find an unexpected roommate: a little white griffin. Where did it come from? Is it lost? But just look at those fluffy bird paws and cute kitty toe beans! Maybe he can stay, just for a while!

title: Doctor Quest
synopsis: Makito Shindo, son of a powerful hospital director, dreamed of saving lives. But after his father’s sudden death, he discovers that he had many enemies simply because of his lineage. Betrayed by a fellow doctor, ruined professionally and financially, and forced into hiding, Makito’s life ends in a tragedy... until a mysterious “Game Over” message gives him a second chance. Now, armed with a mysterious power and the resolve to reclaim what he’s lost, Makito embarks on a journey of revenge and salvation, determined to protect the lives he couldn’t save before.

title: The S-Class Hunter’s Peaceful Life with Monsters
synopsis: Chimera hunter Number 17 has spent decades hunting monsters. On his latest mission, he’s ordered to ensure the human hunters’ escape and never return to base. In other words, he’s meant to die. As his body dissolves, his life flashes before him: kidnapped as a boy, forced into endless battles, reduced to a mindless weapon. But against all odds, his body reforms into his human form. No longer Chimera Hunter Number 17, he stands before a vast open land on his own two feet as Do-un Cheon, a human, ready to start his life anew, making friends out of monsters and building the family he never had.

title: One Day, My Sister Died
synopsis: After her sister turns up dead as the latest bride of a monstrous, exiled prince, Louanne is assigned to take her place and hopes to uncover the truth. The prince initially refuses her, but with her magical powers, she begins to heal his pain each night while concealing her own. Meanwhile, her evil uncle, who took advantage of her ability in order to run a medical scheme at home, begins to crumble. Has Louanne truly escaped her cursed family, or is she stepping into something darker at Sable Manor?

title: Beware of Love
synopsis: Nayun, a college freshman, only approached the drummer of the campus band 3DAYS to help her best friend get closer to him. But when the band’s handsome vocalist, Seolu, unexpectedly confesses to her that same night, Nayun’s simple plan takes a surprising turn. Convinced that she’s not ready for a relationship, she tells Seolu she’s not looking to date anyone, though her racing heart suggests otherwise. Unfazed, Seolu suggests they just be “good friends” instead. Between his teasing charm and her own conflicted feelings, Nayun soon finds that staying just friends might be harder than she thought.

title: How Far Is Too Far?
synopsis: After a painful breakup with her first love, Eunpyeong returns to campus still haunted by the past and burdened by a secret fantasy she’s afraid to reveal. When Nyeok, a younger guy, discovers her secret by chance, he responds with unexpected acceptance. Their bond deepens, but complications arise when another girl enters the picture, and Eunpyeong learns Nyeok has been denying their relationship. What will become of their romance, trust, and life on campus?

title: Shifting Tails
synopsis:
Euna is half human, half boar and is looked down upon by the others in her village for her weaker boar side. When a tiger attacks the village, Euna fends him off, but is isolated with him in the process. Unfortunately, she falls off the cliff with the tiger as well. The tiger transforms into a human to save her, taking several bashes to the head in the process.

When they find themselves at the bottom of the cliff, the tiger realizes he doesn't remember anything other than that he was protecting Euna. In her panic, Euna tells the tiger that he is madly in love with her and gives him the name Mr. Whiskers. Desperate to hold onto his only lifeline to her memories, Mr. Whiskers follows Euna back to the village. Euna has to continue to trick this tiger into thinking he is nothing more than a sweet, docile, house cat who is madly in love with her for her and her family's safety!

title: I Want to Kiss 100 Monster Girls!
synopsis: Protalizabetta fled from her arranged wedding, leaving her old life behind. Finally free, she’s on a mission to see the world and find true love. The only thing standing in her way is Meliora— an alluring, heart-devouring demon, lurking in the woods. They make a pact: if Mel can help Prota kiss 100 monster girls in a year, Prota will let Mel eat her heart… but when gods, monsters, and nobles start meddling, things are rarely so simple.

title: Princess's Princes
synopsis: These people don’t know anything about tilling the earth… Salada Horrentz is a peasant-raised Princess who finds herself thrown into the high-class world of Royal Charming Academy. If she wants to defend her people, she must survive magic quests, the shocking ignorance of her fellow nobles, and the ‘help’ of two royal buffoons, Paul and Bufford. When these two world-famous Princely fools start vying for her hand, Salada realizes that survival might be more difficult than she thought.

title: Rabbit Holes
synopsis: Alice is a writer and a big fan of horror who discovers that everything she loves is real after using a mobile app that supposedly guides its users to supernatural phenomena. Alongside Hastur, a Hat-man entity his cat companion, she will embark on adventures that will lead her to uncover the hidden world of the paranormal that she so dearly loves, and face the true horrors that lie there.

title: The Royal Tea
synopsis: Princess Penelope is just trying to win the family crown when she accidentally trashes the fandom of famous masked actor, Allan Reinhart, live on camera. The problem? She’s secretly his biggest fan! Luckily, her new charismatic bodyguard offers to help rehabilitate her image for the public. But why does Penelope’s savior seem to be hiding a secret of his own?

title: Tribute to Youth
synopsis: Dropping out of college was an easy decision for April McKenzie, so long as she could pursue her dreams of becoming a singer. One of her more difficult decisions was to sacrifice her struggling soloist career to join two free-spirited guitarists in an indie band. As they navigate their hopes and dreams together, they find that the music industry is tough, but relationships are even tougher.

title: Literary Link
synopsis:
Delinquent Faye Scott just wants to keep her head down and get through her latest sentencing -- finish her community service and make it across the graduation stage as unscathed as possible -- but her old enemies aren't letting her go without a fight.

However, a certain library volunteer might be the one to show Faye just the kindness she needs to change her life for the better.

title: Cherry Waves
synopsis:
Childhood friendships can survive anything... except growing up. 

When a wedding invitation pulls the boys back home, the years between them fade faster than expected. Somewhere between old jokes, remembering and pretending not to, the lines between friendship and something more start to blur... again.

Turns out distance doesn't kill feelings. It just gives them time to get complicated.

title: Simon Says
synopsis: Riley, Piper, and Noah are locked into a year long game to win the most simon says challenges. Their host, a mysterious alien named Simon, has promised the winner one wish for whatever they choose. With the near infinite power of this new extraterrestrial friend, they'll put their wits to the test against each other to see who'll come out on top.

title: My Dear Watson
synopsis: Cat is a private investigator looking for a way out, but the world has other plans. While their city descends into chaos as random acts of violence become more prevalent, Cat is thrust into a position to potentially fix it all, but at a cost they can't possibly comprehend. A sickness is spreading through their world and they're going to have to try and fix it...again...and again...and again...and again.

title: Fake Bonds
synopsis: Daughter of a noble house, Aria Bellerose, has big dreams of following in her family's footsteps as warriors and generals. But when a marriage proposal between her and the crowned prince Anthony is forced on her by the emperor, she'll have to find a way to outmaneuver his machinations and secure her independence. This puts her in direct competition with her athletic rival Zeke for the only position in the country that will put Aria out of the reach of Anthony and the Emperor forever: The Royal Knights.

title: Pink Through the Night
synopsis: The quiet war between the forest fairies and humans has been going on for ages. To fight deforestation, fairies are trained into pixies who target potentially threatening individuals who contribute to the issue they face. Naymith is different, however, more sensitive than the other pixies, she has always been doubted to not have the killer instinct it takes.

title: Fae Trapped
synopsis: A fae’s exile and an artist’s despair ignite a journey of magic, danger, and a love that crosses realms.

title: A Single Dad in Another World
synopsis: His wife has gone missing. His baby daughter is terminally ill. But as Junhu falls to his death, he wakes up in his wife’s unfinished dark fantasy novel--a world infested with vile demons. Armed with knowledge of the story, he allies with powerful demon hunters to avert the tragedies to come. Yet every action rewrites the story in unpredictable ways, and Junhu must seek answers if he hopes to keep his daughter safe.

title: The Grim Reaper is My Guardian
synopsis: Okji Mun can’t escape bad luck. From tripping in class to near-miss accidents, her life has always been one streak of misfortune after another. What she doesn’t realize is that her best friend, Haseong Ji, is actually a Grim Reaper assigned to keep her safe. When the truth comes out, Okji learns her fate has changed and she has only 30 days left to live. A strange method might let her alter destiny, but it comes at the expense of others. As high school drama collides with a mysterious threat, Okji must decide what to do before time runs out.

title: Love Thy Neighbor
synopsis: When Hyeonu moves into Terrarium Apartments, the place seems idyllic—until he witnesses a man plunge from the building across his window. The residents dismiss the victim as a “misfit”, and Hyeonu soon notices their unsettling, scripted routines. Beneath the cheerful facade lies something far darker: a community that demands conformity and punishes defiance. As the walls close in, Hyeonu realizes that once you enter Terrarium, leaving may no longer be an option.

title: Four Options
synopsis: To Yoonha, a model student at an elite high school, romance has always felt like a frivolous distraction. But when four surprising choices for love appear, her pencil begins to waver. Will she choose the right answer and ace the ultimate test?

title: Social Coin: Your Price
synopsis: All things in this world have a price. But what if people did too? With the mysterious "Social Coin" app appearing on phones all over the world, people are now "priced" according to their reputation and character. While those worth high prices thrive, those worth low prices are in danger of facing ostracization, discrimination, or even death.

title: The Max Level Returner
synopsis: The world falls into a state of panic when 120 million players of a popular VR game, Eternal World, vanish without a trace one day. A few months later, they begin returning one by one after dying in the game. But they’re not the only ones to make it back—monsters also start to appear and wreak havoc on Earth. All hope seems lost until the Masked Monarch, the most powerful player of Eternal World, returns. He quickly assembles his old team back together to defeat the beasts and the nefarious Demon King once and for all. But man-made weapons are useless against the enemies they must fight, and players are struggling to level up without the game’s special items or rewards. The Masked Monarch has a few tricks up his sleeve, but will they be enough to save the world?

title: Funerals for the Damned
synopsis:
It all begins with a meteor shower.
Soon after, reports spread of so-called Immortals. Each time they die, their bodies reset to an earlier point in time, with every wound, scar, and even the smallest scratch gone. Humanity is thrown into chaos, unable to explain the strange phenomenon. Two hundred years later, scientists still haven't been able to uncover the mystery of immortality. The Immortals now live in hiding: hunted, captured, and exploited as test subjects. They are forced to live, unable to die.
Then, a rumor begins to spread of a man known only as the Undertaker— the one who can kill the Immortals.

title: Impure Blood Regression
synopsis: Falsely accused of consorting with Demons and executed by the one he trusted most, he wakes up twenty years earlier. In a world ruled by lightning-wielding Nobles, Isaac Quincy— a low-born rebel turned aristocrat—gets a second chance at life. Armed with memories of a ruined future and lightning in his veins, he plans to dismantle the corrupt monarchy responsible for his downfall. But fate has its own rules: every time Isaac changes the past to save someone, a price must be paid.

title: ShaMONEYism
synopsis: Where does one find the top shamans and the most reliable fortune tellers in the country? Welcome to the stock exchange, where one prediction could make or break billions. This is their all-star match, world series, medal of arts, and olympics all rolled into one. Follow the story of Jiseung Cheon, as he breaks into the world of occult and finance, one shamanic ritual at a time.

title: SUMMER MOON: THE QUPRIDS
synopsis: Yeoreum is just a normal high school girl determined to find a cute boyfriend. But everything changes when she stumbles across a constellation shard and transforms into one of the Quprids -- warriors with magical powers. How is she supposed to date Gowon, the hottest boy at school, on top of protecting the galaxy? And why does her childhood friend Doyun seem to know more about the shards than he should?

title: Falling For It
synopsis: Sujeong writes romance novels but has never lived one. A proud homebody and a self-proclaimed loner, she's content on her own—until the sly and irresistible Seunghyeon crashes into her life and turns it upside down. His charm feels dangerous, yet impossible to resist. Now Sujeong must find out: is he the love that she's been waiting for... or the heartbreak she never saw coming?

title: Dirty Deeds
synopsis: When Sahui’s quiet life at Yeonghwadang, a secluded shaman house where she spent her whole life, is disrupted by imposing CEO Tae-eon Jeong, she wants nothing more than to keep her distance. Scarred by abandonment and a childhood accident, she has no interest in love. Yet Tae-eon’s arrogance, charm, and relentless attention begin to break through her defenses, stirring emotions she thought she had buried for good.

title: A Regressor's Tale of Cultivation
synopsis:
Is infinite regression a blessing– or a curse? For Eunhyeon, it is a fate that he desperately wishes to escape.
Seven beings fall into the world of cultivators. Each has rare talents, but Eunhyeon appears to have none and struggles to survive in this strange world. Yet after his death, he finds himself back at the start of it all, realizing that his talent is the ability of infinite regression. Here begins Eunhyeon’s relentless struggle to break free.

title: The Stand-in Daughter Wants to Be Free
synopsis: Nina Lindra is a gifted student and skilled magic user, but she has a secret that no one can find out. She often disguises herself as her adoptive sister, Lilia Lust, even taking her exams in her place, at the request of the Lust family. When the kingdom’s queen requests Lilia to heal her ailing son, Nina once again steps into her role, using her powers to ease Prince Erland’s pain. As Nina tends to him, she discovers the warmth hidden beneath Erland’s icy facade. But as feelings grow and a charming foreign prince enters her life, Nina must face the hardest choice. Will she continue living a lie, or risk everything to be herself?

title: Vows and Vendettas
synopsis: After a prophetic dream foretells her sister’s death in a political marriage, Arasilla Hugo takes matters into her own hands and marries in her place. Her groom? Demian Vandermeer, the knights’ captain and the brother of her sister’s former betrothed. The only problem is that mages and knights are sworn enemies, and their sharp tongues and stubborn hearts turn every situation into a competition. Arasilla races to save her sister from a tragic fate, while Demian fights for the dukedom. Will their rivalry stay just that? Or will their contractual marriage burn into something more?

title: They All Live in the Little Lady's Garden
synopsis: Evelia is reborn with the Spirit King’s seal, a rare mark that makes spirits obey her every command. All she wants is a quiet and ordinary life, but instead she’s spoiled from all sides: doting parents, overprotective brothers, knights begging to guard her, a childhood prince promising an empire, and a charming demon declaring she’s his only desire. Surrounded by devotion, affection, and endless expectations, Evelia faces a choice: create her own path, or let the world decide her fate. Can the little peep finally take flight on her own terms?

title: Shape of the Nightmare
synopsis:
Da-eun Jeong and Jong-u Yun are the sole known survivors of two killing rampages perpetrated by a mysterious gang. Many years later, an investigation into a possible copycat crime forces them to revisit their trauma.
Da-eun becomes determined once again to find her boyfriend, Gyuheon Shim, who went missing after the murders they witnessed. Meanwhile, Jong-u is plagued by the ghost of “Room 203,” his former neighbor who came within inches of killing him. His sick brother Jongseok was his only reason for living, but with Jongseok now dead, will he help Da-eun? And will Gyuheon ever be found?

title: Sweet Whispers
synopsis: One day, Hyeonjun, the president of an entertainment company, coincidentally sees Yeona on the subway. Mesmerized by her mystical beauty, he begins riding the subway every day, just so he can see her. When they are unexpectedly reunited, love sparks between their hearts... Until Hyeonjun discovers a secret about her.

title: Cat Girl
synopsis: An epidemic of loneliness, shut-ins and social isolation has swept the entire world, primarily affecting young men. With internet addiction, romantic rejection, and other forms of self-imposed social isolation deemed as medical conditions, corporations eventually sought out a solution inspired by online forums of the afflicted: genetically engineered super companions, or "cat girls."

title: Make Sure You Regret It
synopsis: For Olivia Madeleine, illegitimate daughter of a duke, her only hope of a better life away from her cold-hearted family is her betrothal to arrogant crown prince Leoford Franz. When the revelation of his tryst with another debutante comes as an unsurprising wake-up call, she has no choice but to barter for her freedom with Edwin Lowell Vikander, the ruthless, war-hardened Grand Duke of the north. As her dangerous dance with Edwin begins, Olivia seeks to leave her former fiancé with the coldest gift that vengeance can impart… A heart made bitter with regret.

title: My Husband Was Stolen Twice
synopsis: Byeolha Kim was happily married… until she wasn’t anymore. Betrayed by her best friend, she is no longer the bubbly, innocent girl she used to be. However, everything changes once again in an accident that causes her to reality-shift. Now she is stuck in a mysterious but familiar world, and it doesn’t help that her back-stabbing, husband-stealing ex-friend is there with her. Will she be able to weave her own happy reality, or is she doomed by the narrative?

title: Slow Dive
synopsis: One dive shattered To-il’s future. Once a rising star on the 10-meter platform, a brutal fall forced him into eighteen months of recovery. Now he returns to the pool, where rivals have surged ahead and every leap carries the shadow of his past. Along the way, he discovers teammates who lift him up, rivals who test his limits, and the fragile but unyielding hope of youth. In the air, seconds feel eternal. Will To-il soar again or will the water claim him once more?

title: Noble in Name, Vulgar at Heart
synopsis:
Ariana, born into a politically arranged marriage, was nothing more than a tool, used and abused by her family her entire life. On her 28th birthday, she was tragically killed, yearning for a love that never came. Perhaps out of pity, a mysterious force sent her back to when she was 16.
Reflecting on her painful past, she makes a vow: "I shall beg for love no longer. I will never love nor be loved again."

title: The Dropout Returns
synopsis:
In middle school, Cheol Im was a living legend for his fighting prowess. Years later, he learns that his childhood friend from the orphanage, Sol Kim, was bullied to death. Determined to get revenge, Cheol returns to school. But his plans take an unexpected turn when Ha-yun Seo, a fellow orphan who was like a sister to him, is assigned as a teacher at that very same school.
Now, Cheol is forced to choose between his thirst for revenge and his loyalty to the person who once protected him.

This series contains themes regarding bullying, harassment, suicide and graphic violence that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, please reach out for help at Crisis Text Line (http://crisistextline.org/).

title: My Second Life is a Healing Life?
synopsis:
Eugene Pellivia, the youngest son of a legendary warrior family, is on the brink of death—until he’s visited by Pellin, the fabled Mage of Creation, and given a second chance at life.

Determined to follow in the footsteps of the one who saved him, Eugene sets out to become a great mage and use his powers for good. But fate has other plans, and before long, he's drawn into the shadows of a darker world...

title: A Group Chat Without Me
synopsis: “What have I done wrong?” That’s the question Hyo-in An asks herself as she’s ignored and bullied by her former friends at school. She used to get along with everyone, until Juhye Kim and the other kids she thought were her friends began excluding her from their group and treating her horribly. But Hyo-in has an ace up her sleeve that could turn this whole situation around. Her uncle, the developer of the messaging app KitTalk, has given her a special phone that lets her access the group chats where her ex-friends badmouth her behind her back. Her initial hopes of being included again turn into desire for revenge, and Hyo-in begins using the phone to her advantage, making morally questionable choices along the way.

title: Grand Finale
synopsis: After global warming destroyed the Earth, humanity set off for the uncharted planet paradise known as "Arcadia." Crew member Yeongsu Dong wakes up from stasis to find himself the lone survivor, orbitting the planet in the debris field of the wrecked ship. He gets to the surface, where he is immediately attacked by wild creatures, and gets caught in the civil war among the native Arcadians. He must learn to communicate and survive in this strange new world, and find a way to stop an apocalyptic comet set to destroy his new home.

title: Limit-Breaking Genius Mage
synopsis: Verden, a first-tier mage with a genius intellect but no innate magical talent, is condemned to life as a secret test subject after a devastating betrayal at the Magic Tower. Driven by a thirst for revenge and survival, he develops the "Theory of Celestial Reversal," unlocking limitless potential. But with the tower’s dark forces still looming and mysterious organizations entwining with his fate, will Verden’s quest for vengeance and self-discovery lead to triumph, or will he be shackled once more by inescapable limitations?

title: Illusion Hunter from Another World
synopsis: Tired of being exploited by his job on Planet Alpha Uri, an alien finds escape by possessing the body of a human with the highest magic energy on Earth. Unfortunately, his dreams of a carefree life are dashed when he wakes up as Giryeo, a weak F-rank hunter whose magic can't be activated for some reason. Can the new Giryeo level up and learn how to survive in a world filled with dangerous gates and monsters?

title: The Tale of a Fox's Love
synopsis: Yeon is a powerful gumiho with a distrust for love and an even bigger distrust towards humans, but what will happen when she gets involved with Dong-i, a poor painter who defies all her expectations of human nature? Will Yeon finally get the happy ending she deserves, or will she pay the price for falling in love with a mortal?

title: Dare I Hope
synopsis: Branded a heartless and cruel sovereign, Emperor Herace of the Tevente Empire has lost three empresses to betrayal and murder. Into his life steps Eleanor Snow, the fearless daughter of House Snow, offering herself as his new empress to protect her family from ruin. In a world of assassins, treachery, and political unrest, their alliance is forged out of necessity but eventually tempered by trust. Together, they will fight to defend the empire… and each other.

title: Survive
synopsis: No one knows why these people are stranded here with death looming in the corner. As loneliness creeps in, it becomes all too easy to seek solace in others. But they must trust no one but themselves. Remember, the goal is to survive.

title: Apple Black
synopsis:
In a world of sorcery, where items can become wands, Sano, a young sorcerer whose entire arm is blessed with the power of a god, struggles to fulfill his prophesied destiny, hailed as the Trinity, savior of the world.
Fearing he may be quite the opposite with ominous visions seemingly seeking to steer him down darker paths, Sano dreams of protecting the world from a devastating event known as the Infinite Night.

Can Sano and his friends uncover the mysteries of the immense power that is Apple Black and prevent the Infinite Night?

Apple Black is the hit African manga by Saturday AM co-founder, Odunze Oguguo, aka WhytManga.

title: The Duke is a Thug
synopsis: Carjacked and hit by a truck, Park Min Seo wakes up as Madelyn Roseheart, a frail baron’s daughter destined to marry the terrifying Duke of the North, Torsten Icewood. But Min Seo has no interest in romance—she’s a businesswoman who wants nothing more than to annul the engagement and start fresh. The twist? The Duke is none other than her carjacker, who was also reincarnated here… and claims they’ve both been thrown into a romance novel he once read, in which their characters are destined to die. The harder Madelyn tries to break free from her fate, the more entangled she becomes with her thuggish fiancé. And between murderous parties, poisoned tea, and hidden truths, one question remains: will they outsmart their tragic ending, or fall for each other in the process?

title: The Twins' New Life
synopsis:
Reborn as the prince and princess of a fantastical land, Arienne Yuriana and her twin brother, Arhen, should have been living a life of luxury… But instead of beautiful palaces, magical adventures, and attentive servants, the twins are left by the emperor to live with their abusive mother in a rundown castle full of cruel maids. However, after a freak accident suddenly leaves them without a guardian, their father reappears, saying that now he wants them to live in the palace! Thrown into an unfamiliar world of royals, can the twins forgive their neglectful dad and make the most of their new life with him? Or will this world prove too dangerous for the two of them to survive? Based on the hit novel.

This series contains themes regarding child abuse and trauma that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, please reach out for help at Crisis Text Line (http://crisistextline.org/)

title: Daisy: How to Become the Duke's Fiancée
synopsis: Sweet, timid Daisy meets a tragic end after being betrayed by the man she loves. When she is given a second chance at life, she vows not to repeat the same mistakes of the past! The only problem is that she must pay off her father’s gambling debt to Kilian, an aristocrat with a terrifying reputation. One option will take her 60 years, and the other, just three... but it involves a contract marriage to Kilian, who must be three years married in order to inherit the title of duke. While Daisy has sworn off men, the conditions of the offer are too good to pass up. She will be paid a generous amount of money at the end of the contract and also be guaranteed a swift divorce. Is she making a mistake by putting her trust in another man? Or will this deal give her the wings she needs to fly? Based on the hit novel.

title: Double Kill
synopsis:
Kasai was only a boy when he watched his parents die, not from blades or bullets, but as their very souls were ripped away. No one believed him. No one but Naraka, a ruthless mafia syndicate that raised him into their perfect weapon.

Now, years later, Kasai has escaped the underworld, desperate to bury his bloodstained past. But when Naraka comes hunting, fate delivers him into the hands of a mysterious group of assassins that are after Naraka, known as Soul Hunters. But their killings don’t end with the body; they annihilate the soul itself, preventing their targets from reincarnation. 

For Kasai, they may also hold the truth about the night his parents were killed. To uncover what really happened, and finally break free from Naraka, Kasai must hunt the very Mafia family that forged the monster he has become.

title: Cat Bird Dog
synopsis: Cat and Bird have been best friends for practically their entire life and thought they always would be. All of that starts to change after some crossed boundaries at a party, where their friendship is tested and Cat meets a new friend Dog. What follows is a tale of love, friendship and some inter-dimensional adventure sprinkled in as Cat, Bird and Dog have to navigate an ever changing world as well, as their own feelings.

title: The Hunter Next Door
synopsis: The rift brought an end to the world humanity once knew. Monsters claimed the lives of countless people, and those with supernatural powers known as hunters became humanity’s last hope. For Jiho Lee, becoming a hunter wasn’t a choice, but a result of losing everything. Now, in the aftermath, she begins forming new ties and gradually rebuilding a life on her own terms.

title: I Will Become the Villain's Poison Taster
synopsis: After waking up in the body of Giselle Rozevin, possibly the worst character from the novel, “The Poisoned Apple,” our protagonist has one goal: escape the original Giselle’s miserable fate of being poisoned to death by assassins while trapped in a prison cell. Thankfully and strangely, she finds out that poison is ineffective on her and that she can distinguish them by taste. Thus, having fallen out of favor with the good guys, Giselle uses her new unique skill to appeal to the villains. However, is joining hands with the villains really the right choice?

title: The Dying Villainess's Path to a Happy Ending
synopsis: As Clea Rino died, she made a desperate plea to make her wish come true. The demon king, fascinated by this, hastily injected the soul of someone from Korea into Clea's body and proposed a deal. If Clea's wish comes true, he will let the wayward soul go back to Korea. Now, the new inhabitant of Clea's body has to successfully remain happily married to Grand Duke Isaac Detroi for six months, deal with everybody in the nation hating her, and survive in Clea's frail body, which is actively trying to kill her (again) with every step she takes.

title: Campfire Friends
synopsis: After another soul-crushing day at the office, Chaesu wakes up inside the world of Campfire Friends, a cartoon he used to watch as a child. As he spends more time with his colorful woodland pals every night, he begins to regain his lost childhood innocence. But behind their cheery kindness hides a chilling secret...

title: The End of an Imperfect Divorce
synopsis: After a life of neglect and a cold, loveless marriage to Duke Johann Leopold, Olivia Blanchett’s desperate attempts at love fail… until one day, Jian Han awakens in Olivia’s body. She seeks a divorce and flees to a rival kingdom, where she meets the charming but cunning Marquess Edgar Lancelot. Olivia is eager to start over and live her own life, all while her ex-husband secretly watches from afar. Will old flames be rekindled in this tale riddled with regret and revenge? Or will new love bloom?

title: The Dark Duke's Pet Bird
synopsis: What life is there for a creature forever trapped in a cage? Such questions ring true for Isabella Heloise, illegitimate child of an abusive count who uses her as a pawn for his political ambitions. When Isabella's betrothal to an influential noble is broken off, her value within the Heloise household plummets, prompting her to flee from her father’s violence. Isabella finds herself alone and destitute, only to be found by Ethan Holden, a dashing duke with a nonetheless ominous air. Can Isabella trust the handsome duke, or has she found herself in yet another cage?

title: When Pride Fell at My Feet
synopsis: The beautiful Duke Enrico Michele approached like a devil whispering sweet lies, offering a cunning deal. "Just dance for me like a living doll. In return, I'll tell you about your dead parents." Along with his mysterious patronage came a chilling question: "Don't you want to know the truth?" And so began my secret, dangerous entanglement with the Duke, a meeting that should never have happened.

title: The Serpent in the Empress’s Chamber
synopsis: Despite devoting her body and soul to Emperor Laxus and helping him rise to power as an illegitimate son, Empress Lenisha loses her family and is cast out of the palace due to the Emperor’s paranoid suspicion that she might betray him. Now, Lenisha has only one goal: to bring him down. To do so, she chooses a new husband and ally in Kassius, a war hero brimming with fiery vitality. And so begins their tale of revenge… and perhaps love.

title: This is What First Love Is Like, Your Majesty
synopsis:
Once cursed to never love, Crown Prince Kalart stuns the royal ball by declaring his love… for a hefty black cat that looks more suited to a back alley than a palace. Determined to win the cat’s affection, he brings its seemingly ordinary owner, Roserikta, into the royal palace.
But appearances can be deceiving—Roserikta is clearly hiding something… something magical.
Thus begins a whimsical romance between a cursed prince, a mysterious woman, and one unforgettable feline.

title: Moralless Scandal
synopsis:
Lorena chose death to take revenge on the husband who ruined her life. Thrown back in time, she is determined to rewrite her destiny, protect her family, and destroy her husband. There’s only one way to win: a scandalous divorce.
“I need a wild dog… because I’m going to hunt down a hound.”
A dangerous alliance. A deadly deal. Will she be able to take everything back this time?

title: Project MARS
synopsis: Ddeosari Cha, or Plankie, lost her family to an alien attack years ago and is bullied for her unusual name and obsession with aliens. When two mysterious Kudoomians– aliens with pink blood, disguised as humans– appear to capture her, she fights back using a strange power… the ability to control the stars. Outnumbered and outmatched, suddenly a blue alien steps into the fray, offering what might be the chance at friendship she’s been searching for her entire life. Will Plankie finally find the ally she needs?

title: One and Only
synopsis: Ten years ago, Yeonju left Eunseong, the man she loved, to protect his budding career. Now a stylist and devoted single mom to her son, Hanbyeol, she's shocked to learn that the lead actor of her next film is the very man she walked away from...

title: A Decade of Us
synopsis: Bo-yeong and Haewon have been dating for ten years since they met at university. The two have been through thick and thin together, supporting each other every step of the way. But at some point, their relationship began to feel strained. They thought they knew each other better than anyone after a decade together. But they're starting to realize that as time passes, it's becoming increasingly difficult for them to understand each other.

title: The Red Shirt
synopsis: It all started with a retirement. A legend in the underworld of killers and assassins, Sihyeok Cha, otherwise known as “The Red Shirt,” leaves a life of violence behind for his loving wife Miju and their unborn child. Little did he expect, however, that bonds made in blood cannot be so easily erased. When tragedy strikes, Sihyeok is dragged back into the deadly struggle between mob factions… and the fight is far from over.

title: Who’s That Girl?
synopsis: Sanghyeon Kim has the talent and the drive to become a K-pop star—but one thing keeps holding him back: a false school bullying accusation. After countless rejections, his dream feels more distant than ever. But when the head director of a major entertainment company hands him a mysterious bath bomb that transforms him into his past-life self, he's suddenly staring at an unbelievably beautiful... woman? Sanghyeon's second shot at fame is about to begin—in the most unexpected way!

title: The Shell
synopsis: Shy and unpopular Dasom Park rushes to meet her only friend, the beautiful and adored, Iseul Chae. Instead, she finds Iseul's dead body, or rather, its hollow shell. Dasom enters it and takes over Iseul's seemingly perfect life. But as Dasom discovers horrific family secrets, she wonders where her friend went, and if it was an accident she ended up in Iseul's shell.

title: The Genius Swordmaster Returns
synopsis: A century ago, Agito Yatsurugi and his comrades saved humanity by slaying the six dragons that invaded Earth through magical gates. As he lay dying, he learned the dragons would return in 100 years to awaken the dragon god and end the world. Granted a second chance, Agito awakens in the body of Agito Mitsurugi, a powerless F-rank student at a magic academy. With time running out, he must rally new allies--some tied to his past--to face the reborn dragons and stop the coming apocalypse once and for all.

title: Wild Ranker
synopsis:
A blinding flash of light, and his village was gone.
Lowe vows to reach the floating Island of the Gods, but first, he must venture into a world ruled by a ranking system and claw his way to the top. Trained by the world’s strongest knight, he embarks on a quest to become the top ranker, battling fearsome beasts and ruthless rivals to uncover the truth and save his loved ones.

title: Normal Duke
synopsis: Just a totally normal duke who will not stand for these popular - but cliche - shenanigans!

title: The Dawn to Come
synopsis: Neither school nor home is an inviting place for top student Junyeong Yun. Like a stray cat, she wanders into the woods until she comes across an abandoned house, which proves to be the perfect place for her to study in peace. Well, it would be the perfect place, if it weren’t for the fact that she has to share it with the school’s notorious bad boy, Beomjin Kwon. Although the two seem worlds apart at first, in actuality, they are both lost souls who just might find home in each other...

title: Have an Affair With Me
synopsis: Born the illegitimate daughter of a powerful tycoon, Soyeong Ji has spent her life sidelined and scorned by the Ji family. Believing marriage will be her escape, her hopes are shattered when she catches her fiancé in bed with her half-sister. Betrayed and alone, Soyeong chooses vengeance by seducing her sister’s lover and setting a calculated plan in motion to bring them all down.

title: Our Contract Marriage Ends Here
synopsis: Marrying your childhood best friend and first love may sound like a dream come true – but not for Renee. After marrying into a contract marriage with Alexander, Renee faces all sorts of trouble, but none can match her own husband’s cold shoulder. However, a magical wish might change everything. Can a simple wish save Renee’s failing marriage?

title: Castle
synopsis:
“Facing the truth only distances you from vengeance. And the stronger your opponent, the further you have to remove yourself from the truth.”
Castle. The criminal organization that gathers in the Castle Hotel in Gangnam. Eight years ago, they killed Shin Kim’s father. Then they killed his mentor. Now, he wants revenge-- and he knows just the people he’ll need to get the job done.

title: Shovel Up!
synopsis: "Welcome to Another World. Exciting adventures with millions of other users await you!" Or at least, that's what Jiseok was promised when logging in. Instead, he finds himself alone with nothing but an ordinary shovel to fend off ferocious beasts, evil dragons, and... some dude in tighty-whities? Now, Jiseok's only got two choices - dig or die.

title: Disney - As Old As Time: A Twisted Tale
authors: Disney,Beatrice (Bibi) Bassoli,Francesca Siviero,Chiara Bracale,Rossella Gentile,Liz Braswell
synopsis: Clever and imaginative, Belle longs to escape her provincial town to find adventure. Only, Belle’s father won’t leave. He’s waiting for her mother to return— a mother Belle can’t remember. But when Belle’s father is taken prisoner by a terrifying Beast, she offers to take his place to save his life. Belle finds the Beast’s enchanted rose, and when she touches it, images flood her mind with memories of the mother she believed she would never see again. Shocked and confused, Belle and the Beast must work together to unravel a dark mystery about their families.

title: Avengers
synopsis: It's a new day and a new beginning for the Earth's Mightiest Heroes, with a brand new team that's bigger and better than ever before! And they won't just be 'Earth's Mightiest Heroes', either - when the galaxy is in danger, the Avengers will answer the call!

title: Alien (2021)
synopsis: THE ICONIC CINEMATIC TERROR MAKES ITS MARVEL DEBUT! Gabriel Cruz gave his life to Weyland-Yutani--In the case of an alien attack he barely survived, almost literally! Recently retired, Cruz is trying to patch things up with his abandoned son with the help of his friend, a Bishop-model android, but his re-entry into civilian life is not going smoothly…and his encounters with the deadly Xenomorph are far from over. Phillip Kennedy Johnson and Salvador Larroca team up to tell an all-new tale of the titan of horror and science fiction that has scared audiences for decades. No one is safe. No one is innocent. And no one can hear you scream.

title: Star Wars™ (2015)
synopsis: Luke Skywalker and the ragtag band of rebels fighting against the Galactic Empire are fresh off their biggest victory yet--the destruction of the massive battle station known as the Death Star. But the Empire's not toppled yet! Join Luke along with Princess Leia, smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca, droids C-3PO and R2-D2 and the rest of the Rebel Alliance as they strike out for freedom against the evil forces of Darth Vader and his master, the Emperor.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man (2022)
synopsis: Peter Parker is on the outs with the Avengers, the Fantastic Four and even Aunt May! But what did Spider-Man do that has alienated him from everyone? And what’s going on with Peter and Mary Jane? Doctor Octopus is out to get his archnemesis, the Master Planner is unleashing fresh schemes and the gangster called Tombstone is masking some shocking moves that will culminate in a truly brutal showdown! Somebody from Spidey’s past captures the Sinister Six and uses them to create the truly terrifying Sinister Adaptoid! Norman Osborn returns to shake up the status quo! Tragedy strikes when a young hero falls! And Marvel’s two most infamous clones — Ben Reilly and Madelyne Pryor — unite to spin a Dark Web that ensnares Spidey and the X-Men!

title: The Returned C-Rank Tank Won't Die!
synopsis: Betrayed by her team and abandoned to die in a dungeon, timid C-rank hunter Cho-i Hyeon discovers a cursed ring that keeps her alive by endlessly regenerating her body. Time stretches into years as she’s killed over and over, unable to escape. When she finally does, she’s no longer the girl who was left behind. Stronger, colder, and haunted by something growing inside her, she wants answers -- and revenge. But the ring may have a will of its own, and its true cost is only beginning to surface. Whatever it is, it may already be too late to stop.

title: Miyeon
synopsis: Picture this: It’s your final year of high school, and you can’t wait to get out there and live your best life. You blush at the popular kid, and eye the new transfer student with bruises on his face. You’re looking forward to the future… Until you wake up in the future, with no memory of the last six years. Suddenly finding herself as a 25-year-old aspiring actress, Miyeon Seo begins to unravel the painful threads of her forgotten past.

title: Footsteps in the Snow
synopsis: In a world where blue snow freezes everything it touches, humanity has long forgotten what warmth feels like. Seonu, a teenage boy with a prosthetic leg, carries the lifeless body of Iseo through the snow-covered wasteland, determined to bring her home one final time. The snow will soon erase his footsteps but not the promise that keeps him moving.

title: Acting Gangster
synopsis: Taeseong, an actor past his prime known for playing gangster roles, accidentally switches places with a real-life gangster named Mun-gil. Taeseong’s life suddenly turns into a scriptless scene filled with dangerous thugs! One wrong move could mean the end for him. Will Taeseong be able to make it out alive in this world of real gangsters?

title: One of Three
synopsis:
Myeongha’s beloved boyfriend Taeon—her pride and everything—has died, leaving behind a will addressed to his friend Jeongu: “I leave all my assets to my beloved girlfriend.”
But there’s a twist—Taeon had not one, but three girlfriends.
Under Jeongu’s supervision, a quiet yet intense battle unfolds. With 3 billion won at stake, only one can inherit it all.
Who will emerge as the “beloved girlfriend,” and what truths will surface as each woman stakes her claim?

title: Woke Up as the CEO’s Dog
synopsis: After a rough day and a run-in with a missing dog, overworked office worker Umi Seo wakes up to a surreal nightmare: she’s trapped in the body of her boss’s beloved pet. By day, Umi is a dog. By night, she’s back to being human. Forced to live under one roof with the aloof CEO, Chahyeon Baek, the two begin to grow closer in the most unexpected way. But can Umi ever return to her normal life for good? Or will she be stuck living on a leash forever?

title: Escape Devildom
synopsis: Past the grey desert and across the ocean lay the demon lands. Bloodthirsty and savage, they've waged war with the humans since anyone can remember. And seated on his throne, behind castle walls and royal guards, sits the demon king. At least, that's what everyone thinks. And if Merlin ever wants to see his brother again, he'd better make sure everyone goes on believing he's the demon king. Otherwise, who knows what the demons'll do if they realize a human has been masquerading as their king?

title: The End Has Come
synopsis: Minjun wished for the world to end-- until it did. When a zombie appears at his door, the bullied teen chooses to fight for survival. Teaming up with Yena, his sassy yet charming classmate, he flees the collapsing city. Hunted by the infected and haunted by enemies old and new, they discover that in a world without rules, trust may be their only chance at survival.

title: Level 999 Goblin
synopsis: Cheolsu is a loser in life and a loser in-game... until he’s suddenly promoted to Goblin Summoner. He’s shocked when he discovers that his goblin summon is a hideous, max-level monster capable of obliterating any foe with a single attack! There’s just one catch, though--his new buddy can’t be unsummoned, and it draws way too much attention. Now stuck with an overpowered pet following him everywhere, he has to get crafty and channel his inner goblin to manipulate and claw his way to the top in pursuit of greatness and riches.

title: A Shoulder to Cry On
synopsis: Dayeol hears two guys fooling around in the nurse’s office and accidentally knocks over the curtain rod. When the nurse walks in on the scene, devilishly handsome Taehyun tells her that Dayeol tried to make out with him. Before Dayeol can correct the misunderstanding, the rumor spreads and his archery scholarship is in jeopardy. To make matters worse, Taehyun doesn’t show the slightest bit of remorse; in fact, he shamelessly begins hanging around Dayeol. It’s not long before the two begin walking the thin line between hate and love.

title: How to Use an Angel
synopsis: After a wild turn of events, Yoon Kiom ends up being kidnapped by demon fanatics and is about to be sacrificed to summon a demon, whatever that is. Just when her kidnappers are about to end her life, a gorgeous man interrupts the ritual and saves all the hostages' lives. However, this was only the start of Kiom's troubles. Her rescuer, who keeps calling her "Sion," forces himself into her house and keeps lingering around. Not only that, he tells her that she's actually a demon named Gusion and that she's her prisoner. Seriously... What's up with this dude?

title: How to Send Your Husband to Hell
synopsis:
Helena Winston, the dazzling diva of noble society, is thrust into scandal when the crown prince unexpectedly confesses his love.
To protect the Empire—and her own reputation—the Empress proposes a secret deal: marry a man of her choosing and expose his secrets. Her target? Count Benjamin Ischpern, a veiled noble rumored to be tied to enemies of the throne.
As Helena begins her life in an arranged marriage, one thing becomes clear—there is indeed far more to this man than it seems. So she swears: she will bring her husband to ruin, no matter the cost.

title: Not the First Time
synopsis: It's been three years since Yeong-in and Seonghyeok parted ways. So why is Seonghyeok approaching her now -- gentler, and more intense than ever? Will their reunion end differently than before? Can they fill the emptiness in each other's hearts?

title: Ctrl+Alt+Resign
synopsis: Max and Joy may sit just inches apart at work, but they're miles apart in every other way. Max prefers to be a fly on the wall, while Joy is the office's social butterfly. So when Max accidentally sees something on Joy's work laptop he wasn't meant to, he's pulled off the wall and thrown straight into the tangled web of workplace dynamics. Maybe this change is exactly what he needed... or is it?

title: The Monkey King’s Journey to the Murim
synopsis:
The Monkey King’s  journey was over. 

But a new story begins with an impossible crime -- his master, Sanzang, has gone missing. His new mission is to dive into the Murim, a world where mortals and their martial arts rival the power of the gods and unravel this mystery.

The threads of fate reveal not only allies, but foes from his past. 
The Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal has been unchained, but this new arduous journey may yet prove to be his most challenging yet...

title: Ghost Dating Simulation
synopsis:
Struggling streamer Doyeon Choi downloads a mysterious dating sim game, Heart-Racing Ghost Dating Sim, only to find himself trapped in a deadly loop-- where the love interests are real-life ghosts with unresolved deaths. From haunted highways to murder cases, Doyeon must navigate a world where romance, horror, and mystery collide. Every wrong move could cost him his life...again.
This series contains mature themes that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: Island of Stars and Chains
