synopsis: The bond of family can be a star that guides us in the night, or a chain that drags us down. For aspiring hunter Seunghyeon Gi, both are true. He dreams of becoming a legendary hunter like his father, despite his bitterness at his family’s preoccupation with his comatose sister, Sohyeon. Everything changes when Sohyeon suddenly regains consciousness and reveals herself as a ‘Homecomer’, possessing powerful abilities from transmigrating to another world while comatose. Seunghyeon realizes that if he wants to protect his sister, he'll need to grow stronger, and there’s no better place than the Seonghan Academy for the Gifted…

title: Timeline
synopsis: Ha-yoon’s freshman year of college isn’t particularly noteworthy. She became a fashion design major because it was a good fit for her GPA, she has no friends except the incredibly popular and gorgeous Soo-ah, and she has a crush on handsome upperclassman Jihoon. She’s content with her life as it is, but everything changes with a single post online. Now, a whole world of greed and fame built on social media awaits her, and Ha-yoon is determined to find her place within it. Will Ha-yoon find love and success in the cutthroat society of influencers?

title: When the Archduke’s Leash Is Pulled
synopsis:
Jenna, a girl cursed to see others’ emotions as light, awakens as an extra in a novel.
Yearning for a quiet life, she settles in a forest cabin—only to discover it belongs to Enoch Winchester, a cursed duke cloaked in an ominous black light.
When Enoch realizes Jenna may hold the key to breaking his curse, he proposes a contract: she must spend time with him each day and come whenever he calls.
Jenna agrees, but with one condition—he must appear in the form of a snow leopard whenever they're together.

title: Containment Zone Management
synopsis: Welcome to the Containment Zone, where every space is warped by anomalies and bound by deadly rules. From unholy hospitals to sinister arcades, the four-man team of Department 2 ventures in daily to study the spaces and bring back supplies. Things are always guaranteed to get bizarre, but the job has to be done... no matter how many deaths it causes.

title: Playing the Perfect Fox-Eyed Villain
synopsis: Shihu Lee has logged 20,000 hours playing Let's Kill the Demon Lord! for the past 5 years. But when the game takes a turn he doesn't like, Shihu cancels his pre-order of the DLC in anger, only to find himself sucked into the game! Now in the body of Julian Kreipart Prason, the villain, he has to play the part perfectly to survive the many enemies around him while unable to use the moonlight blade, Julian's signature ability. Under the watchful eye of Eileen, the genius gold mage, and his family members who want him gone, can Julian make it?

title: Elegant Aubrey
synopsis:
Aubrey Sandalwood had one goal: to hide her past as a slave, and become the perfect lady in high society. But at her long-awaited debut party, she runs into a man from her past— the boy who rescued her from the island she was trapped on. Colhard Karnus, the only one who knows her secret.

"This series contains themes regarding child abuse and trauma that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, please reach out for help at Crisis Text Line (http://crisistextline.org/)."

title: The Secretary’s Secret
synopsis:
She was sent to spy on him. Falling for him was never part of the plan.
Hyewon Yoon works tirelessly to secure her future, but loyalty comes at a cost. Vice President Jiseok Ha makes her track every move of his cousin, Executive Director Taebeom Ha.
Taebeom knows she’s spying on him. But instead of pushing her away, he keeps her close. What begins as a cold arrangement shifts into something unpredictable. Their worlds were never meant to intertwine, but the more they fight it, the more inevitable it feels. Is it just proximity -- or something deeper?

title: Return to My Dark Past
synopsis: What if you could undo your dark past? Chaebom Yu, a burned-out office worker, wakes up as her 17-year-old self, given a second chance to rewrite her life. She enters high school determined to avoid the mistakes that once haunted her. But the more she tries to fix things, the weirder her life becomes. Money starts slipping away, and strange boys keep showing up… Her “do-over” begins to feel just as messy as before! Can Chaebom truly escape her past, or is she just trading one chaotic life for another?

title: The Law of Immutability
synopsis: Woori Nam has always been the golden boy—wealthy, carefree, and untouchably lucky. But on the leap day of 2028, his 7th real birthday, everything changes. A seemingly harmless reunion with an old classmate, Subin Shin, ends in a brutal murder. And then, inexplicably, Woori wakes up back in high school, right beside Subin who has no idea that he just killed his deskmate. Trapped in a deadly time loop where almost every timeline ends with his death at Subin’s hands, Woori becomes desperate to escape his fate. After multiple resets, Woori finally comes to the conclusion that the only path to survival may be ensuring Subin’s happiness. With just one life left, Woori sets out to give Subin the happiest life possible.

title: Why Does Everyone Love Me?!
synopsis: One day, the disgraced child actress Sara Gwon takes her own life, only to wake up… ten years in the past? Except now, she is successful, radiant, and adored by all. What happened? How did she go from public enemy number one to national sweetheart? And more importantly, can her fate truly be rewritten this time?

title: How to Hide the Emperor's Child
synopsis: After dedicating ten years of her life to Kaizen, Astelle is divorced by him as soon as he becomes the emperor, making her reign as empress the shortest one in history. Because of her decision to go through with the divorce, she is also disowned by her family, leaving her no choice but to raise her (and Kaizen's) son, Theore, alone. Six years pass by without much trouble, until one day, Kaizen's soldiers manage to track her down and bring her and Theore to Kaizen. Will Astelle be able to protect Theore?

title: Dallae
synopsis:
Bo-eun has recently acquired a furry little roommate named Dallae (Korean for azalea), who she met in an azalea field. Dallae has her own schedule, though, and comes and goes as she pleases. Meanwhile, Bo-eun can’t seem to stop dreaming about a missed friendship in high school – her name is Saeyeon. Oddly enough, it was around the time that Dallae started showing up that Bo-eun started having recurring dreams of Saeyeon...
This story has two (or is it three?) main characters, and they’re all hiding a secret from each other.

title: Addicted to You
synopsis: On a dark, quiet night, as Se-a returns to her empty home, flickering lights reveal a man in a cap standing at her doorstep. He calls her name, and when she turns, she’s stunned by the familiar face: someone she believed had died ten years ago. Letting him in sets off a chain of unraveling truths, buried secrets, and painful misunderstandings. But he’s not the only one hiding something. As past and present collide, can the two mend the distance that time and silence have carved between them?

title: Sapient Dream
synopsis:
Kuro's dreams come true. So when he dreams about a falling meteor, and walking through the woods at 3 am to hear a voice calling out "Help me!"—that's exactly what he does. In the midst of a storm, Kuro saves the meteor's tiny alien pilot, a sludgy little guy who fits into a Slushie cup.

Slushii is very cute, super friendly . . . and clearly hiding something. What he does admit is so bizarre, Kuro can't believe it. A dimension for dreamers? A conqueror with a grudge against sentient beings? And the most amazing (and terrifying) claim of all: could Kuro's dreams really do more than predict the future?

title: Paradise on Earth
synopsis: Love, money, fame… They all come to Paradise Island chasing different things, but what they find is a nightmare. Oreum joins 15 other participants on a reality dating show, hoping to win prize money that could save her sister’s life. But when a mysterious virus spreads, turning people into flesh-hungry monsters, trust crumbles, terror rises, and Oreum’s only goal becomes making it out alive.

title: The Spy Life in the Demonic Sect
synopsis: Iseo Jang, the Murim Alliance’s prodigy spy, has spent 14 years deep undercover in the Demon Sect, earning the ruthless title of “Rabid Dog” for his work as their counterintelligence agent. But his newest mission is his most absurd yet: make the Sect’s laziest, most notorious delinquent -- Wu Ma -- the next Cheonma. To pull it off, Iseo ditches his post and applies to be Wu Ma’s official aide. In a world of betrayal, martial arts, and political games, can even a talent like Iseo turn a hopeless young master into an heir?

title: The Villainess is Bothered By Male Leads
synopsis: All she wanted was an easy life as a noble woman. Instead, Laura Jay found herself involved with a series of drama and a number of courters. She didn't sign up for all the excitement. "Just leave me alone!"

title: Romance in Reverse
synopsis:
Lady Carinne is in danger of being sold off in a political marriage, but the arrangement falls through when she spends a night with a mysterious stranger, willingly conceiving his child. Her spiteful father locks her away as punishment for years, until one day - another suitor steps forward, offering to marry Carinne and take her child in. When she arrives at his castle, however, she realizes he is someone she has met before…
The following series contains depictions of domestic abuse that may be upsetting for some readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: I Don't Love You Anymore
synopsis: What happens after you fall out of love? Nevaeh Solene was engaged to the Duke, Baler Eustache. But for ten long winters, she endured in a relationship that was not meant to be. After calling off her engagement, Nevaeh moves to another country, hoping to lead a quiet life. But there she meets Emperor Arendt, who wants to give her the love she’s never had. Will Nevaeh’s eternal winter finally melt into the blossoms of spring?

title: Getting to Know Grace
synopsis:
Andrew is the only daughter of the famous Grace family. She also has an incurable disease. Due to her family’s high status in society, Andrew grew up with no friends save for her maid, Herta, whom she has become intensely infatuated with. Little does she know, her family is responsible for ruining Herta’s life. Can Andrew break the hierarchy and be with her? Or will Herta end her suffering first...

This series contains themes regarding abuse, sexual assault and child abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, please reach out for help at Crisis Text Line (http://crisistextline.org/).

title: Haechi's Princess
synopsis: What if a myth from 300 years ago wasn’t just a myth? According to Joseon legends, it has been told that Haechi, the youngest son of the Jade Emperor, was inseparable from the Princess So-yang. Following the recent discovery of the princess’s tomb, Lee Young-gwang is chosen to curate the exhibition. However, it seems there were more than just ruins in the tomb that was excavated… Haechi reappears in modern-day Korea to search for his princess. Will he be able to find her? And is Young-gwang ready for the adventure that awaits her, full of danger and centuries-old vengeance?

title: Leveling Up in an Exclusive Dungeon
synopsis:
Guilds are there to protect hunters, right? Right...?
Nope. All they seem to protect is their own interests. As they monopolize hunting grounds, the monsters, and even the XP points, Jinhyeok, our MC and a hunter without guild affiliation, is left bouncing from one part-time job to another just to scrape by. What he needs is an opening. A shot. A crack in the system. Then the universe provides one. In his attic. What?!

title: Eat Before You Go
synopsis:
After 30 years in the other world and defeating the demon lord, Cheolho Kang finally returns to Earth-- only to find it overrun with monsters and hunters. Tired of endless battles, he opens a small restaurant and wishes to live in peace. 
With dishes to make and a baby dragon to raise, a heartwarming tale where every visitor brings a story is set to begin.

title: Boutique at 97 Sheldon Street
synopsis: Yu-eun is a burned-out designer whose sole hobby is gaming. Just when she decides to take a break for once and enjoy her pastime, she is met with a system error. But wait... why is the error screen appearing before her in real life?! That’s when Yu-eun is transported into the game as her character, where she soon finds her place working as a talented designer at a boutique on 97 Sheldon Street. She catches the eye of Lord Ashton Richmond, whom she assumes is an NPC. Yet this NPC seems to act a bit too familiar with her...

title: The Gourmet Gamer
synopsis: Star chef, Lee Rim’s life fell apart a year ago when he lost his sense of smell and taste. For a whole year, he stayed holed up in his house, devastated at the fact that his cooking career was over. However, the immersive VR game “Real,” provided Rim, who goes as “Rice” in the game, with a way to cope with reality. Real restored all five of his senses, enabling him to pick up cooking again, and it seems like he’s still got the chops because everyone in the game is willing to pay him for his food!

title: Proof of Dignity
synopsis:
Geonyeong is a brilliant girl. Despite being underprivileged, her exceptional intellect allows her to enroll in the prestigious Pyeonghyeon High School. 
There, she meets new competitors and friends. She struggles to compete with all the other privileged students who have expensive lessons.
Amidst these challenges, she is determined to succeed and become a judge. This is Geonyeong's journey to prove that despite the disadvantages life has dealt her, she is worthy of respect.

title: Why Ophelia Couldn't Leave
synopsis: When her mother remarries into the Arpad dukedom, Ophelia finds herself uprooted into the Arpad nobility. However, due to a tragic carriage accident, Ophelia's mother and stepfather suddenly lose their lives. Alexander, her stepbrother, urges her to stay in the Arpad household for the next three years. One day, Ophelia hears devastating news from an investigator that changes everything. "The deaths of the Duke and Duchess of Arpad that took place this very day, three years ago... were not accidental deaths, but murders.

title: The Circumstances of the Lying Empress
synopsis: Peace is a prize that must be won at all costs– but what if that peace is based on a lie? When palace maid Kochun discovers a shocking secret about the princess of the enemy kingdom married to her emperor, her life is cast into turmoil as she becomes embroiled in palace intrigue surrounding the new empress. A kind yet courageous soul, Kochun vows to remain loyal as the empress’s personal maid, but the storm ahead threatens to smash the fragile peace between the Kingdom of Bansa and the Kingdom of Yufe to pieces…

title: The Day the Real One Appeared
synopsis:
Ever since falling ill as a child, Mel Slofi has had white hair. However, this trait brings her more than she bargained for when it leads her to be mistaken for the lost daughter of a duke-- even being told by the duke’s son to keep up the facade in order to protect his fragile father.
But when Mel sees a mysterious woman at a grand ball who perfectly matches the photos she’s seen of the duke’s real daughter, she begins to worry that the truth may be catching up to her.

title: The Pure Heart of a Monster
synopsis: Deep beneath the ocean lies the Alabaster Sea Kingdom, where its king, Taerang, faces a deadly curse. Born without a heart, he must steal one from a woman who truly loves him or die on his 25th birthday. Having given up all hope as his cursed body convulses at any woman's touch, everything changes when a mysterious woman named Sollu appears. Now, the arrogant king must race against time to win her heart before it's too late!

title: Ancient Animal Tales
synopsis:
What does it take for an animal to live and survive? What would it choose to die for?
A T. rex, washed ashore and stranded on an island for over 20 years, waits for the day he can take his final breath. But just when that moment seems near, hope arrives.
A collection of stories about the great creatures that have roamed the Earth before us.

title: On Your Knees, Your Highness!
synopsis: Everyone dreams of knocking out their insufferable boss, but what if that boss is a war hero, a duke, and constantly breathing down your neck? For Chloe, enduring Curtis's relentless inspections was a daily struggle... Until a royal marriage decree offers her an unexpected way out.

title: Artifact-Devouring Player
synopsis: Sanghyeon has the uncanny ability to absorb powers of magical artifacts—by devouring them. But it took him thirty years to master, and at fifty-five, it’s too late to escape mediocrity. Then one day, he’s miraculously sent back in time to the fateful day he awakened his powers as a monster-hunting player. With a chance for a do-over, he wastes no time using his ability to its full potential, rapidly absorbing incredible powers and rising through the ranks, determined to become the hero he always dreamed of being.

title: Raising the Second Male Lead’s Son
synopsis: Our protagonist wakes up one day to find herself as Elia, the daughter of a bankrupt baron and a side character in a romance-fantasy novel. While on the run from debt collectors, she saves a child from an attacker -- only to be accused of being the kidnapper by the child’s guardian, Duke Kaiden. Taken to his mansion, she’s forced to live with them and be the child’s nanny. Can Elia clear up the misunderstanding and find her way out of this mess?

title: Villainess Streamer
synopsis: Ji-u Shin has been transported into her own dating game. Her life inside the game is now being broadcast live across the cosmos. If she wants the broadcast to end, she must win the game. The catch? The game is set to the hardest difficulty, and she’s been cast as the notorious villainess, Theresa. If she fails to win, she will lose her life. Can she avoid all of Theresa’s bad endings and bring this broadcast to an end once and for all?

title: Defeating Dungeons via Copy Paste!
synopsis: Hanjun is the weakest hunter alive. While others wield powerful skills, he’s stuck with a useless copy-paste ability and mocked by everyone around him. Cursed during the Great Calamity, he has only five years left to live… but Hanjun refuses to give up. When a chance discovery reveals his skill’s hidden potential, everything changes. As he rises through the ranks, a new calamity begins to stir. Time is running out, and Hanjun may be the world’s last hope—an unlikely hero with a power no one saw coming.

title: The Regressed Doctor Just Wanted to Live Quietly
synopsis:
In the operating room, Dr. Jinhyeok Lee is flawless—unyielding, brilliant, and untouchable. But outside, he’s a ghost to his family and loved ones. He misses everything, even his mother’s final moments. By the time he understands what he’s lost, it’s too late… until it isn’t.
He wakes up 27 years in the past. Now armed with a lifetime of memories, Jinhyeok vows to live differently. But peace won’t come easy. Old rivals, new battles, and countless lives await.
Scrubs on. Lights up. Scalpel ready.
And this time, Primum non nocere.

title: The Monster Dame Requests Maternity Leave
synopsis:
Lucia is the captain of the imperial knights and a swordmaster famous for her extraordinary achievements. However, she regrets something on her deathbed: unknowingly aiding a nefarious group in their plot to sacrifice the saintess for profit. So when she wakes up in the past as her 25-year-old self, Lucia is determined to rescue the child saintess and keep her safe until she’s old enough to protect herself. But the formidable knight is completely clueless when it comes to raising a child... Will six months of maternity leave be enough time for her to figure things out?
The following series contains depictions of child abuse that may be upsetting to some readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: The Worst Generation
synopsis: Buldo Jeong was once a legend of the Korean underworld. But after a decade in prison, he walks free into a world that no longer plays by the old rules. The streets are run by a new wave of criminals known as the “MZ Gang” who are louder, flashier, and far more reckless. Though he intended to leave his past behind, he’s pushed to the edge when the youngbloods hurt those around him. Now, it’s time the city remembered who ruled these streets.

title: Mark of the Fool
synopsis: Alex has one goal in life: attend the greatest magic university and become a powerful wizard. But just as his dreams are about to come true, he is branded as one of his kingdom's Five Legendary Heroes. And, as fate would have it, he's the one destined to die. Burdened by the Mark of the Fool, Alex's magic no longer works as it once did. The Mark interferes directly with the power he's spent every free moment studying. But he’s not about to let that take his future away. There’s a loophole to every rule in life and magic -- even the ones written by a god. Alex is going to become a master wizard, and not even fate can stop him.

title: System Universe
synopsis: Derek lives by one creed. Fight, adapt, and rely only on himself. In the years after the System arrived on Earth and warped it into a monster-ridden wasteland, those rules forged him into one of Earth’s most powerful warriors. They let him thrive in the face of the Apocalypse — until the day he broke them. Failed by his teammates and sent through the void into an entirely new world, fate seems to have wanted Derek to start all the way back from the beginning at level 1. It’s a good thing he brought his old System with him.

title: Dungeon Crawler Carl
synopsis: You know what’s worse than breaking up with your girlfriend? Getting stuck on a sadistic alien gameshow with her cat. Join Carl and Princess Donut as they try to survive the end of the world — or just get to the next level of a trap-filled fantasy dungeon.

title: Steeple
synopsis: When Bilinda Baker arrives in the remote Cornish town of Tredregyn, she finds her new colleagues about as welcoming as the harsh coastline. But she soon makes friends with Maggie Warren, a very fun local woman with very unorthodox beliefs. What does a trainee priest do when she finds out her new best friend works at the Church of Satan? What's the housekeeper's problem? And why does Reverend Penrose always look so tired? The two women with wildly different worldviews puzzle it all out as they navigate the supernatural happenings in a sleepy seaside parish, and soon find out how hard it is to choose sides in a war between good, evil, and everything else.

title: Accidental Assassin
authors: Molly Ní Chéileachair,Vi,Perdizzion,Bonob Beneb Studio,Kait,Kisai Entertainment (Sato),WmW
synopsis: Everyone assumes Bonnie is a ditsy redhead barely surviving corporate life until a late-night office attack reveals her true nature: sharp, capable, and deadly. Her unexpected display of skill draws the attention of the Fianna, a secret organization that wastes no time recruiting her as an apprentice assassin. To her surprise, Bonnie thrives in this dangerous new world. But one obstacle remains: Ronan Clarke, the Fianna’s top operative, who sees her as a joke and is now forced to rely on her as his partner. Will Bonnie ever be able to prove herself to Ronan?

title: Murder Girlband
synopsis:
Ema Nakahara has never killed anyone. She's just a girl trying to make it in the cutthroat music industry, stuck as the forever intern. But when she suddenly finds her first big break as the lead singer of Starfruit, an up-and-coming queer band, it is immediately plagued by misfortune: cancelled gigs, a scummy manager, a dead body—and a lot of secrets to keep.

The band doesn't deserve this. Emboldened by her new friendships, Ema will do whatever it takes to protect them and her dream.


[This series contains themes regarding sexual harassment that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, please reach out for help at Crisis Text Line. (http://crisistextline.org/)]

title: The Frostbound Warrior
synopsis: Ryugeom Cheok, a loyal Goryeo warrior, throws himself off a cliff with his enemy to protect his master—only to be frozen in ice for 900 years. Awakened in the modern era, the greatest swordsman of Goryeo begins his journey of vengeance…

title: For Your Murder
synopsis:
Elementary school teacher Gijeong Go has lost almost everything: her parents when she was a child, her freedom when she had to support her shut-in younger brother, and now her very dignity as the class bully among her students and his mother threaten to turn her life into a living hell. Upon meeting the mild-mannered yet inscrutable lawyer Inseop Oh, Gijeong begins to find her life changing, though little does she know that wherever Inseop goes, death follows…
This series contains themes regarding suicide, child abuse and bullying that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, please reach out for help at Crisis Text Line (http://crisistextline.org/).

title: The Beast Won't Let Me Sleep
synopsis:
Adele is a notorious villainess among the high society; rumor has it she married and murdered an old marquis, then allegedly seduced her stepson out of lust for power. As such, she’s shunned and ostracized at social gatherings-- until she meets the most sought-after man of the era, Count Vyce.

However, this man turns out to be Chris, the poor boy she looked after before abandoning him long ago. The once-fragile boy now approaches her without hesitation. Does he approach out of past attraction, or is there something more underneath?

title: Girl Friend
synopsis:
Taeu and Jieun are friends—just friends. Both of them were comfortable with this arrangement, with neither holding any romantic feelings for the other. However, when Jieun returns from summer break looking noticeably different, Taeu’s feelings for his friend begin to change, and new feelings of jealousy and confusion taking their place.

When Jieun develops a crush on a handsome classmate, things start to get even more complicated between the two of them as Taeu begins to try to beat out his new competitor and take his longtime friendship with Jieun to the next level.

title: My Fake Crush
synopsis: Rai has been secretly crushing on her childhood friend Dogyeong for years. To hide her feelings, she pretends to be a die-hard fan of the K-pop group DIMPLE, especially of Neulchan, her "ultimate bias." It's all just fun and games to make Dogyeong a little jealous... until Neulchan suddenly transfers to her school. With her fake idol crush now a real part of her life, her friendship with Dogyeong starts to spiral. One fake crush, and one real crush—can Rai keep up the act, or is her secret about to come out?

title: Your Sweet Breath
synopsis: For two decades, Actress Kang Seo has been haunted by terrible nightmares. Then, out of the blue, San Han, the man who always rescued her in those dreams, appears before her in real life as her personal bodyguard. Will Kang be able to uncover the true identity of this mysterious figure?

title: Like a Chilling Flame
synopsis: Heavy are the shoulders that bear the burden of a household. To keep his waning clan afloat, leader Mujin Baek has no choice but to leave his homeland and venture out into the martial arts realm. When he passes the entrance exam of the Northern Sky Union with flying colors—leaving behind one unconscious opponent in the process—Mujin soon finds that the realm is not the noble place he once envisioned. With his powerful frost-style qi, however, he sets out to make a chilling mark amidst the fiery maelstrom engulfing the realm.

title: Date or Die
synopsis:
Deoksun Kim, a 111-year-old mogul, built a thriving food empire, but her one regret was never experiencing true love. Miraculously reincarnated as 25-year-old Dohui, she sets out to fulfill her dying wish—only to be betrayed by her lover and lose everything. 
Fueled by vengeance, she soon faces an impossible ultimatum: fall in love within 111 days or suffer eternal torment in Hell. With time running out, will Deoksun seek revenge or take another chance at love?

title: Tower of God: Urek Mazino
synopsis: You know him as the legendary Ranker, Urek Mazino—but once, he was just another Regular, climbing the Tower alongside both teammates and enemies. What awaits him after charging into the Tower, chasing after Phantaminum? Whatever it is he desires... will he find it there?

title: Tears on a Withered Flower
synopsis: Romance, flowers, and dates-- once upon a time, that was the perfect description of Haesu and Mincheol. Now, all Haesu has is the ashes of their marriage and a mountain of debt. But her world shatters completely when Mincheol cheats on her with a young coworker. Hurt and betrayed, Haesu finds herself drawn to Taeha, a young man who seems desperate for her affection… and may be hiding more than he shows.

title: Sounds Like
synopsis:
That song… It sounds like my brother’s unreleased track!
Just before his untimely death, Su-in’s beloved older brother recorded an album dedicated to him – a final gift that was soon forgotten in a desk drawer. Years later, Su-in hears one of those tracks on TV, and it’s being claimed by his brother’s former bandmate.
Now, Su-in must take the stage, beat the competition, and take back his brother’s songs… all through music.

title: Maria: The Deposed Empress
synopsis:
Maria, Empress of Rastonia, is betrayed by her husband Emperor Henry after his mistress gives birth to a son. King Helland the Great, ruler of a neighboring kingdom, takes her as collateral so that Henry can have one more year to repay a considerable debt.
King Helland is actually Gunther Preisley, a former slave for Maria’s family. He has loved her a decade and is determined to woo her. Meanwhile, back in Rastonia, two different women vie to replace her as Empress.
Will Maria survive the year so that she can avenge herself, and will Gunther win her heart?

title: Earthbound God’s School Life
synopsis: The strongest god in the world craves just one thing: the thrill of a real fight. Tired of being unbeatable, Mu – god of Earth – possesses the body of a weak high schooler to relive the joy of combat. But when his divine form is sealed by his enemy, Mu must grow stronger in his new mortal body to fight back. Can fists alone satisfy a god’s hunger... or will his obsession be his downfall?

title: Fight for Me!
synopsis: Daichi is a screw up who has broken dreams of becoming a well- known musician. Marshall was never lucky in life, but that doesn't stop him from pushing through everyday with a smile. When their worlds unexpectedly clash after years apart, they'll lean on each other to build the lives they always wanted. And the more time they spend fighting alongside one another, the more they realize they want something more than friendship.

title: Sunny Side Up!
synopsis: Sunny is the spoiled and lonely heir to the Yongwha fortune, but when it all comes. crashing down he's going to have to learn some serious life skills quickly. A chance encounter with Hyun-joo, a farmer from the country side, offers him a lifeline, but only if he's willing to put aside his vanity and get his hands dirty doing honest work. Maybe with Hyun-joo he'll be able to make love bloom in the countryside.

title: Revenant
synopsis: After losing his life and the woman he loves to a ruthless wizard, Theo Clark is resurrected as a Revenant - an undead being forced to consume essence stones, the life-giving cores embedded within all living creatures. As Theo grows stronger with every enemy he defeats, he unlocks powerful new abilities to hunt the man responsible for his tragic fate. However, as the wizard’s conquest endangers the world itself, Theo discovers that every increase in power comes with a devastating cost, forcing him to choose between his humanity and the power needed to destroy his enemies.

title: Hit On Me
synopsis: Hitmen? In this economy? It doesn't pay enough for Vincent (codename: Mr. Noir), so he has to make pizzas to pay the rent. But Vincent's fortunes change when he's offered a chance at a million dollars to take out Dragonfly, the best assassin around and his hitman-work-crush. The catch? There might be something linking Dragonfly and the cute girl who he just agreed to live with.

title: This Fluffy Love
synopsis: There are delinquents in every school. Ashen is one of them. To make it worse, his father is a powerful politician, meaning he can get away with basically anything. To Sarith, who just wants to lead a peaceful school life, Ashen is someone that should be avoided at all costs. But what happens when they’re forced into situations together and Sarith sees a whole different side of Ashen - One which is cute and needs to be protected?

title: Interstellar Muse
synopsis: Stella’s writing career peaked years ago and her publisher is ready to drop her unless her next romance novel becomes no less than a hit. She’s already deep under pressure when an alien named Theia crash lands in her yard and informs her of an impending Earth invasion. However, Theia is surprisingly interested in the concept of romance... and Stella might have just found a way to save the world and her novel.

title: War of Corpses
synopsis:
Uce, a down-on-his-luck young man, dreams of becoming the champion in the brutal and legendary War of Corpses—a sport where necromancers and their knights battle for supremacy. In a desperate bid, he revives Eleonora, an abandoned corpse who claims to have been the deadliest mercenary alive.
There are two big problems, though.
One, Eleonora is alive — a fact that cannot be revealed at any cost. Two, she and Uce can’t seem to coordinate their movements.
Can this unlikely duo overcome all obstacles, win the War of Corpses, and prove everyone wrong?

title: Destined Killer
synopsis: Number is not your average serial killer. Equipped with the ability to identify future murderers, Number takes the law into his own hands. He believes in ridding the world of destined killers. Simple, right? One day, he runs into Jihyeon, whose number changes constantly as she develops a special power of her own. Will the two work together to eliminate would-be murderers? Or will Jihyeon's very existence threaten Number's moral compass?

title: Chetamja: The King’s Eyes
synopsis:
Become a Chetamja! Turn your rage into a weapon that defends the kingdom!
When young Gwiyeong loses his family in a brutal Jurchen raid, he swears to hunt down every last one of them. His skill in battle soon catches the attention of King Sejong, who offers him a chance to join Chetamja—an elite force of secret agents serving as the king’s eyes and ears in the north.
Now, alongside his comrades, Gwiyeong must carry the flame of vengeance and forge it into a blade of duty that will defend the kingdom of Joseon from the shadows.

title: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!
synopsis: Who was that guy that once said, “An army marches on its stomach”? When hapless agricultural science student Jangcheol Kim starts playing the fantasy MMORPG “Paladins of Blood” to escape the stress of school life, he never imagined he would end up inside the game, much less as its final boss. How can a ruthless demon overlord win over his subjects? Perhaps with potatoes.

title: Bad Influence
synopsis: Weisshorn looks like a sugar-coated dreamland of smiling mascots, endless parades, and a Leader who loves you. But for Nel, it’s a lie. Branded a terrorist, she joins a rebel gang to tear it all down. The deeper she digs, the weirder it gets–strange visions, ghosts, and secrets buried for a reason. Some dreams are designed to keep you asleep. But if breaking free means letting go of everything that held her together? Then that's the price.

title: The Fistfighting Genius Mage
synopsis: Zed, a former MMA champion, wakes up in the body of a scrawny prisoner in a fantasy world. Reborn as a member of the once-feared Arahan family, he’s trapped inside a brutal magical internment camp. With no spells at his disposal, Zed trains his body to become a living weapon. He escapes the prison with his only ally Riu, a sharp-witted inmate. Now hunted by both a ruthless warden and a noble house, Zed must fight his way to freedom only with his fists. Can a man with no magic change the rules of a world built on it?

title: The Good Student
synopsis: After losing his memories in an accident, Eun Jo transfers to a new school, convinced he's a model student—quiet, kind, and hardworking. But when he sees his classmate Bom being bullied, something in him snaps. His instincts take over—and so do his fists. As Eun rises against the school’s cruel hierarchy, he starts to wonder: Who was he before? And why does Bom feel so familiar? Packed with school drama, mystery, and unexpected fists, this is the story of a “good student” who may not be so good after all.

title: Copy-Paste Romance
synopsis: 24-year-old web novel writer Yeong Won isn’t interested in love, but she can’t help admiring her roommate’s handsome boyfriend, Mu-il Shin. But Mu-il suddenly dies, and Yeong receives a mysterious package containing a robot vacuum. The vacuum introduces itself as an AI copy of Mu-il, and claims that he was murdered. Now, Yeong must navigate life with a digital version of the one man she couldn’t resist, as she’s pulled into a mystery far stranger and more personal than any of her novels.

title: Love Notes for Me?
synopsis:
Love comes in when you least expect it… or does it? Falling for your best friend, your high school crush, your crush’s teammate, or even your bully... Wait that can’t be right! Can it? 

Well that’s the case for Melisa Neal, a shy aspiring artist that just came back to her hometown and her old childhood bully Trent Springs that seems intent on making amends. Are these intentional genuine or is he still the same person he’s always been? 

Follow these two along with their friends to see if love really does come out of nowhere or if it’s been right in front of your eyes all along.

title: 44th Period: Survival Class
synopsis: Mysterious black circles have started appearing all over the world, and whoever falls in doesn't come back out. Then one day, a black circle swallows an entire school and everyone in it, turning it into a twisted maze of nightmares. Will Doyun and his classmates find a way out?

title: Doctor Elise
synopsis: Dedicated to making up for the sins of her past life, Song Jihyun devotes herself to mastering the art of surgery. Despite her efforts to atone, she dies in an unexpected plane crash. Or does she…? Waking up in her old body, that of the emperor’s consort, Elise De Clarence, she resolves herself to not squander this life like she did before.

title: Light and Shadow
synopsis: It's a rude insult when lowly and headstrong servant Edna comes to marry Duke Eli, instead of the noble daughter he expected. But the ambitious maid hides an even bigger secret behind her obvious ruse -- one that could change the kingdom's very history. Can the two find freedom, redemption, and love -- without drawing their swords on each other? Based on the hit novel.

title: Between Two Floors
synopsis: When Jaejeong Shin’s dad rents out part of their house, he loses his favorite room, and gains a grudge. The tenants? A single mom and her daughter, Arin Woo. Things spiral when Jaejeong discovers their parents are having an affair. And, turns out, Arin just learned about their affair too. Bound by this dirty secret, Jaejeong and Arin grow closer, even as resentment simmers. As secrets pile up and tensions rise at school, the two form a dangerous pact: if their parents won’t stop the affair, they will.

title: I Became the Duke’s Male Servant
synopsis:
In the original story, Roselia was a maid in the duke’s household, used as a mere pawn in his schemes before being executed by the crown prince after being framed as a traitor.
But this Roselia is different. The heroine, now in the body of the doomed maid from the novel and fully aware of how the story ends, is determined to change Roselia’s fate—disguising herself as a man to avoid the duke’s attention.
But wait… why is she still being taken?!
Somehow, Roselia still ends up in the duke’s estate—not as a maid, but as a manservant!

title: Cryptid
synopsis:
The light that fell from the heavens shared a gift with its creations, seeking connection. But humans and their dark hearts would corrupt the very essence of the gift, turning their desires and themselves into twisted, misshapen monstrosities.
Yet, there was hope. 
Heroes would arise--heroes, who would not only stare into the abyss but fight the horrors in it.
The gift was golden, but darkness festered within. 
Now, murky whispers tug on the edge of our consciousness, daring us to make the pact...
But with who?

title: Legend of the Holy Sword
synopsis: The Holy Sword is the only weapon that can defeat the Demon King… and Knight John Forkinstrong lost it. From the desolate Forgotten Fortress to the eldritch hellscape of the Super-Huge Cursed Ravine That You Can Never Leave Once You Enter, John has searched high and low for decades, but to no avail. And the only thing that continues to fuel John's unwavering willpower... is the fact that it's literally embarassing that he lost his own forking sword.

title: I’ll Marry Your Brother
synopsis: A beautiful and successful news anchor, Yeojin's life looks perfect from the outside. But in reality, she's trapped in an unhappy marriage. Not only did her husband have an affair with her close coworker, but he also murdered her parents and stole their company. Yeojin thought her life was over, but when she opened her eyes, she found herself back on her wedding day. Watching her husband and his mistress flirt, Yeojin swears to get her revenge. She will do whatever it takes, even if she must marry her husband's older brother.

title: Beastly Things
synopsis:
In a world where werewolves live among humans in secret, Ji-u Han, a detective agency owner and a powerful werewolf, crosses paths with Yuseung Cheon, a famous actor, when he “accidentally” hits her with his car. And when they run into each other again “by chance,” one thing becomes clear to Ji-u: She must have him —whatever that may entail.
Ji-u wants Yuseung’s rare ability to make werewolves stronger through touch. Yuseung, on the other hand, wants information on key figures in the werewolf world to eliminate them. Will they each get what they’re after? Or more importantly—will they fall in love?

title: You're So Pretty
synopsis: After discovering her "friend" Minchae was only using her to clean up her own image, bullied high schooler Seyo’s life takes a dramatic turn when an accident leaves her in the body of a beautiful coma patient named Kkotbi! The deity responsible for the body swap offers her a deal: fulfill Kkotbi's destiny by becoming an idol within a year or lose everything. Now Seyo must learn the ropes of K-pop stardom while dealing with a jealous Minchae, who has no idea the gorgeous new girl is actually her former friend who knows all about her dark past.

title: No Benefits for the Reincarnated
synopsis: When Airi is reincarnated as a noble’s daughter, she expects an easy life—until her family goes bankrupt and she’s forced to work as a maid for the Grand Duke. While chasing a young lord, she stumbles into a hidden chamber and is trapped for what feels like 100 days. But when she escapes, twelve years have passed, and the world is at war with monstrous beasts. Now, Airi must navigate a broken kingdom and rewrite the story of her second life.

title: Aiming for the Alimony
synopsis: Reincarnated as the heroine of a dark fantasy novel who meets a tragic end, Ibelin is determined to avoid her fate. After being forced into a marriage with the cold and indifferent Dyffrin, she resolves that, no matter what, she would divorce him in two years, taking a hefty alimony with her in the process. However, as she begins to put her plans to take control of her destiny into action, controlling one’s feelings proves harder than expected for both Ibelin and Dyffrin as their relationship takes an unexpected turn.

title: It’s My Life
synopsis:
Ju-in Jeon, a depressed 17-year-old, is offered a ticket to heaven in exchange for her body. But, 13 years later, she wakes up—not in paradise, but in her 30-year-old body… and in the middle of a scam. Stuck for 108 days while heaven's agent searches for the fraudster, Ju-in crosses paths with Do-gwon Ju, another soul-scam victim in the same situation. But what happens when the souls who bought their bodies come back? Will they return to their miserable teenage lives, or find a way to reclaim their futures?
"This series contains themes and depictions of suicidal ideation that may be upsetting to some readers. Viewer discretion is advised."

title: Ephemeral Bloom
synopsis: Unseon Kang’s master has been killed before his very eyes – and now he is the only one alive who knows the secrets that his master wrote about. Anyone he meets could be an enemy who will stop at nothing to gain those secrets. Now he must try to navigate a world in which he can trust nobody while trying to obtain martial arts skills that will help him grow stronger. Will he be able to keep his secrets out of enemy hands and avenge his master’s death?

title: Beyond Our Marriage Contract
synopsis:
To cover her father’s hospital bills, Jiwan agrees to become Taeseong's legal wife for three years; a marriage of convenience with one condition, one billion won once the contract ends. Bound by strict terms, the contract prohibits any contact throughout their marriage.

Three years pass, and two weeks before the contract expires— Taeseong suddenly shows up at her door convinced that Jiwan is the love of his life.

Now, with her payout on the line and Taeseong clinging to a love that never existed, will Jiwan still be able to walk away with the life she planned?

title: Dungeon Porter
synopsis: In a world where adventurers raid dungeons for fame and fortune, Nagi is stuck as a lowly porter – overlooked, mistreated, and considered expendable. But armed with a mysterious magic bag and quick wits, Nagi begins to challenge the brutal hierarchy from within. Can he rise above betrayal, dangerous monsters, and a corrupt system – or will this ruthless world discard him like the baggage he carries?

title: Dr. Kim of London
synopsis: A state-of-the-art operating room with pristine surgical equipment? No can do; just a rusty bone saw in front of a jeering crowd for you! Sound like a waking nightmare? Well, that’s the best that the finest 19th century British medicine has to offer Taepyeong Kim, a young student from Joseon who retains the memory of his past life as a surgeon in modern-day Korea. For Taepyeong, London’s supposedly cutting-edge medical education is nothing but one barbaric display of malpractice after another, and he vows to drag the profession kicking and screaming into the modern age.

title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman
synopsis: Middle-aged Beryl Gardenant has only ever accomplished one thing: running a humble sword-fighting dojo in the quiet countryside. But when he’s paid a visit by his former pupil, Allucia, he discovers that she has become an elite commander—and she’s hardly the only ex-student who’s a renowned warrior! Now forced by Allucia to become a special instructor to the strongest order of knights in the kingdom, can Beryl reach his full potential even though he’s an old man?

title: Regressed, but the World Didn’t End
synopsis:
Humanity’s last hope just got a second chance… and a mountain of debt.
Dohyeok, the champion of humankind, is sent back in time to stop the apocalypse. He then pours his time, money, and soul into preparing for an alien invasion that never comes. Now chased by creditors instead of aliens, Dohyeok turns to game streaming to repay his debt. Follow the ex-hero-turned-streamer as he hacks his way through popular game titles one epic stream at a time.

title: Our Guild's Idol
synopsis: Ajin Bae suddenly dives into Dear Dane, the world’s top MMORPG, using her brother’s account—who just happens to be the master of its number one guild. Tasked with keeping her identity secret, she tries to protect his legacy, but things spiral when she’s mistaken for a creep hitting on Bloomie, a popular female player who’s secretly a male idol. Trying to clear things up, Ajin sends a video with her voice in it. But that just gets Bloomie thinking: Wait… I know this girl!

title: Indulgence
synopsis: Once a year on a cold midwinter night in the Empire of Hartan, a fortress of frost appears, revealing the resting place of a blue-eyed demon said to grant any wish – for a price. When Princess Estelle of Hartan flees her abusive imperial family, she is encounters the otherworldly Frost Fort and makes a pact with Satael, the blue-eyed demon of legend. Pledging her body and soul to him, Estelle begins to plot for the crown.

title: The Genius Swordsman of Mount Hua
synopsis: After being ambushed by the Demonic Cult, Goheon Dok and Hyeonjo, his close friend from Mount Hua, are cornered and on the verge of losing their lives. Before they're both killed, Hyeonjo hands Goheon the Plum Blossom Spirit Beads, a sacred relic of Mount Hua that causes Goheon to take possession of the body of Muhwi, an apprentice of Hyeonjo. Now, as a Senior Disciple of Mount Hua, Goheon Dok must fight to protect Mount Hua and fulfill his friend's dying wish.

title: Mr. Delivery Knight
synopsis: Binge-reading my favorite romantasy novel is my one and only solace after late-night shifts at my part-time job. I was just reading my novel while walking home from yet another long shift, when suddenly a truck…! Huh? Delivery truck driver Taekjin’s struggle to return back to Korea after waking up in a strange world begins!

title: Trauma Center: Dr. Baek
synopsis:
The Trauma Center series returns!
Uncover the gripping prequel to Trauma Center: Golden Hour and follow the emotional journey of Dr. Ganghyeok Baek. Every scar, every choice, every life saved... his story starts here. Witness the making of a medical legend as he takes his first steps into the chaos and courage of trauma care.

title: Castaway Marriage
synopsis: Burned out from work, Yeonseul’s long-awaited vacation takes a disastrous turn when she finds herself stranded on an island. Her only company? A maddeningly handsome stranger, infuriating as he is irresistible–but with survival forcing them together, sparks fly and an impulsive marriage marked by a night neither can forget transforms their relationship into something rather intimate. But as rescue brings an end to their rendezvous, Yeonseul reluctantly resigns herself to the end of her castaway romance–except her island husband doesn’t want to, their love story far from over.

title: Rules for Dating Trash
synopsis:
After a messy breakup with a trashy ex forces Ihyeon Seon to take a three-year-long break from college, the last thing she wants to do upon her not-so-inconspicuous return is to dive straight into another relationship. But then comes Chanu Nam, a notorious bad boy who finds himself having a vested interest in Ihyeon. And suddenly, what was supposed to be a low-key senior year is looking like it's going to be anything but.

The harder Ihyeon pushes Chanu away, the stronger he keeps pulling her back. But something’s gotta give – so who’s giving in first?

title: Amongst the Tainted
synopsis:
Blessed be the devout who remain chaste among the tainted. 
A pious young debutante of the Kingdom of Brandt, Elke Eberhardt prays each day as she vies for the sacred title of Pontifex, which grants authority over the nation’s faith. Unfortunately for Elke, fate has other, crueler plans—as she catches the eye of Sir Reiner Mikhel, a notorious womanizer who has seduced countless noblewomen in Brandt. Despite her firm resolve to remain virtuous, Elke finds herself increasingly drawn to the temptations of this dark, ambitious nobleman, whose seductive gaze conceals his true intentions.

title: Kindergarten for Divine Beasts
synopsis: Minu Seo, a struggling nobody, never thought he'd inherit anything, especially not from the mother who abandoned him. However, what he received was beyond anything he could have imagined... A kindergarten for divine beasts! Will Minu be able to look after these magical children as their new teacher?

title: Date a Ranker
synopsis: All Seong-a Myeong wants to do is spend her life playing video games. Unfortunately, after defeating a streamer in an online game and taking his money, she realizes that he is actually a boy in her class named Hanjun Kang, who also happens to be a terrifying delinquent! Determined to keep her identity a secret, she decides to request a class transfer, only to run into Tae-ui An, another classmate who looks exactly like her game character! Can she spend time with Tae-ui while keeping Hanjun from discovering who she really is?

title: Winter Breeze
synopsis: Set against the backdrop of a wintry Seoul, Winter Breeze tells a story of second chances, hope, and the unexpected warmth that can bloom even in the coldest seasons. Two years after their fleeting encounter at Seoul Station, Haena is reunited with Dohwa at a newly opened photo studio tucked away in her quiet neighborhood, and finds herself drawn to the mysterious photographer she hasn’t been able to forget. Is their reunion merely coincidence, or is it the beginning of something meant to be?

title: The Genius Prismatic Mage
synopsis: In a world where you must steal or be stolen, kill or be killed, Ray, an orphan from the 50th sector, possesses the unique ability to see mana in the form of colors. However, despite the colorful sparks that fill the world around him, his existence has been numb detachment, completely devoid of emotions. But when a life-altering event shatters the cold, unfeeling life he once knew, Ray's journey might just unfold into a story richer in color than he could have ever imagined.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist
synopsis:
After losing their mother to an illness at a young age, two young and talented alchemists, brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric, attempt the forbidden act of human transmutation to bring her back. But little did they know there was a heavy price to pay for breaking the ultimate taboo in alchemy.
Edward loses his left leg after the transmutation fails, and his only remaining family, Alphonse, is taken from him.
Desperate to bring his precious brother back, Edward sacrifices his right arm in exchange for Alphonse’s soul and successfully binds him into a suit of armor.
The brothers must now embark on a journey to regain everything they have lost.

ⓒHiromu Arakawa/SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD.

title: Why You Shouldn't Enter a Haunted House
synopsis: Hyeon may seem like a normal high schooler, but he can see and interact with spirits. While he tries to live a quiet life, everything changes when he meets Jeseung, a classmate obsessed with live-streaming in haunted houses. Soon, Hyeon finds himself visiting eerie places and uncovering a sinister mystery--someone is manipulating spirits, promising to bring them back to life. As he confronts dangerous forces, Hyeon must navigate a dark world he never expected to be part of. Will he uncover the truth before it’s too late?

title: The Scent That Binds Us
synopsis:
Idel Fleure was born without a scent in a noble family where fragrance defines one’s lineage, causing her to be ostracized.
She escapes a forced marriage by being accepted into Euphiter Imperial University, but finds herself bound in another marriage– one to Archduke Chaeron, who is drawn to her scent that only he can smell. Chaeron proposes a contractual marriage, and agrees to take her as his wife for three years and then divorce her.
Will this seemingly contractual partnership conclude as smoothly as planned, or will the Archduke’s fascination with Idel’s scent lead to a different ending?

title: Seeking Your Forgiveness
synopsis:
"I want a divorce."
The arrogant Christoph believed Marianne would eventually return. That she'd left home on a whim. After all, the facts had always said he was right.
Well, he couldn't have been more wrong. Filled with regret, he tries to bring Marianne back, but she refuses to change her mind.
Can Christoph earn Marianne's forgiveness and win her heart again?

title: Tiki-Taka
synopsis: Harang is a rising star in women’s handball… until she isn’t. Unexpectedly sidelined by a devastating shoulder injury, Harang tries to return to her daily grind as a student. But life has a way of throwing huge curveballs, and she finds herself a part of the women’s futsal team at her high school along with passionate, determined teammates. Women’s national league, here we come…?!

title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train
synopsis:
Every night, Yeo-un takes the last train home—same route, same time, same routine. But one thing keeps catching his eye: a girl with a guitar and a presence that lingers in his mind. When a shared love for the indie band Long Afternoon sparks a conversation, their late-night encounters begin to turn into something more.
But Hae-in isn’t just another fan—she’s the voice behind the band, a secret she can’t afford to reveal. As music draws them closer, the truth may threaten to pull them apart. When the final note plays, will their story end in harmony… or heartbreak?

title: Maybe Undefeatable
synopsis: Hyeol Yu is a third-rate warrior feared more for his menacing appearance than his actual skills. Branded by false rumors and endless misunderstandings, he has long been an outcast in the world of martial arts. But everything changes when Seolhwa, the woman he once vowed his life to, reappears before him as a true martial arts master. From that moment on, Hyeol is thrust into chaos, his name weaving its way through the ranks of warriors, sects, and factions. As his unwanted reputation spirals out of control, he is pulled into a conflict far greater than he ever imagined.

title: Miss Pendleton
synopsis: If love is the ultimate prize, then the perils of courtship are the necessary trials and tribulations one must endure in its pursuit. It is a blessing for the society debutantes of London, then, that Cupid’s arrow should be guided by the dainty hand of Miss Laura Pendleton, granddaughter of Countess Pendleton and the city’s finest matchmaker. When Laura’s self-ascribed duties call her to befriend the stoic and saturnine Mr. Ian Dalton of Whitefield, however, she soon finds that when it comes to the grand contest of love, it may well be every woman for herself…

title: Ugly Duckling Complex
synopsis:
Ajin is a carefree high school girl interested only in baking and is a loyal friend who values her bonds above all. Despite her ordinary appearance, she garners the interest of Junu, one of the most handsome guys at her school, adding a newfound excitement and unpredictability into her life.
Will they be able to overcome the jealous manipulations of others and realize their feelings for each other?

title: The Masters of Heaven and Earth
synopsis:
The tales of the heavens are no different from those on earth.
Tongmi just wants to live an ordinary, peaceful life. However, with new kinds of thugs appearing left and right every day, it seems like the world has other plans for him – plans that involve him becoming a legend.

title: Mr. Tiger's Snacks
synopsis: Hoseok is a tiger who wants to make and sell cute desserts in peace. While he was once a member of a shady syndicate, he makes the decision to wash his hands of that life and instead follow his dream of opening his own dessert shop! But this new life isn’t as easy as it sounds. Can Hoseok overcome the prejudices his neighbors have against him and make his dream come true? A slice-of-life story to warm your heart!

title: Marriage Blues
synopsis:
On her wedding day, Hana Gu realizes her relationship lacks love and flees the ceremony. During her escapade, she runs into her ex-boyfriend, Gawi Nam who helps her by using his mysterious ability to time travel into the past. Determined to erase her unwanted marriage, she uses this ability to try and change her fate, but the future proves less malleable than expected. Amid repeated failures, she finds solace in Gawi, who is also trapped in the past, facing similar struggles.
As they fight fate together, old feelings from their first love resurface, making Hana question -- does she truly want to change her fate?

title: Emperor of Solo Play
synopsis: Betrayed by his guild and defeated by a top player, Hyrkan loses everything. Before he can get revenge, a fatal accident ends his life—only for him to wake up years in the past, back at the start of Warlord. Now, with his memories intact, he’s determined to rise to the top alone. But in a game where power means everything, can he truly survive without any allies? The Emperor of Solo Play is back, and this time, he’s playing by his own rules.

title: The Veteran Healer is Overpowered
synopsis:
Top Korean hunter Siu 'The Rabid Hound' Min defeated the Demon Lord with his disciples, only to be trapped in a monster-filled otherworld for 100 years.
However, a century of struggles did not break Siu—it drove him to break his limits instead.
Now, he returns to Earth with Pred, his mysterious partner, only to learn that his name and legacy have been erased, along with his disciples’... and that only 10 years have passed on Earth. As new conflicts arise, will Siu and Pred prevail and uncover the truth?

title: Arena
synopsis: Gabriel appears to be a shy, quiet teenager but beneath the surface, he is a psychopath struggling to suppress his violent urges in order to fit into society. Everything changes when he and his classmates are caught in a mysterious storm and transported into a brutal arena where survival means fighting to the death. As chaos erupts, Gabriel faces an impossible choice: continue hiding his true nature, or unleash it to stay alive. In a world where only the strongest endure, will revealing who he really is be his greatest weapon or his downfall?

title: The Queen and Court Jester
synopsis: Queen Clara of Balladene is in a tough spot! After her sudden coronation takes her from carefree student to queen overnight, she faces the impossible task of holding court with excessively judgement lords. But a new face appears in court, albeit behind a jingling jester’s mask, and this handsome jester has a proposal: use the power of goofs and gossip to sway the lords. With few allies in the castle, will a friendship with the court jester bring Clara more ridicule or a path to rule on her own terms? And just who is this mysterious jester, anyway?

title: The Reaper and the Waiting
synopsis: The Grim Reaper centers his whole existence on collecting mortal souls, waiting to be reborn into his next reincarnation. It is the haunting of a lone spirit that insists the Reaper remember his past life instead... But the Reaper would rather not remember. He wants to move on. Though maybe the only way forward is to embrace the secrets that the past may hold.

title: The Legend of Korra
synopsis: Following Kuvira’s defeat, Korra can finally carry out her Avatar duties and focus on her budding relationship with Asami… or maybe not. In this new batch of adventures, Team Avatar - Korra, Asami, Mako, and Bolin - are tasked with keeping the peace in Republic City as new enemies arise, political conflicts unleash, and new emotions surface. In Turf Wars, can the new triad leader, Tokuga, be stopped or will they be forced to close the portal and start anew? In Ruins of the Empire, the team must work with Kuvira as the Earth Kingdom's future lies in peril.

title: Stranger Things
synopsis:
Francine, a teenage girl with precognition, has struggled through a lifetime of exploitation: first by her parents, then by Dr. Brenner of Hawkins Laboratory. Dr. Brenner wants to harness her powers as well as those of the other gifted children that they hold captive at the lab. Wracked by increasingly disturbing visions, she sees an opportunity for her and all the children to escape. But at what cost? 

This series contains graphic and depictions of violence against minors, including intense gore and distressing imagery. Viewer discretion is strongly advised.

title: The Witcher
synopsis: Traveling near the edge of the Black Forest, monster hunter Geralt meets a widowed fisherman whose dead and murderous wife resides in an eerie mansion known as the House of Glass—a labyrinth of endless rooms with nothing to fill them, and horror around every corner. An anthology series following the adventures of Geralt of Rivia, the legendary witcher from the critically acclaimed video game series by CD Projekt Red!

title: Cyberpunk 2077
synopsis: Explore the depths of Night City through the interconnected lives of cyberpunks, mercs, gangs, corpos, and more! In this megalopolis of corporate power, crime, and corruption, survival is an everyday struggle. Based on the hit game by CD PROJEKT RED, experience the dangerous, yet vibrant world of Cyberpunk 2077 where humanity and future technology converge in these intense action-packed stories.

title: Plants vs. Zombies
synopsis: Crazy Dave—the babbling-yet-brilliant inventor and top notch neighborhood defender—helps his niece Patrice and the young adventurer Nate Timely fend off zombie invasions that threaten to overrun their peaceful town of Neighborville! Their only hope against Dr. Zomboss’s hordes and hapless plans is a brave army of chomping, squashing, and pea-shooting plants!

title: Rise of the Devourer
synopsis: Noah Brown has a gift for fighting. Unfortunately, punching things doesn't pay his bills. At least, that was the case until he dies and an Eldritch god finds his soul. The strange encounter brings him to a new world, summoned by bloody cultists. He’s got nothing but the shirt on his back and a strange item of unknown power he isn’t yet sure how to use. If he wants to survive, maybe even thrive, perhaps it's time he finally put his gift to good use. Art by Kisai Entertainment.

title: Critical Role - Mighty Nein Origins
synopsis: Experience the whimsical, tragic, and sometimes haunting backstories of the party of misfits who would become the Mighty Nein. Created in collaboration with the cast of Critical Role.

title: Miro in Memory
synopsis: Haechan dreams of becoming a hero, saving Korea from the deadly Calamities. But as a powerless guard, he is seen as a weakling. That is, until he meets Miro, a mysterious girl who offers him immense power in exchange for his help in destroying the sacred Seal Talismans—the true source of the Calamities’ wrath. Now, Haechan must embark on a dangerous mission to free the world from its torment, all while living a double life filled with secrecy, betrayal, and a growing conflict between heroism and villainy.

title: No Kids Zone
synopsis:
Doesn’t every child dream of a world without grown-ups? But when a deadly virus wipes out everyone over the age of twenty, reality proves to be far more sinister than a childhood fantasy.
By the time No-eul turns eight, he is already familiar with the virus and the mysterious monsters that roam the land. When his mother passes away and his village comes under threat, he sets out on a journey to find "Utopia," a rumored safe haven said to hold the cure for the virus.
But this so-called "Utopia" may not be what it seems...

title: Justice Deserved
synopsis: Ever feel like the legal system's punishment just isn't enough? Taepil Kim knows that feeling better than anyone. Ever since he was slapped with ten years in prison for retaliating against two burglars who killed his wife and left his son in a coma, he stopped having faith in the kind of justice the judicial system could bring. But one day, he’s given the opportunity to become a Punisher-- a government-authorized vigilante who acts according to the Code of Hammurabi. The bad guys better watch out now, because Taepil is determined to give them a taste of their own medicine…

title: Superfish
synopsis: DJ just wants a simple life with his friends, until a chance run-in with a witch named Superfish leaves him accidentally bonded to a powerful witch’s core. Now a walking target for any malicious creature, DJ finds himself under Superfish’s reluctant protection as they search for a cure before it's too late… assuming the two can get along to make it to the other side.

title: Sirius of Earth
synopsis: Humans have left Earth, leaving behind a pack of dogs who have been waiting for their master's return for years. Most had long since moved on, but a small pup with no name is still holding onto hope that he would one day meet his humans.

title: Her Tale of Shim Chong
synopsis: Based on a Korean folktale, two very different women find themselves making the same wish - to leave this world behind. One is Shim Chong, a young beggar living off the kindness of others to support herself and her blind father. The other is the bride-to-be of old Chancellor Jang, sold off to him for the sake of her family. When Shim Chong rescues this new bride from the river, their relationship triggers both love and hidden intentions. But will these two women be able to find their way forth in a world that favors men?

title: I’m Not a Soccer Genius!
synopsis: Suit up! Jian is an Italian soccer league benchwarmer who needs to convince his childhood friend that he's a star player. A lucky goal or two might do the trick, but how long can he keep up the ruse? Unless, unbeknownst to him, Jian really is a genius...

title: Lord of the Fists
synopsis: Remember when high school drama felt way more serious than it really was? Well, in Taeyang City, there’s a little more on the line than gossip and hurt feelings. It’s more about loose teeth and broken jaws! With every high school in town ruled by a gang of hard-knock delinquents, the top dogs fight for dominance and the elusive title of “Myeongwang,” the greatest high school fighter of them all. At first, transfer student Ujae wants nothing to do with this, but he is soon dragged back into gang life to settle a score with the notorious Sunrise gang…

title: Ex-Love Review
synopsis:
Giju is highly competent, but when it comes to love, she always seems to choose the wrong guy.
This time, she thought things would be different. But again her faith is betrayed, and during a heated argument, she ends up falling down a flight of stairs.
When she awakens in the hospital, she starts seeing suspicious ‘relationship reviews’ of others!
‘Love reviews written by their former exes…?’
Could this strange phenomenon be able to save Giju’s love life?

title: Regression of the Yong Clan Heir
synopsis: Hwalin Yong, once the shattered heir of a fallen martial sect, is thrust back in time-- but he isn’t alone. A monstrous darkness lingers at the edges of his mind, constantly whispering, waiting to claim him. Can Hwalin resist its pull, or will he surrender to the shadow? As the battle within intensifies, he uncovers a dormant power that could reshape his destiny and the fate of his sect.

title: I Will Protect My Tyrant Dad!
synopsis: Sien is your average adorable kid living in the country with her kind dad... or so she thought. It turns out her dad is actually an heir of a grand duke banished from an evil family! Sien will do anything to protect her innocent dad from the wickedness that awaits them. Join Sien on her adventure to keep her tyrant dad safe!

title: There Are No Bad Warriors in This World
synopsis: Hyeonseok Choi finally becomes the undisputed heavyweight MMA champion of the world, but gets hit by a truck, and dies. A fairy, Rahel, appears and convinces him to fight as a hero in the afterlife, but accidentally sends him to the side of the demons. Stuck in the demon world, he sweet talks his way into positions of power, but slowly discovers this battle between good and evil isn't as clearcut as it seems.

title: Paper Tiger
synopsis: Welcome to Hoseon: The land of myths and spirits, where monsters take human form and exorcists come with assault rifles! For wandering spirit hunter Gal Park, sniffing out and dispatching disgruntled monsters and spirits is all part of the job – no matter if they prey on the wicked or the innocent alike. But everything becomes a little more complicated when he crosses paths with his former comrades at the Bureau of Exorcists. Not to mention, there’s something afoot in the Dragon King’s Underwater Palace, and a mysterious red-haired girl who can see right through spirits in disguise…

title: In the Spirit of the Law
synopsis: After a mysterious accident on a scorching summer day, high school student Jaehun wakes up to a startling discovery - his soul is now sharing his body with that of an enigmatic ascetic. Over the next three years, Jaehun adjusts to life with his unexpected companion while undergoing rehabilitation. Just as he begins to settle into this strange new reality, he faces a pivotal moment: choosing his path for college. A conversation with his defense attorney father opens the door to a world he had never considered before.

title: The Emperor's Puppy
synopsis: Many people dream of being reborn as a princess in another world. And Hari, an ordinary woman, finds herself in that exact situation… or so she thought. Instead of flowy hair and the beautiful face of a princess, she has stubby limbs and shiny black toe beans. Yup, she’s been reincarnated in a palace in another world as a dog. And a talking one, at that! Will she be able to survive as the pet of the emperor rumored to be a ruthless tyrant? Will she ever be able to turn into a human? Find out in this humorous story about a little talking puppy living in a fantasy world!

title: Holding You Close
synopsis: After three failed marriages, Archduke Theo de Phoenix has long accepted that love simply isn’t in the cards for him. After all, who could love a war-hardened monster like him? So when his fourth bride arrives, he greets her covered in blood, gives her a shabby attic for a room, and keeps his distance. Surely, this one will run too. But Yuelina is not like the others. To Theo’s disbelief, she welcomes his presence and fills his cold world with warmth and light. As the walls around his heart begin to thaw, will Theo finally allow himself to love?

title: I'm a Villainess, but I Won't Live Like One
synopsis: Bianca is just another noble lady with a simple dream: to marry into a dukedom and enjoy a life of luxury. But everything changes when she stumbles upon a book—one that casts her as the villainess, doomed to stand in the way of her real-life fiancé’s love story with a commoner girl. As Bianca realizes the book accurately depicts her own fate, she refuses to accept her tragic ending. Can she rewrite her story, or is she simply destined to become a villainess?

title: Death Is My BFF
synopsis:
On the night of her eighteenth birthday, Faith Williams meets the boy of her nightmares — Death himself. 

Unbeknownst to her, Death has come to collect on a forgotten promise Faith made long ago. But when she refuses to comply, Faith's reality twist into something unrecognizable.  

Torn between Death’s dark pull and her growing connection to David Star— a golden boy with secrets of his own - Faith is left questioning everything and everyone. 

With the truth buried in her past, Faith must uncover who she really is...before Death finally claims what he was promised.

title: Fantasy High
synopsis: When girls at Aguefort Adventuring Academy go missing, six heroes who meet in detention band together to investigate their new high school for clues. This gang of self-anointed “Bad Kids” sets off on a wild journey, encountering vicious corn chowder and debaucherous wizards, among other perils that threaten their lives and the world they know and love. Based on the hit Dimension 20 show helmed by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

title: They Called Us Enemy
synopsis: George Takei has captured hearts and minds worldwide with his captivating stage presence and outspoken commitment to equal rights. But long before he braved new frontiers in Star Trek, he woke up as a four-year-old boy to find his own birth country at war with his father's—and their entire family forced from their home into an uncertain future. In a stunning graphic memoir, Takei revisits his haunting childhood in American concentration camps, as one of over 100,000 Japanese Americans imprisoned by the U.S. government during World War II. Experience the forces that shaped an American icon—and America itself—in this gripping tale of courage, country, loyalty, and love.

title: Godzilla: Unnatural Disasters
synopsis: The King of the Monsters is back in this compendium collecting three series: Legends, In Hell, and Rage Across Time! In a world where monsters roam freely, some stories have been lost to time... until NOW! In Legends, the kaiju of Godzilla's fearsome rogues gallery get the spotlight. Featuring Anguirus, Rodan, Titanosaurus, Hedorah, and Kumonga! Then, meet Godzilla's greatest adversary of all time‚ the impossible tortures of Hell! It's a monster battle that takes you through the depths of the underworld. Move over dinosaurs... monsters used to rule the planet! In Rage Across Time, travel to different time periods to examine the origin of myths that fueled nightmares: Feudal Japan, ancient Greece, medieval England, and classic Rome!

title: Sonic the Hedgehog
synopsis: The evil genius Dr. Eggman has been foiled — but the work of Sonic the Hedgehog isn’t over yet! In the aftermath of the latest epic battle, rogue robots continue to attack small villages around the world. In order to defeat them, Sonic will need the help of his friends Tails, Knuckles, and Amy, along with some new and surprising allies. This new collection features the Blue Blur like you’ve never seen him before. Gotta go fast!

title: Locke and Key
synopsis: Locke & Key tells a sprawling tale of magic and family, legacy and grief, good and evil. Acclaimed suspense novelist and New York Times best-selling author Joe Hill (The Fireman, Heart-Shaped Box) has created a gripping story of dark fantasy and wonder—with astounding artwork from Gabriel Rodriguez—that, like the doors of Keyhouse, will transform all who open it.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin
synopsis: Who is the Last Ronin? In a future, battle-ravaged New York City, a lone surviving Turtle embarks on a seemingly hopeless mission seeking justice for the family he lost.

title: Beneath the Trees Where Nobody Sees
synopsis:
Don’t. Murder. The locals.
This is small-town serial killer, upstanding citizen, and adorable brown bear Samantha Strong’s cardinal rule. After all, there’s a sea of perfectly ripe potential victims in the big city just beyond the forest, and when you’ve worked as hard as Sam to build a cozy life and a thriving business in a community surrounded by friendly fellow animal folk, warm decor, and the aroma of cedar trees and freshly baked apple pie…the last thing you want is to disturb the peace.
