So you can imagine her indignation when one of Woodbrook’s own meets a grisly, mysterious demise—and you wouldn’t blame her for doing anything it takes to hunt down her rival before the town self-destructs and Sheriff Patterson starts (literally) barking up the wrong tree.
Cute critters aren’t immune to crime in this original graphic novel debut by writer-artist Patrick Horvath.

title: Love Bites
synopsis: When Kieran meets his new classmate, Mason Kane, he bristles with an unexplainable disdain. Soon it becomes apparent why: Mason is a werewolf. But when a fight turns into a sudden kiss that neither expects, Kieran's feelings for Mason turn to attraction in an instant. None of it makes sense - vampires and werewolves are supposed to be mortal enemies, so why does Kieran find Mason so irresistible?

title: The White Tower’s Rogue Mage
synopsis: Once the greatest mage and Grand Magus of the White Tower, Oscar Sage dies in a war against The Demon Emperor—only to awaken twenty years later as the disgraced noble, Oscar Crusian. The once-mighty White Tower lies in ruins, and rival factions hold control over military and resources. With his mana circuits sealed and former allies now enemies, Oscar must rebuild the White Tower, seek vengeance, and reclaim his power before the Mage Council exiles him for good. Will magic rise again or will it be buried forever?

title: I Decide My Fate, Your Highness
synopsis: Betrayed by her family and sentenced to die as an experiment, Phillie Lutner awakens the Tarot Cards of Fate, a Divine Relic with the power to rewrite time. Determined to reclaim her life, she uses their magic to escape her former fiancé, outsmart her scheming half-sister, and claim her rightful place as heir to the House of Lutner. But as she uncovers a dark plot surrounding the Relics, one question remains - can she break free from the past and build a future with those she loves, or is she doomed to repeat her tragic fate?

title: Holy Night: The Zero
synopsis: Raised as brothers in an orphanage, Bawoo and Joseph take opposite paths—Joseph becoming a priest and Bawoo becoming an underground fighting champion. However, when Joseph awakens as the great demon Lucifer and massacres the residents of their orphanage, their brotherly relationship turns into one fueled by revenge. In order to bring Joseph to justice, Bawoo sets off on a relentless pursuit of him and his cult. As threats mount and doubts creep in, can Bawoo’s powerful fists and allies overcome Joseph’s overwhelming supernatural powers and influence?

title: Singles’ Royale
synopsis:
Find love and…500 million won?!
Three women are about to take on a special challenge to escape their “forever alone” status.
The “airhead” Jurim, the “trash collector” Seona, and the “devout Christian” Chaeyul are ready to compete for both money and love for the first time ever.
Who will take it all?

title: I Raised a Villain
synopsis: Yeon finds herself as an extra in her own novel. To make the most out of the bizarre event, she goes on a quest to find her handsome male lead Chang. However, who she finds is none other than the younger, frail version of the antagonist Bi. Yeon finds that the "antagonist" Bi is being pushed through the narrative of a villain -- can she stay by his side through it all?

title: The Formerly Number One Ranked Rookie
synopsis: After learning that he can make money by clearing a full-dive VR game called Prophecy Online, Ray Endo bets his life on the game in hopes of striking it rich. When he successfully clears the game, it suddenly announces its shutdown. However, days later, the world is on the brink of destruction by the same monsters from Prophecy Online. As the only person who has cleared the game and knows its ins and outs, Ray decides to seize this opportunity and profit from his power and knowledge.

title: The Second Chance Convenience Store
synopsis:
There’s a convenience store that feels uncomfortable but somehow keeps drawing you in. One day, a new night-shift part-timer appears at the small convenience store -- his rugged looks fill everyone with unease, but soon he brings about a refreshing change to this small convenience store.
He helps not only his coworkers but also customers, resolving their worries and troubles. Who is this mysterious night-shift part-timer?

title: Zero0: A Space-Time Mage
synopsis:
What if your future self appeared to guide you?
Haruto is a magicless stooge in a world of mages, but everything changes when his future self appears and alters his destiny. However, with great power comes great challenges. Thrust into the spotlight, Haruto must face relentless trials while following the guidance of the person he is destined to become.
But one question remains—why has his future self traveled back to the present? What does he want from Haruto?

title: Electrifying Confession
synopsis:
Hari Jeon is a high school student with a heart condition. One day, she is struck by a curse that causes her to zap everything and everyone around her whenever her heart races for Jeong-won, her secret crush.
Yura Baek, a brash and sharp-tongued classmate who mysteriously knows about her curse, offers her a deal—he’ll help her keep it under control if she lets him use it.
Can Hari find the courage to confess her feelings to her crush? Or will she stay in the safe zone of friendship?
Get ready for Hari’s electrifying first love story!

title: The Genius Wants an Ordinary Life
synopsis:
A man who has everything and yet nothing.
The only thing successful corporate executive Jinhyeok Son ever really wanted was an ordinary life with a beloved family, a desire arising from the tragic death of his parents when he was a child. This all changes after he finds himself back in his nine-year-old body after an accident -- to a time when his parents are still alive, to the very life he had longed to return to! Can Jinhyeok change the past and finally fulfill his dream of an ordinary life?

title: Just a Cat
synopsis: In a world filled with monsters and magic, a cat and a hunter named Hawk begin their adventure with different purposes but with the same goal in mind: to protect something precious and seek revenge.

title: The Bathroom Ghost
synopsis: The public bathroom at the mall is haunted... but no one has noticed?! Easily distracted but determined to achieve her goals, this ghost girl will have to work hard to give people a good fright!

title: Murder Club
synopsis:
Fame, fortune, and rabid fans - America’s new favorite pastime guarantees it all. Live assassinations funded by the masses, brought to you by the thriving entertainment industry of Murder Club! Fresh out of retirement, veteran Holly Mountainside needs to get back in the game, and country boy Bartholomew Greaves, who has never touched a weapon in his life, needs a job. Can this eclectic tag-team make it in the glamorous world of killing for sport?

This series contains themes regarding graphic imagery and homophobia, transphobia, and other prejudices.

title: Primrose Academy
synopsis: Primrose Academy is a prestigious school attended by future gods, angels, and familiars. For the Angel of Death, Azrael, there’s only one goal in his final year: to graduate. With the help of his friends—and a pact to make the most of their last year—what could possibly go wrong? Well, aside from someone at school discovering a secret that could get Azrael expelled.

title: Jinna
synopsis: Stranded in the middle of the desert with no food, water, or purpose, Raissa's luck turns around when Esther, a djinn who can grant temporary wishes, falls into her lap (literally). Teaming up to find a legendary artifact that can permanently grant any wish asked of it, no matter how impossible, the two set off on an adventure to fulfill their deepest desires: Esther to become human, and Raissa to bring back her missing father. But they aren't the only ones with improbable wishes, and they'll need to work together to fend off the competition.

title: Change Your Story
synopsis: Being a shonen protagonist is a pain! Oryn avoids mobsters, monsters, and mayhem to achieve his true dream: living a completely unexceptional life. Unfortunately, his villain—volatile, dangerous, annoying Zef—can’t seem to let him go. If he can’t change his role, Oryn wonders if he might be able to change his genre instead… and what could be better than romance?

title: Cuffing Cupid
synopsis:
Yejun is a private investigator who specializes in catching cheating partners. Love is the last thing on his mind.
But when he's assigned a cupid tasked to find Yejun a soulmate, the two are forced into an uneasy partnership. They don’t get along, but as they work together, they begin to uncover darker truths about each other, and what it really means to fall in love.

title: Holistic
synopsis: Amber’s tarot-reading business might be a flop, but it does lead the dangerously charming and very real seer Gareth right to her tent. Invited to a secret society of witches who do readings for the rich and influential, Amber follows Gareth into the coven’s prestigious Gallery. There, she finds herself in a whole new world of nature defying powers... and crime.

title: Praesepe Outside the Cage
synopsis:
Trapped inside the world of "Praesepe in a Cage", Juyeon Yun becomes the game’s female protagonist, Praesepe, and must navigate a tangled web of romance and danger to escape. After completing all five male protagonists' storylines, she’s thrust into "secret mode," where everything changes. The characters she thought she knew are acting strangely, and Praesepe begins uncovering secrets—memories, death, and a mysterious new ally named Grand Duke Fenrick. As she gets closer to finding the "real" male protagonist, Praesepe must decide who to trust, and whether escaping the game is truly the freedom she desires.

"This series contains depictions of abuse that may be upsetting to some readers. Viewer discretion is advised."

title: Words Left Unspoken
synopsis: James Rayner has long endured the Council’s oppressive rule over the society of other creatures—but everything changes when he meets Kenta, a spirited werewolf working at a quiet convenience store. What begins as an unlikely friendship turns into something deeper, and the mark they share awakens an ancient power the Council both fears and covets. As love and destiny collide, James must face a choice: protect their bond or risk watching their world burn.

title: Blood Breaker
synopsis: Living in a contaminated zone under the constant threat of the Crimson Cloud and its acidic Red Rain, all Mani wants is to protect and provide for his younger siblings. Thankfully, as one of the few who can survive the Red Rain, a 'Bleacher', he has been able to do that so far. However, when faced with the very weight of the world coming for him and his siblings, what will his soul drive him to do to protect them? To break through Red Rain? Or perhaps... to bleach the Crimson Cloud above?

title: The Egg Project
synopsis: Riku and Cherry have always hated each other. So how are they supposed to co-parent an egg together? They're totally scrambled. Forced together for their senior project, sparks fly when these two boys try to keep both their egg baby--and their feelings--uncracked.

title: To Get Her
synopsis: Serious Ann has no love life, instead choosing to focus on her career as a graphic designer. But when a project brings her into happy-go-lucky Libby's bar, will that change?

title: The Wonder Witch
synopsis: In a world of magic and demons, Willow - the most powerful witch of her generation - has only one goal: discover the truth behind her mother's death. The most likely suspects? The royal family. So when Willow is given the rare opportunity to mentor the Crown Prince, she eagerly does so. But little did she know the secrets - and passion - she and the prince would uncover...

title: Don't Enter the House Pool
synopsis: What is Jasha's worse offense: that he's magicless? Or that he's a boy? Adopted into an all-girls academy, his classmates - all aspiring to the Sisterhood and its White Magic - are eager to remind him his faults daily. Eager to fit in, growing up makes Jasha only grow more desperate - perhaps desperate enough to break the Academy's one cardinal rule...

title: Puppies and Werewolves
synopsis: Dan is a lone wolf... literally! A werewolf with no home, that is until Marina mistakes him for a dog and brings him into her dog shelter. Hoping to secretly pay her back, Dan works there as a volunteer, but did he bite off more than he can chew? Now he has to contend with vets, unruly dogs, and the frazzled Marina herself! Oh, and did we mention he turns back into a wolf whenever he sees a moon?

title: HAZESHIFT
synopsis: After illegally sneaking outside the city boundaries, Slade becomes unlikely friends with Calico, a boy from the outer slums who the city deems "defective" Can they stay together when the outside world is full of deadly 'haze', and the only safe haven wants them apart?

title: Justice x Heresy
synopsis: The relationship between a monster and the paladin sent to kill her.

title: The Siren's Light
synopsis: "Never sail into the sea when your heart bears the weight of sorrow," Jaena, burdened by the pain of a recent breakup, stumbles upon a mystical encounter that changes her life forever. As the deep sea threatens to swallow her whole, an alluring beauty emerges from the depths, followed by a kiss that ignites a bond between two worlds — that of a human and an annoying, flirtatious siren.

title: Jas and Art
synopsis: When Jas jokingly claims he’s dating “Art,” his words spark a school-wide misunderstanding that flips Art’s life upside down. The rumor costs Art his chance to get closer to his crush Julienne, who just so happens to also be Jas’s sister. To make things right, Jas proposes a deal: if they pretend to date, he’ll help Art win over Julienne. As they navigate fake couple activities, unexpected friendships, and school drama, their carefully crafted act becomes more complicated than they ever anticipated.

title: The Princess is Now the Duke
synopsis: Princess Amara fakes her own death to escape an unwanted marriage and reinvents herself as Duke Alexander—the perfect suitor to marry Lady Elaine, the woman she truly loves. But Elaine, unaware of the truth, is set to marry Prince Edgars—Amara’s own brother. When the Emperor declares a tournament for Elaine’s hand and the throne, Alexander must outfight rival suitors and win Elaine's trust—all while keeping her true identity a secret.

title: True and Me
synopsis:
What if your “true self” jumped out of the mirror and got mixed up in your life?
That’s what happens to “Me”, an insecure trans guy, when he meets his flamboyant “True” self, determined to teach “Me” to love himself. Follow them and their friends on a journey filled with comedy, overthinking and nerdiness!

title: Surviving as the Crown Prince's Childhood Friend
synopsis: When Ella finds a sickly young boy suffering from a mysterious illness in a cave, she brings him home, only for her to discover a special healing power that helps him recover. Six years later, Carl has grown into a striking young man, but to Ella, he remains like a brother… or so she thinks. Though childhood friends, what Ella doesn’t know, is that Carl is the lost crown prince of the Easton Empire, believed to have perished in a fire… and is only biding his time to make things right again. But Carl has another secret–his feelings for Ella go far beyond family…

title: The Archmage’s Restaurant
synopsis:
A young aspiring chef suddenly finds himself in a world of war, dragons, and magic. These two worlds couldn’t be further apart... or could they? 
Who says you can’t open a restaurant in a fantasy realm? I mean, what could possibly go wrong?
A perfect series for fantasy, magic, and food lovers.

title: This Wasn’t in My Adoption Plan!
synopsis:
I spent a decade cleaning up after Duke Havenik Brauno’s mess only to be murdered by him?
Reincarnated as Aerin Brauno, an illegitimate child of the Brauno family, she’s horrified to find her adoptive father is none other than the man who killed her. This time, Aerin refuses to let him control her fate. Armed with the knowledge from her past life, she’s determined to escape his grasp and find a new path. Can she rewrite her destiny, outsmart the deadly Duke, and maybe even save the Brauno family?

title: Her Tiny Highness, the Mastermind
synopsis: The martial arts world's most dangerous mastermind finds herself reborn in the weakest possible form: a tiny toddler and holy monarch’s successor, destined to die young. But Danye Jin didn't survive centuries of martial arts intrigue just to accept defeat in diapers. Armed with ancient techniques and disarming baby charm, this mysteriously capable little girl is turning imminent death into the realm's greatest adventure. Who knew saving yourself could be so adorably dangerous?

title: Best Laid Wedding Plans
synopsis: After suffering her own heartbreak, Melissa devoted her life to creating peoples’ perfect weddings. Her professional and emotional worlds collide spectacularly when a dream client walks into her office, only for Melissa to learn that the bride-to-be’s fiancé is none other than the man she once planned to marry. Will she subtly sabotage the one who broke her heart or will the forced proximity allow them to address unresolved feelings to rekindle or finally move on?

title: The Zenith
synopsis:
Jinwol Ma, better known in the martial realm as the ‘Mad Demon’, once stained the earth with blood in his pursuit to become the pinnacle of all living things.
That was until his final battle with the Five Supreme Masters, where the leader of the Fire Dragon sect sealed him away using the Demon-Sealing Sword.
Now, three thousand years later, Jinwol awakens, but he is no longer on Earth. Instead, he finds himself surrounded by hostile alien civilizations.
Will Jinwol rise once again to aim for the peak of all living creatures?

title: Blood System
synopsis:
In a dangerous world teeming with monsters at every turn, the kingdoms placed their hopes in the System Users, powerful adventurers who grew stronger faster than anyone else. Among them was Novis, one of the most righteous of all.
But when a quest goes horribly wrong, Novis’s system becomes infected... and his first new quest is a thirst for blood.
The world isn't as simple as Novis once believed. The line between monsters and humans begins to blur, because Novis is no longer just a man. He’s a vampire... a vampire wielding the kingdom’s most powerful system.

title: Double Mafia Godfather!
synopsis: Despite his terrifying face and aura, Brian chases his pure-hearted dream of becoming an actor… with little success. When a mob boss’s daughter needs an actor to impersonate her actually-terrifying father, it seems like the answer to Brian’s prayers. If Brian can survive subterfuge, shootouts, mafia chaos, and Vivianne, this might just be his greatest performance yet.

title: Bodyguard Babysitter
synopsis:
The world's deadliest assassin just got the hardest assignment of his life: babysitting.
After years of bloodshed, legendary hitman William has finally retired. But his peaceful life comes to an end when an old friend entrusts him with his only child, Ko.
At first, the job seems simple. Ko is an energetic 8-year-old with a bucket list inspired by her favorite movies and TV shows. From eating her first burger to seeing the world for the very first time, she's determined to make the most of her life.
But when Ko's father suddenly disappears, assassins, criminal organizations, and even world governments begin hunting her. As the attacks grow more relentless, William realizes the girl he's protecting may be the most valuable target on Earth.
Now, a retired assassin and a stubborn young girl must race across the country in search of her missing father while staying one step ahead of the powerful forces closing in on them.
But why is the entire world hunting Ko?

title: On the Way to Meet Mom
synopsis:
One day, after being discovered in an abandoned house by a rescue team, Mori suddenly finds himself in a children's protection center. Here, he begins to learn a new way of life – one that includes grand care packages sent by a mysterious patron.
But when his closest friend is reunited with her mother and leaves the center, Mori learns for the first time the existence of a mother for every child, and decides to embark on a journey to find his own. But what sort of obstacles wait along the way?

title: Momfluencer
synopsis: How far would you go for fame and wealth? Fledgling mommy influencer Juyeon Park is desperate to join the ranks of popular internet celebrities. Thanks to a video of her daughter going viral and her “friend” from high school, popular influencer Yehui Kim, she finally gets the chance to join the ultra-exclusive Deep Pink Society, a group made up of former idols, wealthy CEOs, and social media stars. Elated at the chance to become one of the glittering elite, she’s determined to do whatever it takes to make this work -- no matter the cost.

title: The Forbidden Marriage
synopsis:
It’s been seven years since King Heon Lee declared a marriage ban in Joseon after the death of his wife. But one day, he comes across a woman named Sorang Ye who claims she can summon the spirits of the dead. Though Sorang was lying about her spiritual powers, she now has no choice but to put on an act for the king.
As the secrets behind the mysterious death of the king’s wife and Sorang’s past start unraveling, the red thread of fate becomes more entangled…

title: The Tyrant of the Apocalypse Returns
authors: Lee sung jae,Moon Chang Hyun,Injeolmi,Lee hyung suk
synopsis:
As Hellgates open across the globe, humanity falls, bringing with it the death of Goong Nam’s family. On the edge of a cliff, he loses hold of his beloved daughter’s hand as she falls straight into the jaws of a fiend. He wishes to reach out one more time with his shattered arm and grab her hand. He wishes to turn back time. 
These wishes can be granted, but for a price: completing a legendary quest by offering the heads of 666,666 high-ranking demons. Thus begins Goong’s unrelenting, blood-soaked battle, filled with chaos and an unyielding love for his family.

title: Till Crimes Do Us Part
synopsis: Althea -- heiress to the Loviatar crime syndicate -- has been playing a cat and mouse game with the duke and head Jupiter agent Damien Reed for years. The phantom thief has stolen art, gems, secrets and gotten away without a trace. But the one thing she can't get away from is her father's control. So she has no choice but to accept when he offers up this impossible bargain: impersonate Damien's fianceé, take down Jupiter from the inside, and kill Damien in exchange for her freedom. All Althea needs to do is not get caught or fall in love with the duke in the process.

title: All Colors of Snow
synopsis: Balls, operas, beautiful ladies in silk and muslin, footmen, cadets, love, champagne, Parisian sunsets, alleys, funny pranks and walks, Schubert's waltzes, Indian tea aroma, poems in thick volumes and the sparkle of unfamiliar eyes. How to find yourself among all these new things? How not to lose yourself?

title: The Ghost Duchess
synopsis: Murdered on her wedding day, Alena returns as a ghost to kill the mastermind of her assassination: her very own groom. What happens when her target is not only the most powerful man in the kingdom but could also see and touch a ghost? His touch unraveled sensations she was supposed to never feel again. But Alena is determined to fulfill her dying wish and not even the mysterious duke’s allure could stop her from delivering justice with her own two hands.

title: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life
synopsis: After a lifetime of bloodshed, the Heavenly Demon longs for peace. In his final moments, he uncovers the truth about his power and yearns for a different life. He wakes up in the body of Taesan Byeok, the frail second son of a powerful merchant family, barely clinging to life. Using his knowledge from his life as the Heavenly Demon, Taesan must navigate a world of temptation and corruption to survive. As his martial arts reputation grows, new enemies emerge to disrupt his quiet life. Yet, Taesan is determined to live on his own terms, despite the chaos around him.

title: The Regressed Empress’s Abduction Marriage
synopsis: Eliano, the daughter of a powerful duke, marries the seventh prince of Jakador, and they fall in love. But their happiness is short-lived when the prince ascends to the throne. After suffering a miscarriage, she is cruelly poisoned by her husband and dies. Eliano miraculously wakes up to find herself 21 years old and is now determined to avoid the tragic future she once lived. Will she be able to find happiness in this new life?

title: Find My Crown
synopsis: Ari is a headless grim reaper who has been guiding souls to the afterlife for hundreds of years. She has always felt unseen and unloved because no one can see her face. That all changes when she encounters Ucheol, a popular actor who can see her head and agrees to help her search for it. Will Ari find her missing head and reclaim her identity, finally freeing herself from a lifetime of loneliness?

title: A Husband I Didn’t Expect
synopsis:
Gyeo-ul has lucked into a marriage with a rich, handsome, and kind man. The catch? She has no idea how it happened.
After an accident wipes out the past year of her memory, Gyeo-ul finds herself living a life she doesn't recognize: Sihu Kang, her sworn enemy, is now her doting spouse, and he won't stop gushing over her.
“Wait, I have to share a bed with this guy? And kiss him, too?! Why does he keep saying he loves me?!”
Something about this marriage doesn’t add up.

title: Thiendavis: The Road to Salvation
synopsis: Evie Ariatte, a lovely saintess candidate, has her bright future shattered when a sudden curse forces her to answer every question with the truth. This unexpected twist of fate threatens her reputation and jeopardizes her dream of becoming the saintess. As her blunt honesty earns her both friends and enemies, will Evie uncover the hidden truths of Thiendavis and bring about its perfect salvation?

title: A Kiss Before I Sleep
synopsis: Jiho has a superpower that causes explosions whenever she gets excited, making dating and fun nearly impossible—until she discovers that touching her new neighbor, Yechan, miraculously helps her control her ability. Determined to maintain physical contact without outright harassing him, Jiho embarks on a mission to “seduce” Yechan and become his girlfriend. Along the way, ghostly advice and a whirlwind of chaos lead her to uncover the mystery of their unique connection in this unpredictable romance.

title: My Clueless Love Diary
synopsis:
“I’m gonna live a normal life!”
 Cho-eun, the heir to the powerful underground clan, Hongsal, has entered university.
 Her only wish? To make lots of friends and enjoy a peaceful, ordinary college life. But who are these four mysterious guys constantly hanging around her?
 'Are you my enemy? My ally? Or... do you like me?'
 Thrown into a whirlwind of emotions at twenty, can Cho-eun finally achieve the campus life she’s always dreamed of?

title: The Merman Trapped in My Lake
synopsis:
Servaine Noxirel was never easily pleased, but that changed when her father gifted her a merman, named Mel. Mel became Servaine’s entire world, but as Servaine’s health worsened and before her death, she confessed her love but never heard his answer.

A century passes by and, Mel, now a human, instantly recognizes Servaine’s great grandniece, whose resemblance matches that of her name. But the reasons behind Mel’s long wait and his true feelings remain a mystery. Is it love he seeks, or revenge?

This series contains themes regarding depression, suicidal ideation and abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, please reach out for help at Crisis Text Line (http://crisistextline.org/)

title: The Beloved Incompetent Stepmom
synopsis: Dismissed as incompetent and neglected by her family, the Duke’s daughter, Elsha, is suddenly ordered to marry the infamous Archduke Iceberg—a war hero feared for his ruthless reputation. Rather than despair, she seizes this chance for a fresh start. But upon arriving at his manor, she finds the Archduke missing and is instead met by his wary adopted sons, Wilbert and Hugh—who had no idea their father was remarrying. With an absent husband, distrustful stepchildren, and a manor full of secrets, can Elsha carve out a place for herself and find happiness at last?

title: Teach Me How to Desire
synopsis: In a war against demons for the fate of the world, even three chances at life may not suffice. Such is the fate of Lady Sacred Beryl, a divine maiden tasked with rooting out demonic corruption, only to be murdered and travel back in time -- twice. Upon her third attempt, Beryl realizes the truth: Her only hope to purify the realm is to face the fearsome House Vine, a lair of demons in mortal guise. Can Beryl survive in the domain of Duke Beleth von Vine, or will she find nothing but death and damnation once more?

title: Don't Worry, Dear NPC!
synopsis: The RPG “Lost Story” not only allows players to interact with NPCs but also introduces a new system to rank your closeness with them. With this update, the hero discovers that his relationship with Emma, one of the guild receptionists, is maxed out—even though that shouldn’t be possible! Despite being level 99, Emma always worries whenever he leaves, no matter how much he tries to reassure her that he’ll be fine. Meanwhile, he encounters two star-crossed lovers: the inventor Slaki and Iragneff, the avatar of a god. Can he help them be together while also coming to terms with his own feelings for Emma?

title: In the Shadow of the Spring
synopsis: Chahee finds herself being forced to return to her hometown of Cheongna, where she practically ran away from after graduating high school. The reality of her family's poverty and misfortunes begin to overwhelm her, all while her first love and ex-boyfriend Wookyeong insists on coming back into her life. She was the one who broke his heart, but he seems to still have feelings for her, flirting with her incessantly and making her waver. This is a story about Chahee's heart-wrenching first love that she has no choice but to turn her back on.

title: Just Read Me Already!
synopsis: 300 years. That was how long it had been since he had last been opened. For 3 whole centuries, the mysterious book of magic, also known as Grimoire, has been stuck on the shelf of the Le Temis Royal Academy Library. Just then, an apprentice mage opens the Grimoire, only to die in a freak accident. As the dismayed Grimoire awaits his teleportation to a new location, the library door creeps open and a mysterious girl, Riley, approaches and opens the Grimoire, becoming his new contractor.

title: Our Secret Marriage
synopsis: Yoonseol Choi, a business student and orphan, lives with her beloved grandfather. But when he falls gravely ill, her whole world is shaken. Before his time runs out, his final wish is to see her marry a good man. Determined to fulfill his request at any cost, Yoonseol embarks on a desperate search for a suitable husband. Love was never her priority, but could an unexpected romance change her heart?

title: Demon Lord
synopsis: Following the brutal Virtuous-Demonic War, the Demon Cult emerges victorious, seizing control of the world. But their triumph is shaken when the Cult’s vice-leader is assassinated in a sinister conspiracy. From the shadows emerges Ryeon-hwi Hyeok, Crown Prince of the Demon Cult. Determined to uncover the truth and avenge his brother, he infiltrates the elite Academy of Mirages. There, he crosses paths with Seol Bi, a hidden master from the Virtuous Sect, and as the two aid each other, their relationship begins to blossom… Follow Ryeon-hwi on his journey to conquer the murim and become the next Demon King!

title: Clevatess
synopsis: Wrapped in a mane as bright as light and covered in fur as dark as the night, Clevatess oversees his territory as one of the Four Lords of Dark Beasts. His life, however, takes a sharp turn when he adopts a humanoid baby and revives a hero he slew following fiery destructions and deaths. What fate awaits the trio in their journey?

title: Not the Time for Love
synopsis: Betrayed by love and cast aside by society, Liz finds herself at the edge of despair, with nothing left but her tragic fate. As darkness slowly closes in around her, a flicker of hope appears – a chance to reclaim her life and rewrite her story. Should the naive girl who once believed in love’s promises face her cruel destiny, or transform into a force of vengeance against those who deceived her? The decisions Liz makes will shape her destiny, and the world around her, forever.

title: I'll Take That Marriage This Time
synopsis:
Adored by her noble family, Saina Devof had a perfect life until one night ruined her societal debut, her family’s honor, and her future in one fell swoop. Determined to fix her mistake, she chooses to marry the man from that night, only to find herself trapped in a nightmare that ended with her lonely death.
Then, she woke up. 18 years old again with a second chance at life, Saina swears off marriage for good.
But her plans change when he appears: “I want to be your choice.” 
Enter Duke Constantine—the man determined to rewrite her destiny.

title: The Witch Doctor of Walpurgis
synopsis: Upbeat witch doctor Kina Witchwood receives an ominous prophecy: she will face her execution in six months, but not before encountering three men--one she cannot refuse, one she cannot persuade, and one to whom she will vow her life. Though she tries to defy fate, she soon finds herself appointed as the emperor's personal physician and thrust into the heart of the imperial palace's trecherous political intrigues.

title: The Knight Becomes a Black Flower
synopsis: Diana Lesley, a renowned knight of the Agripana Kingdom, is killed by her rival Cornelius Heimann in the war against the Heverunia Empire. However, when she wakes up, she finds herself at 10 years old and decides to pursue the life of a proper lady instead of a knight—much to her family's disapproval. After becoming Princess Juliana's lady-in-waiting, she must contend with conniving noblewomen, the threat of oncoming war, and the affections of Cornelius who, in this life, dreams about her past life and falls for her. Can she keep her loved ones safe and live in peace?

title: The Prize of Youth
synopsis: Yeong, nicknamed “Contest God” for her middle school wins, faces a chaotic start to high school when a contest with a huge prize is announced. The catch? It requires a six-person team. After a class project forces Yeong, her best friend Hana, and four unlikely teammates together, Yeong learns about the challenges of teamwork. But when the prize money doubles, the mismatched group decides to enter, sparking drama and unexpected bonds. Will they find success -- and maybe something more?

title: Bride of the Afterworld
synopsis: Legend says the God of the Afterlife gave his heart to one human girl to keep her as his eternal bride. Their love is loyal, their love is forever, and their love is a prison for the eighth reincarnation of Mei Shi. Raised in a secluded shrine to become the perfect bride, Mei Shi refuses to be humanity’s peace offering to the Afterworld any longer, especially after discovering the God of the Afterlife's true cruel nature. To escape being forcefully married off to the terrifying and possessive god once again, Mei Shi will forge her own path under her own name: Mytha. She’s willing to defy the gods, humanity, and fate itself to end this cruel love story. Mytha, more than just a bride, will kill the God of the Afterlife herself.

title: The Sichuan Tang Clan’s Entomologist
synopsis:
Fabre, a famous million-viewer streamer known for his daring encounters with venomous creatures, is bitten by a black mamba while filming in Africa and wakes up in the mystical world of Murim. To his surprise, the jungles of Murim offer him a peaceful farming life in which he enjoys cultivating various poisonous species. But his tranquility is short-lived when he crosses paths with members of the Tang Clan, the masters of poison and devious tactics. 
"I see potential in you. Become a part of our family.""

title: Ultimate Shut-in
synopsis:
Kill monsters, save your neighbors, and expand your domain, all from the comfort of your couch. 
When his city becomes infested with monsters, Jaehyeon discovers an ability that makes him the absolute master of his apartment building. But his ability comes with a catch -- he cannot leave his apartment. Now, he must arm his neighbors and lead them beyond their building to survive the post-apocalyptic world they find themselves in.

title: What Death Taught Me
synopsis: As if being framed by her love for plotting a murder weren’t enough, Rinette learns that her stepsister, Kanna, is the true mastermind behind it all. As she’s burned at the stake, Rinette makes a desperate wish for another chance…and wakes up as her younger self. Determined to change her fate, she vows to stop Kanna’s schemes and protect her family this time around. But rewriting the past is far from simple. Each choice she makes brings unforeseen consequences—some more devastating than she could imagine. Can Rinette escape the shadows of her past, or will they consume her once more?

title: My Status Window Went on Strike
synopsis: Monsters pour out of gates, wreaking havoc on the world, but Taejun couldn’t care less. After seven years of failure and bullying in his hunter’s guild, he’s fired—until his dormant S-Tier power suddenly activates. Now, with newfound strength, Taejun hunts monsters, exacts brutal revenge, and rises to fame. But as his power grows, so does the danger, and shadowy forces begin targeting him. Can Taejun stay one step ahead and crush those who want him dead?

title: Combat Ward
synopsis:
Seonu Kang single-handedly takes down a group of illegal loan sharks who show up at his house. While being treated at the hospital, he encounters a mysterious man who offers him an invitation to a suspicious secret fighting tournament with a massive cash prize. 
The prize money is his only hope to save his family. Seonu must survive in the combat ward at all costs! Will he be able to defeat all other fighters and become champion?

title: The Academy is Doomed
synopsis: The academy where Amon was assigned as a new teacher has gone bankrupt! The principal is addicted to gambling, the teachers are no-goods, and the students are lethargic! How will Amon tread forth as he stands at the crossroads of escape and success? A comedic fantasy series that will make your sides hurt from laughing!

title: The Fallen Sage Rises to Power
synopsis: In a world where dungeons and monsters appeared one day and people began to develop special powers, Yuto Kirishima is an orphan and an F-Rank adventurer who is forced to join lower-level raids to make ends meet as he supports his younger sister, Arisa. When his guild tries to turn him into a human sacrifice, he instead awakens to an overwhelming new power! As he uses this legendary sage skill to raise his rank, he suddenly hears news of a dungeon break right by his sister's school. Can he save her and the city before it's too late?

title: The Necromancer Family’s Young Heir
synopsis:
A spinoff of “Time-Limited Genius Dark Knight.”
Leon von Marbas had no choice but to execute his father when his house was defeated in a war. Though chosen as the new lord, the renown and strength of the mighty Marbas necromancy has dwindled, and the weight of the declining clan is much too heavy for 14-year-old Leon to bear. In a time of despair, however, Marbas the Black Lion, the devil who granted the power of necromancy to his forefather, approaches Leon...

title: Lock Me Up, Duke!
authors: Kisai Entertainment,ⓒGLEE CAT,AriaSama,Nana.maruse,Ndeelooknow Studio,Ha Min Seon
synopsis:
When doomed to get the bad ending, everyone would try to avoid it no matter what, right? But, that’s not the case for A-Min Kim. 
Reborn as Jayna Blake, the main character of her favorite game: “How to Fall in Love with the Obsessed Man”, A-min Kim is determined to get the locked up ending. Free food, limitless sleep, and no need to work! Who’d refuse that? At least, not Jayna!

title: Be By My Side
synopsis: Aylah Goldwyn’s destiny had been determined since her birth: she was to marry the crown prince. However, on the day after her wedding, the prince asks for their marriage to be dissolved. Now, she suffers from near-constant headaches and insomnia, made bearable only through the embrace of a man. One night, she discovers a man who can make her headaches disappear entirely with nothing but a touch. But the next morning, she discovers that he left without a word, and she doesn’t even know his name. Will she be able to find this mysterious man, her “cure”?

title: I've Fallen for the Empire's Greatest Villainess
synopsis: There’s a price to be paid for a seemingly perfect life. For Raven, the dashing young son of a duke tasked with guarding the empire, marriage represents nothing but a downward spiral into misery. Cherishing his freedom as a bachelor, Raven is perplexed when the daughter of rival House Sharen makes him a daring proposal of marriage. But there’s a hitch: Lady Estrella Sharen is an infamous villainess who is feared across the empire! Raven suspects there is more to her than meets the eye, but nonetheless agrees to enter into a marriage contract…

title: Chronicles of a Doomed Prodigy
synopsis: Gifted by the heavens yet cursed by fate, Yeonshin was born with unimaginable talent in martial arts. But this very gift condemned him to a life that would end before adulthood. With the right opportunities, he had the potential to become a legendary hero, or the reincarnation of the Heavenly Demon. Yet fate cast him into the third-rate Jeong Clan, a family of no particular renown. Now, with time slipping through his fingers, Yeonshin must find a way to defy his doomed destiny.

title: For the Princess Who Will Disappear
synopsis:
You’re saying that I, a barmaid who grew up on the streets, might be the princess…?!
After pawning off a necklace, Sasha finds herself embroiled in a game of politics and enters the Imperial Palace as the long-lost Princess Anastasia. The secretive romance between Sasha, a shrewd and daring back-alley-raised “princess,” and the stern Duke Lascan, fiancé to the missing princess who vows to stay by Sasha's side, unfolds!

title: Transference
synopsis:
Su-a, a college freshman in Creative Writing, struggles to understand and express her emotions, leaving her isolated from those around her. When she meets Taeyang, a second-year Sports Coaching student who can sense emotions through touch, their unexpected connection sparks a journey of discovery. Paired for a class assignment that involves a "date," their bond deepens.
This is a story about a man who feels too much and a woman who feels too little, and their journey toward emotional growth.

title: Deadpoint
synopsis: When the going gets tough, the tough get going. But what if sooner or later, we hit a ceiling and can’t soar any higher? For Hoji Park, a young sports climber with grand ambitions, it’s difficult to accept that our limitations are set in stone. When her mother passes away from a tragic accident, Hoji begins to see a literal manifestation of her limits in the form of a dark barrier across the sky. Years later, together with former climbing idol Aseong Chae, Hoji begins the ultimate climb of all– the ascent past all limitations.

title: False Paradise
synopsis: High school student Sanho, blessed with extraordinary intuition, finds himself caught in a battle between monsters only he can see, nearly losing his life. He awakens in a world where monsters keep humans as pets. Now trapped as a pet himself, Sanho desperately searches for a way to escape and return home. Will he be able to find his way back home?

title: Game Master
synopsis: "Gamemaster," a high school streamer, dedicated his life to beating the supposedly unbeatable game "Hero's Destiny." Finally succeeding after ten years, the realization that he's wasted his life is short-lived, as the game asks him to keep playing—only for him to wake up inside the game after he agrees, in the body of Callix Szcecin, the meek young son of a count. Together with Lyla, the maid and assassin hired by his stepmother who failed to kill him, Russel, the loyal knight, and Kraut, a young knight with much potential, Callix must survive the game again, in person.

title: It Wasn't Love at First Sight
synopsis: Eunjae Seo, a not-so-fortunate member of a wealthy conglomerate family, goes on a blind date with Shi-u Yun, whom her grandfather arranged for her to marry. Initially wary of Shi-u due to his bad reputation, Eunjae starts warming up to him as Shi-u confesses he fell in love with her at first sight. She ends up falling deeply in love with him. The two seem to be a happy couple, until Shi-u begins to reveal his secrets to her after their wedding.

title: Hero of All Trades
synopsis:
Gang-in Na wakes up in the year 2024 in the middle of South Korea with no memory of where or who he is.

Upon hearing a voice that sounds strangely familiar, he comes face to face with a robot named ACE (Autonomous Combat Entity), who informs him that he was once part of the Earth Federation Forces in the year 2082 and possesses a wide array of skills.

Gang-in decides to join forces with ACE to recover his lost memories and adapt to life on Earth, but the two look to be in for a bumpy ride.

title: The Graymark
synopsis:
Have you ever been so angry that you wanted to break the laws of physics and throw down with a cosmic being? Well, you might if you’re Great—no, not “great”; I mean Great the Executioner. On planet Graymark, where the law decrees that all sinners must die, Great makes a name for himself butchering criminals in their thousands. Except now the law is no more, and Great must stand trial before the King of the Cosmos, Lohumlagaha. Enraged by fate, Great takes up his sword. It's just one last time… Or is it?
This series contains themes regarding child abuse that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: Devilish Son-In-Law
synopsis: Jaerim, a.k.a. the “Executioner”, the most fearsome villain of all, is about to marry his civilian girlfriend! But before they can say “I do”, he has to survive life with her family, who just so happen to be the most powerful superhero clan. Can he keep his identity a secret and convince them that he’s the perfect son-in-law?

title: My Girlfriend is the Man!
synopsis: Yunjae Park thought his relationship with his girlfriend, Ji-eun, was perfect--until one shocking morning changed everything. Ji-eun has mysteriously transformed into a man overnight! Can the two adjust to this sudden and earth-shattering change? And will Ji-eun ever turn back to who she once was?!

title: Leviathan
synopsis:
"The Survival of Humanity in a Submerged Earth"

The endless monsoon began when an icy comet collided with the Moon, triggering a catastrophic flood on Earth. 

For 70 years, unrelenting rain fell, ultimately submerging the entire planet.Having lost their land, humanity's survival now depends on life at sea. The once-dominant species that ruled the Earth is no more. Sea creatures, mutated into grotesque beings known as "leviathans," now pose a deadly threat to human life.

As the world teeters on the brink of collapse, two siblings, Bota and Rita, must navigate a dangerous new reality filled with monstrous threats, human conflict, and the destruction of the environment.

title: Kowloon: COPÓKA
synopsis: Jintae Seo and his younger sister Jina, a purple-eyed albino, are separated after being kidnapped by human traffickers. After two years of torment, Jintae is rescued by an assassin named Shin Kim. After years of training, Jintae, now an assassin himself, follows a lead to Hong Kong to find his sister. After accidentally getting involved in a gang war, it is revealed that Jina is apparently an assassin working for Kai Liu, another albino, who is rebelling against the Triad, and claims that Jina is his half-sister. Can Jintae stay alive long enough to reunite with her?

title: The Roguish Guard in a Medieval Fantasy
synopsis: In a brutal medieval world where innocence means life and guilt means death, Aron, captain of the castle guard, enforces order within the fortress. But when demons begin to corrupt men’s hearts, violent events erupt, including repeated attempts to assassinate the lady of the castle. As Aron hunts the culprits, he encounters a demon that marks him, granting incredible strength but tainting his body with dark magic. Now, with his mind clouded and powers growing, Aron must unravel the mystery before the castle and his soul fall to ruin.

title: Endless Summer
synopsis:
After being joyfully reunited with Jinhan Ryu, the best friend of her brother, Hayeon Ji’s day immediately takes a turn for the worse as the two witness her boyfriend with another woman, right in front of them.
After a series of awkward, coincidental encounters between the two, Hayeon and Jinhan begin to get reacquainted with one another. But after spending some time together, Jinhan seems to begin seeing her as more than his friend’s little sister.

title: Locked Up by My Mad Dog
synopsis:
After dying and being reborn as Elizabeth, a character from a dark fantasy novel, the new “Elizabeth” begins to navigate her new life.

Set to be married to the empire’s crown prince, the new Elizabeth can’t believe her luck. But just as she’s getting ready for a life on easy street, the dark secrets of the previous “Elizabeth” begin to come to light. 

Learning that Elizabeth keeps a slave known as her “dog,” Elizabeth feels she should set him free. 
But little does she know that pulling on this thread will unravel far more than she could ever imagine.

title: Growth-Type Superhero
synopsis: In a world where humanity battles monsters with powerful weapons called Relics, Hinata Asahi is the ultimate underdog at Valkyria Academy, a school for training warriors. Mocked for his relic, a gimmicky suit that looks like a comic book costume, and bullied by classmates, no one knows it holds a secret. The more he is pushed down, the stronger it becomes. Driven by his father’s legacy, Hinata forges new friendships and pushes past every obstacle. With unwavering determination, can he rise to become one of the academy’s strongest?

title: Absolute Reign
synopsis: Twenty years have passed since the Great War, but petty theft and exploitation have taken root during times of peace. The once dazzling world of Murim is a mere shadow of its former self, but one young enigmatic swordsman has sworn to restore Jianghu to its former glory. Will the noble principles of justice and loyalty prevail over corruption and greed?

title: MOONSTRUCK
synopsis:
How far would you be willing to go for love? 
The unavoidable temptation to destroy one’s deepening love is an age-old dilemma for many. This provocative collection of love stories will show you how dangerous passion can sometimes be.

title: Space Cheon-ma 3077
synopsis: Qi, swords, martial artists… and robots and spaceships?! The year is 3077, thousands of years after the heyday of the martial arts realm. Humanity inhabits the stars, governed by interstellar martial arts organizations who kept the old ways of the realm alive: might makes right! For bounty hunters like Seryeong, Robert, and Sunja, this means trouble is good for business, except when they bite off more than they can chew. After venturing to the irradiated wasteland of Earth for a top bounty, only to find a 2,000-year-old martial artist instead, they realize their fortunes are about to change…

title: Monster Eater
synopsis:
Rudd’s a nobody-- just an E-Rank adventurer with a seemingly useless talent of status immunity. 
An outcast in a city obsessed with labyrinth crawling, he’s stuck scraping by as a “grubby forager,” navigating guild politics and backstabbing adventurers just to survive. 
But when a betrayal leaves him for dead without any supplies or help, he does the unthinkable and consumes the flesh of fallen monsters...

title: The Black Serpent
synopsis: “I shall destroy the factions of justice and avenge the deaths of my comrades!” Jeonghwa, the captain of the Black Serpent Squad, loses everyone she grew up with when the lawful factions betray them after the battle against the chaotic factions. On the verge of death herself, she must now claw her way up to deliver true justice to the so-called justice factions.

title: Hellbound 2: The Resurrected
synopsis: Five years have passed since a blameless infant was spared from a demonstration, saved by her parents' self-sacrifice. Yet what should have ended the religious hysteria has instead fueled a new wave of feverish cult practices by the ever-growing Arrowhead. As society teeters on the brink of further chaos and long-dead sinners inexplicably begin returning to life, the government steps in behind the scenes to tip the scales.

title: Reincarnated into a Cursed Game
synopsis: An overworked game developer dies and is reincarnated as the weakest character in the game he created himself. Challenged by Jaeseokcheon, the ruler of the game universe, he must complete a series of quests to survive and prevent a second death. Epic battles between monsters, celestial beings with magic powers, and Jaeseokcheon ensue. In this tug-of-war between the omniscient game designer and the hidden mastermind ruler… Who will win?

title: Radiant Rewind
synopsis: In a cynical world where love has lost its luster, 37-year-old Hayeong Kim is merely a shell of her former self. But in a twist of fate, she’s catapulted back in time, inhabiting the body and vibrant spirit of her 17-year-old self, Seon Kim, and reliving an era of passionate love and limitless potential. Empowered by her knowledge of what’s to come, Seon embarks on a mission to reshape her friends’ destinies. Bouncing between past and present, orchestrating grand changes, Seon begins to discover that altering others’ lives might be the key to rediscovering love, purpose, and the courage to dream again.

title: The Unparalleled Hidden Rank Equipment
synopsis: What would you do if you suddenly regained memories of your past life and realized you were living in a world that was once a game you played? Jinfrey chooses to use his knowledge as an OG gamer and exploit the game’s secrets so he can become an unparalleled adventurer. But he’ll have to be careful because if he dies, it’s game over! Will he be able to find all of the hidden rank equipment, defeat the bosses, and give his family the life they deserve?

title: A Flower Blooms on the Wall
synopsis: “Of course I recognized you. You’re my first love.” Living a life of being stalked by her first love, Dam Do is visited by her brother’s friend Yun Oh. No longer the boy next door who used to follow her around like a puppy, Yun is now a man, and he acts strangely aloof around her. While Dam has found herself resenting her first love, Yun is secretly quite excited to be around his first love once again. As the two become reacquainted after their time apart, they may be in for a lesson on what love really is.

title: The Memory Shop
synopsis: Feeling down? Stop by Cunimaru – a cozy shop where souls waiting for reincarnation gather to reminisce about their happiest memories. Savor a warm cup of tea and join Jiun Lee, Cunimaru’s new owner, as she embarks on a journey of healing, both for herself and her new friends, while unraveling the mysteries of this whimsical afterlife retreat.

title: Dear Summer Sky
synopsis:
Gihu, a high schooler with a passion for photographing the sky, dreams of entering a photography contest. However, the contest requires a portrait photo, which he’s terrible at. He enlists the help of Haneul, a mysterious new transfer student who accidentally appears in one of Gihu’s sky photos. Despite his struggles, he finds himself wanting to take more photos of her. As they prepare for the school festival, Gihu becomes more intrigued by Haneul, while she, initially misjudging him, helps him out of guilt after realizing she underestimated his abilities.


This series contains themes regarding bullying that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, please reach out for help at Crisis Text Line (http://crisistextline.org/).

title: The Princess and the Boss
synopsis: Juyeong Nam, the boss of a multinational corporation, has been doing his best to defy the fate of a super-rich male lead, only to be swept off his feet by a princess falling from the sky! Will he succeed in returning this princess, with her strange hair color and even stranger personality, to her world safely?

title: Funtime Phobia
synopsis: Scared? Not yet? We’ll see about that! Welcome to the Circus, where monsters feast on your greatest fears, then send you home. Chip the clown does his very best to frighten Raylee, but she is, tragically, fearless! Surely there’s a phobia out there just for her.

title: SCREWBALL
synopsis: When a dead officer’s badge falls into Vano Grice’s hands, he enters the city’s hidden war with soul devouring Shadows. The badge links him to the SDU, a monster hunting organization where his sister Cleo serves. As the power within his soul awakens, the work pulls him deeper and raises doubts about the truth at home.

title: Primoral Descent
synopsis: It starts with two. A young D'ar warrior, haunted by a beast. And a child of prophecy, blessed with Gnomon's holy light. He would give anything to live free. She would give anything to reunite with the person she loves most. If they work together, one of them just might get what they want. Together, Kenjie and Rivkah must fight their way through a world that’s pulsating with magical tech, ancient secrets, religious warfare… and a dormant potential for wishes to be made manifest.

title: Girlfriend Manual
synopsis: Athena is desperate. Why is dating girls so hard? Even though she's doing everything to become the "it" girl- the skincare, the workouts, and even the university she goes to- nothing is working. Where is Athena's love story? Every crush ends in disaster, every date is a flop, and her confidence is running low. But then she meets Levi, the handsome yet mysterious barista. Athena can’t keep her eyes off of her! She knows she can't mess this one up and her friends have just the solution. Athena needs... the Girlfriend Manual.

title: Nina Lives Alone
synopsis: Nina is living on her own for the first time, and between work, classes, and home maintenance, she's determined to make it work. Sure, she's learning as she goes, but how hard could it possibly be?

title: The Reluctant Demon Cult Leader
synopsis:
The leader of the demonic cult is a formidable entity that everyone is afraid of.
However, while the demonic cult members expect him to exude great violence, the new Demonic Cult Leader, Do Yu-gang, wishes to live a simple and peaceful life.
Will his modest wish be granted in the end?

title: Broken Engagement
synopsis: “Once I’m back from the battlefield, perhaps you’ll share your heart with me then.” Those were the final words of Prince Lochlan of the Routen Kingdom to his fiancée April Campbell before he rode away to war, never to return. Left heartbroken and destitute as the neglected ward of her greedy uncle and his mistress, April desires nothing more than her freedom, almost as ardently as she wants her prince to return to life. When April is brought to the royal palace for her beloved prince’s funeral, she notices something unusual about his twin brother, Crown Prince Dominic…

title: How Far Can We Go?
synopsis: The Song family's true biological daughter appears, shaking Juha's world. Seeking an escape from an unwelcoming home, Juha embarks on a series of blind dates until she meets Sahyeon, who boldly suggests setting a wedding date within minutes of their first date. Just as Juha starts to develop feelings for him, her cunning younger sister—who has already taken everything else from her—declares her intention to marry him instead.

title: Kill to Live
synopsis: Individuals who return from death as Terminal Revenants are granted unique abilities that allow them to surpass human limits. They have the power to steal the lifespan of others. Twenty-one years ago, the worst of these revenants, Hae-su Shin, disappeared without a trace after killing 144 people and stealing everything. Now, a revenge 20 years in the making begins, aimed at capturing the most dangerous of these resurrected beings.

title: Over the Top
synopsis: Legend says that a being stronger than any other, a being feared by both angels and demons, a being completely OVER THE TOP (aka OTT) will be awakened in the near future. But our average high school boy Jae-ik doesn’t care much for this legend... until he turns 19 and members of Heaven and Hell desperately attempt to win him over. Will our soon-to-be fearsome (and uninterested) OTT be able to pick a side? Well, we'll see once the dust of the recruiting war settles.

title: Love in Session
synopsis: Eighteen-year-old Woori Chae is just a normal high schooler who loves reality dating shows—until she unexpectedly lands a spot on "Love in Session" alongside her childhood crush, Woojin Hyeon. Frantic to win his heart, Woori throws herself at the opportunity. But her mission quickly becomes complicated: Woojin is mysteriously absent, one participant hates her, and she finds herself unexpectedly attracted to others on the show. As romantic tensions rise, Woori must navigate her feelings and the show’s drama. Can she untangle her heart and find true love amid the chaos?

title: Frozen Hearts
synopsis: Hiding her identity as a Snow Maiden demon, Seolha has carved out a life in disguise among humans. However, her life changes forever when she catches the interest of the Northern Prince, a man known for hunting down and killing demons, and agrees to become his bride. Will these two be able to overcome their differences and live happily ever after?

title: High School Queen
synopsis:
Cheongha Kim, a legendary swordswoman from the Joseon era, awakens centuries later in the body of Dajin Park, a quiet high school student. Armed with deadly combat skills, Cheongha must face school bullies, navigate the chaos of modern-day life, and find her place in a world far different from her own. The halls of Juwon High are about to meet a warrior unlike any they’ve seen before.
The series contains themes regarding bullying and violence that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan
synopsis: Cecil Perdium, the Mercenary King, was killed in battle before he could avenge his family. As he faces death, he learns that Duke Delphine, the man who caused the downfall of his family, didn't work alone. Suddenly waking up as his teenage self, Cecil must work to both overcome his poor reputation and build up his strength to save his family. With their soldiers and knights defecting due to the harsh conditions they must endure, he has his work cut out for him. Can Cecil become the mighty warrior he once was and avert his family's fate?

title: Writers Legacy
synopsis: In a world ruled by Writers, a chosen few who draw incredible power from their books, we follow Ji-Sung, an underdog E-rank Writer. His life changes forever as he discovers he’s the secret heir of a legendary Writer and possesses extraordinary abilities. Now hunted for his new powers, Ji-Sung must unlock the truth about his legacy and face fearsome new enemies.

title: The Regressor Only Protects Me
synopsis:
“Let the Survival Game Begin!”Designated as a disruptive species in the universe’s ecology,
humanity must now participate in the ‘league’ under the watchful eye of the universal administrators. 
Jaehui Jin, sent back in time during the final stage of the game, arrives at one conclusion -
only Sion Kang has the power to lead humanity to victory.

title: Valhalla Saga
synopsis:
The strength of a Valhalla warrior comes from the Saga, a magical power born from the feats and achievements of their past life. 
Although Taeho was the world's greatest pro gamer and not a warrior, his character, the valiant Karstedt, was a legend in the world of Dark Age.
Taeho must now begin a new saga to end Ragnarok and prevent the world from being destroyed.

title: Bad Born Blood
synopsis: All this is for the Empire. Luca had never once questioned his dream of joining Accretia’s Imperial Guard. Not until he met Ilay, that is. The most unexpected of friends, Ilay’s personality and family background are nothing like Luca’s. However, it is through their differences that the two friends will begin to shape not only each other, but even the very planet on which they live.

title: Ark of the Law
synopsis:
Eight children, each gifted with mysterious powers that could spell disaster for the world, grow up together on a remote island shrouded in a sinister and unsettling aura. What secrets are they hiding, and what future awaits them?

This series contains themes regarding child abuse and mental health that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, please reach out for help at Crisis Text Line (http://crisistextline.org/).

title: The Academy’s Sashimi Sword Master
synopsis: Chef Kim, Korea's legendary sashimi master, is transported into the world of Blessing M, a mobile game he once played. But instead of being a hero, he finds himself as Geomma Kang, a mere background extra. Forced into a new life, Geomma discovers a new power: the Blessing of the Blade God. Now, to survive in this game-like world, he must slice through challenges and enemies alike. Will his unmatched skills in the kitchen be enough to carve out a new destiny?

title: Day of Disaster
synopsis: In 2009, a resident of a small mountain village is shot and killed, and this murder leads to a series of sinister events. Jeong-u Cho, a boy who was born and raised in the village, begins to feel a mysterious gaze on him, and finds himself caught up in an uncontrollable disaster.

title: Oversummoned, Overpowered, and Over It!
synopsis: It was another boring school day, or so thought Inori Takafuji until Goddess summons him and his classmates to a different world. Just as Inori gets excited for a new life, he is banished and resummoned to other worlds over and over again, each time with new, additional powers! Will there be an actual challenge and suspense befitting our super-packed hero or will the adventure be a breeze?

title: Hiding a Warehouse in the Apocalypse
synopsis: Imagine you are stuck inside a warehouse while the world is experiencing an apocalypse. That’s exactly what’s happening to Jeong-gyeom, except he suddenly awakens a very odd but powerful ability to store anything in a parallel dimension, giving him the tools to defeat the creatures wreaking havoc on the world. But as he ventures into the ravaged city of Seoul, he realizes there is more to this apocalypse than meets the eye as he encounters other survivors and mysterious monsters on his quest to find his family.

title: Yeonwoo's Innocence
synopsis: Yeonwoo is easily mistaken for a female student due to his soft and delicate appearance. He develops a crush on Haesol Kang, the most popular student in school. However, due to his shy and timid personality, Yeonwoo has never spoken to Haesol even once despite being in the same class.

title: Ultimate Tutorial Warrior
synopsis:
Junsu is an ordinary college student who spends an extraordinary amount of time trying to beat a pay-to-win hero collector game called Arcane Seoul. All his hours of painstaking gameplay finally pays off when he lands Cheonma, one of the ultimate SS-ranked characters in the game, seconds before a truck runs him over.
Now, he finds himself as Jeonsa Kim, a basic tutorial-stage character who can learn any skill. Can he use his gaming knowledge to survive the godforsaken, magic-driven, and monster-ridden alternate world of Arcane Seoul?
'This series contains depictions of gun violence that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.'

title: My Aggravating Sovereign
synopsis: Aria’s world is thrown into chaos when Crown Prince Julius, the brilliant but insufferable royal she’s sworn to protect as Captain of his Guard, announces her as his future bride. Stunned, Aria confronts him, and Julius offers a way out: if she can defeat him in any competition before the wedding in six months, he’ll cancel the engagement. But with Julius’ unmatched skills, winning won’t be easy. Can Aria outsmart the talented prince and reclaim her life?

title: Return Your Soul
synopsis: Ryeong is the only one in her exorcist family without powers—she can only see ghosts. One night, during the village festival, she encounters Yuseong, a young man possessed by a mysterious ghost. The ghost asks Ryeong to help uncover his lost memories and break the grudge that binds him to the living world. Desperate to escape her family's cruelty, Ryeong seizes the chance to enroll in Mujang-gak, the elite martial arts school run by Yuseong’s family. As a female student in a male-dominated world, she faces relentless challenges. Can she survive and uncover the truth to free them both?

title: My Child Will Have a Different Father
synopsis: “Fate, save my unborn child…!” These are the last words of Princess Hinael as she plummets to her death at the hands of Count Chetaire, her unfaithful husband. Little does Hinael know that destiny will grant her a second chance, as she awakens two years in the past, shortly before her marriage. With her knowledge of what’s to come, Hinael attempts to rewrite the stars for herself and her future child. And what better way to achieve her ambitions than to court her kingdom’s former enemy, the dark and stern Prince Lutz of the Empire of Triekas?

title: The Acting Empress Still Spends the First Night
synopsis: Zelda von Trova never wanted the title of Acting Empress, but when she's forced to wed the Emperor of the Raphion Empire in place of the runaway princess, she has no choice. Yet after sharing the first night with him, her divorce plans begin to waver. As their attraction grows, Zelda’s heart is torn-- will she be able to walk away when the time comes, or will love unravel all her plans?

title: The Demon Faction’s Return
synopsis:
In an effort to escape the power struggle within the Heavenly Demon Sect, the protagonist Myeong-un retreats to a life of seclusion. However, simply avoiding ambition for the throne is not enough to avert tragedy. 

Myeong-un flees from the sect leader Myeong-gak, who seeks fratricide, before meeting his demise. At the moment of his death, as his consciousness fades, he hears a voice. 

"Do you regret it? Do you wish to fight again?""

To his surprise, Myeong-un, believed to be dead, opens his eyes once more....

title: I Grabbed the Leash of the Blind Beast
synopsis: When an average twenty-something wakes up in the battered body of a nameless extra from a romance novel, all she wants is to go home. But first, she’ll have to see the story through as Rona, the maid of Grand Duke Ileon, the novel’s hero who was blinded by poison. She just has to make sure the heroine restores his sight with a special flower so they can have their happy ending -- easy enough, right? With a plot gone awry, Rona’s dangerous past, and the grand duke’s affections, can Rona stick to the story?

title: Horde: Dark Contract Saga
synopsis: Obi is just an average high schooler who needs money for a date with the girl he likes. But when he signs a contract for a part-time job with a shady boss, he isn't prepared for the fine print… bringing the souls of the damned under heel! With new powers and more to his past than he realizes, he will have to become stronger in order to save the girl… and the world!

title: Fatal Reset
synopsis: Yohan Silang is on a mission of revenge to destroy the demon lords who massacred his village. In order to achieve his goals, he must rise through the ranks to become the most powerful Seeker in the land. The only thing that can stop him is death. Or can it? When dying is just another opportunity to grow stronger, Yohan will do whatever it takes to have his revenge.

title: Socializing 101
synopsis:
Mihai has always been considered intimidating, and the more others avoided him the more socially awkward and anxious he became. Content with two friends, his grandmother, and his beloved cat Muffins, he never felt the need to change... until university started and the charming Adilene moves in next door. Will Mihai resist opening up his life to his polar opposite? Or will he realize that all change might not be so bad?

This series contains themes regarding anxiety and depression that may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, please reach out for help at Crisis Text Line (http://crisistextline.org/).

title: Raising Hell: A Demon's Guide to Parenting
synopsis: A magical baby foils the plans of a powerful demon attempting to escape his complicated past.

title: Little Hollow Café
synopsis: When Mimi moves from the big city to quaint Little Hollow to take over her grandmother’s café, she expects a sleepy, quiet town… but nobody warned her about the fae lurking around every corner! While it’s every bit as cozy as her grandmother described it, it is also full of magic, secrets, and ridiculously cute people. Can Mimi uncover the magical secrets hidden within Little Hollow? And will she be able to pay rent at the end of the month?

title: The Laws of Cultivation
synopsis:
Lu Jie woke up in a world filled with scheming sects, arrogant young masters, and the mad chase for the immortal heavens. He wanted none of it. But his plan to escape the sect is interrupted by an old Alchemist's pills that heal him within moments—a magical cure. These medicines ignite the flame of curiosity to learn true magic in him, rekindling his love of discovery. Lu Jie sets out to study the immutable truths hidden within the world, and soon finds an all-new path of cultivation that could take him to the very top.

Art by Kisai Entertainment

title: The Count's Secret Maid
synopsis: For Paula, not a single day passed by without a reminder of her ugliness. But it was her hideous face that spared her from being sold to a brothel or dying tragically like her sisters. So when Paula's father sells her off to work at an esteemed nobleman's mansion, she realizes that peasant girls are a disposable resource. However, she finds the young Count Belunita tucked away in an annex, shamefully hidden from the curious eyes of the public. And as Paula struggles to appeal to her tyrannical master's whims, she must also embrace her role as his secret maid.

title: The Heir
synopsis: As a young boy, Taeha Jin’s life is turned upside down when an attack during a family yacht trip robs him of his parents and future as heir to the Cheon-gu Group–Korea’s leading conglomerate. Uncovering the dark truths behind the accident–one of vicious power struggles and family betrayals–he escapes to Italy, vowing revenge. Seventeen years later, Taeha is finally back in Korea. A man driven by vengeance, he can’t wait for the sweetest revenge as he makes those who robbed everything from him pay dearly. The stakes are high, and the battle with Cheon-gu begins!

title: At Your Mercy
synopsis: Getting transported into a novel once? Unusual. Twice? Welcome to Ji-an Han’s reality. Her second possession lands her in the body of a noble lady with an unfortunate reputation—the court fool. While still adjusting to this twist of fate, the enigmatic Crown Prince Iskan enters the scene with an unsettling proposition: "Take me as yours," he says, "I’ll become your most cherished possession."  Between her reputation as a fool and a prince whose motives remain unclear, can Ji-an navigate this complicated new reality?

title: A Savage Proposal
synopsis: When the ruthless Lord Tiwakan seizes the kingdom of Nauk, Princess Liene Arsac faces an impossible choice: marry her captor or watch her homeland crumble. But Lord Tiwakan isn’t just after power; he desires Liene, and his devotion stirs a mix of fear and undeniable attraction within her. With her former betrothed, Lafitte, still missing, Liene must decide whether to trust Tiwakan's promises or hold out hope for a rescue. As dangerous secrets come to light, Liene’s decision could change the fate of Nauk—and her own heart—forever.

title: Dagger to the Heart
synopsis: How hard is it to kill a princess? Rafael, a cocky assassin, takes on a job to kill Sazet, the princess of the empire, but soon finds that she is not the easy target he thought. When they are forced to team up, Rafael must decide if he will bury his dagger in her heart…. Or if his will be captured first.

title: When Two Villains Meet
synopsis:
Atalante is the boss of a notorious organization that works in the empire’s shadow. One day, she receives a request from the emperor to assassinate a new target: the tyrant archduke Lionel Vianc.
Reluctantly leaving behind her simple life with her members, Atalante heads off to perform the assassination, but for some reason… the archduke doesn’t die.
After a mixup between a love potion and poison, Atalante finds herself in a frustrating predicament as the tyrant archduke not only refuses to die… but has also fallen in love with her!

title: My Avatars’ Path to Greatness
synopsis: Seonghyeon Han is a victim of a violent crime that left him with impaired legs and a fear of the outside world. Now, he faces an even greater challenge: while he gained the power to create clones, he has just 24 hours before being sent to another dimension. As the countdown ticks down, Seonghyeon makes a desperate move -- he sends his clone through the interdimensional portal, and discovers his real body can remain safe at home. Thus begins the epic tale of Seonghyeon's... clones.

title: My Blood-Curdling Campus Life
synopsis: A cute guy with an angelic face? Check. A cold and aloof outsider with a cat? Check. A class full of vampires? Check... Wait, what? All her life, Seonha Shin has lived in the shadow of her sister, Seonghye, who is one year older than her. Luckily, there is one thing Seonha does better than her sister -- donating blood! When Seonha gets special admission into a prestigious university as a blood donor, she finally starts to feel like the main character of her life. Little did she know she'd be surrounded by vampires!

title: Duchess in Ruins
synopsis: Edele Lancaster is the perfect noble lady who has been groomed for the job. But when her husband whom she married reluctantly commits treason, she is branded a traitor and becomes a slave. Distraught, she tries to kill herself to preserve honor as a noble lady, but her new master, Count Laslo Krissus prevents her from doing so. Will Edele be able to find freedom and happiness in her new life as Count Krissus’ maid?

title: Code Demon
